subject: Our last chance before midnight
body: Did you see our note from earlier today, team? We are in the closing days of this campaign – and the closing moments of our final end-of-month fundraising deadline. You already know that democracy is on the line. But if we can come together and dig deep, we can not only win this campaign, we can ensure our freedoms will be protected from the dangerous forces trying to unravel our democracy. So please, rush a donation of any amount before midnight tonight. [Johnson] and I have a secret. We’ll tell you what it is when the race is over.” — Donald Trump They might be referencing a refusal to certify the results of the election if Kamala Harris wins next week. ANY attempt to overrule the will of the voters is unconstitutional and unAmerican–no matter who it is that wins. While Republicans across the country bend the knee to Donald Trump again, Democratic candidates are putting Constitution before party. We can stop these threats to overthrow our democracy by flipping the House to Democratic control. The one way we can guarantee that happening? By electing Jen Schultz here in Minnesota’s 8th! subject: Not what you want to see
body: A second new poll out this week shows us down. With just 5 days left, we need your help                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          # [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=4743%2E552475%2EOvvHpE) This isn’t what you want to see, Peter. **Another public poll just released shows Bob behind David McCormick. It’s the second one in two weeks with us trailing.** That’s the first time we’ve seen two back-to-back polls with us down. You probably didn’t wake up this morning thinking “Gee, I’m going to donate to Bob Casey.” But with only 5 days left, we’re asking if you can chip in before it’s too late. Pennsylvania will come down to just a handful of votes. **We made you a personal link so we can thank everyone who donates:** [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241031-8?refcode=em20241031-8-dpwillis67@gmail.com**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241031-8?refcode=em20241031-8&refcode2=4743_552475_OvvHpE&akid=4743%2E552475%2EOvvHpE) We always knew this race would come down to the wire. body: I am ready to get to work on DAY ONE with Pres. Trump to secure our borders and fix what the left has broken. | [](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=c1aa2356c77f43209ee7aee0a0b41db9&_e=85m4KzVmLLujDCn13L_g9RdO3CRLbJPO99pjlC9vbg4afa1rcl_-mn-mbpp5ZTdjwQwSDeqSxYYAB8g4qMbdMsFVxVbDi5JZc2zJPyOkqDUvckPwLUZoeDCtZMJhEnRMTDCR8nlxywLMQgNP7F9ZTxjFqtKjzBDMSXQDw7xTsXuq51NCqzVmgvHuAPtoY7mQIE0pbERDAas4mkanjxPUM4ff9r3FjzQ3av--STMVP65QiLNlELbMNXmqioUKVrah6ye2UzKmpkmAQMF-RTDOIQ_ZTxIkIyVvKf8Ij4QpC-VI7HbqRLkNJ50DAi_91ynVz_D9oEmGb5qhGOt4P5isCw9LkBReTa9mTLkJ599SCJaPiKtW527gOjxQwhzZd45RmXYxuo35ZYuGmLJLNI3IlcfVn4XyYVoTG9CO9GdCw_o%3D) --- Friend, I was just boots on the ground at the border in New Mexico, once again assessing the situation and reminding voters just _how bad_ Kamala Harris and Martin Heinrich have allowed it to become. _Of course, “bad” is the understatement of the century._ Words and phrases like “horrifying,” “deadly,” and “worst in history” get closer to appropriate descriptions of what has happened under their watch. body: [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=8115%2E5257348%2EsXIrGH ]Adam Schiff for Senate Derek — In just a moment, I’ll ask you to [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2024_abs_em.0Y0BaT&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20241031_PM2_V1_S1&email=&amount=5&t=1004&akid=8115%2E5257348%2EsXIrGH ]chip in $5 ahead of tonight’s end-of-month deadline. But first, I want to update you on everything that’s been happening. We’re only 5 days away from the election, and attacks from MAGA Republicans are non-stop — especially Donald Trump. Whenever Trump gets near a microphone, it’s almost a given that he’s going to attack me. At a MAGA rally in California, Trump threatened to withhold federal assistance for wildfires, attacked me personally, and urged his supporters to back GOP candidates across California. On Fox News, Trump rolled out a dangerous new attack, calling me the “enemy within,” claiming that I’m even more dangerous than foreign adversaries. He even threatened to use the military against me for holding him accountable. His goal is simple, Derek: sabotage my campaign and silence anyone standing in his way. It’s clear Trump and his allies still see me as a threat — and the closer we get to Election Day, the worse and more frequent the attacks will become. I don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, so it will take a movement of grassroots supporters to overcome Trump and his allies’ attacks. name: Jill Stein
subject: Trump didn’t drain the swamp - he filled it
body: | | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=trump_swamp&n=1) --- Peter, In 2016 Donald Trump duped millions of voters into believing he would go to Washington and drive out corruption. _“Draining the swamp,”_ he called it. In that election Trump positioned himself as the anti-establishment candidate. And up against Hillary Clinton, to the casual voter it was a somewhat convincing argument. But the moment he took office, Trump filled his cabinet and every federal agency with cronies, crooks, lackeys, and lobbyists – to the tune of HUNDREDS of key positions according to a 2018 _ProPublica_ analysis. The result was the mass auctioning off of public parks and sacred native land for drilling, mining, and exploitation; a scam tax bill that shuffled BILLIONS in wealth directly to Trump’s own pockets and those of his elite buddies; empty promises on healthcare; foreign policy moves that directly undermined global peace and security (and directly profited Donald Trump); and a criminally mismanaged public health crisis that led to more than a MILLION American deaths. In 2016 Trump promised that he had a healthcare plan that was “going to cover everybody.” That was a lie. Donald Trump _never_ had a plan for universal healthcare any more than the Democrats have. Even in last month’s debate he admitted he only had “concepts of a plan” – and one of those “concepts” includes putting known conspiracy theorist RFK Jr. in charge of public health (as a medical doctor, I can assure you that RFK Jr. is _not_ an authority on public health). If Donald Trump or Kamala Harris want to see what a _real_ healthcare plan looks like, [**they’ll find lots of good ideas in ours**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/healthcare?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=trump_swamp&n=2)**. **[**And if YOU want a president with an actual, detailed plan for people, planet, and peace, then donate to our movement now for the final push. Every dollar you give helps us reach one more voter on the fence.**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=trump_swamp&n=3) --- | [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=trump_swamp&n=4 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=trump_swamp&n=4) --- It’s important that we don’t let any of our allies fall prey to Trump’s sloppy, self-serving lies. I’ve called out his corruption and incompetence for years. I will keep doing so until this public menace is driven out of power for good. --- [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=trump_swamp&n=5) --- The truth is that Donald Trump DOES have a plan – one that will enrich himself and exploit everyone else. Donald Trump was born into the establishment. He has skated through life on the privileges of the establishment. It comes as no surprise then, that as president Donald Trump ruled as a firm fixture of the establishment. He is a product of the society we built, and it won’t change until we build a NEW society rooted in justice, peace, and human thriving. _That’s_ what this campaign is about. That is the vision we must deliver on November 5th. In solidarity and gratitude, Jill --- | [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=trump_swamp&n=6 "Support Jill Today!") name: Team AOC
subject: We’re coming to you with an important ask before midnight:
body: # We’ll be straightforward with you: with just hours left until our end-of-October deadline, we’re coming to you with an important ask. **We’re going to lay out why a $5 contribution from you — especially before tonight’s deadline — would make a significant difference for our work together, but if you’re ready to chip in now, please make a contribution below to your personal link:** [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20241031-2?personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20241031-2.9teoeI&personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=em20241031-7496-P_FND_EOM_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7496%2E2526796%2EU-9VOm) Here’s the work your contribution is funding: * **Building resources to make local and community-focused impact:** From distributing thousands of backpacks across her district to make sure children started the school year off on the right foot, to raising funds for relief efforts across the country, to working to protect fellow progressives in Congress from opponents funded by special interests, Alexandria has always been laser-focused on improving the lives of working people. * **Standing up for accountability in Congress:** Alexandria is the #2 Democrat on the House Oversight Committee, where she will continue to call out contractors and corporations for their gross misuse of taxpayer money. But with right-wing extremists like Marjorie Taylor Greene on the same committee, Alexandria noted just how much harder holding these contractors accountable may become. Alexandria can’t do this work alone — she needs a movement alongside her. And when we’re able to post strong fundraising numbers, we're able to expand our movement, elect more progressive leaders, and **keep Alexandria in Congress fighting for us all.** **If you’re able, will you use your personal link below to make a $5 contribution before October ends?** [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20241031-2?personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20241031-2.9teoeI&personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=em20241031-7496-P_FND_EOM_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7496%2E2526796%2EU-9VOm) Together, there’s nothing we can’t accomplish. name: Dave McCormick
subject: More lies from the Left
body: Please read this full message [](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=380edb0b2d3a4e4fa8f333a59513bef3&_e=t09jTnzdbsmJQxGUAtZO1TjmTGcP5WEapZS-gZMDvSpFAmpbC1abTlTfTVs7crqOrpDJ1uXmrS0_1GQeCb_xz4qo9vW94FnxlrgLUi3kieEHdydRYUFoesnZrfCHQu_eMvWLD31C4w9QVm8DUeuNCDwW9RaNGQ8d6kti2zZYBEHchmzugyrSWjGLk5ZCl_bsCl-TFDEhP7VAlqFpnspKhbmviH_9FnsX-b0wfecD4dtIfgrXW7FHheiaQcvnIHwK2uj0LYlqn37Q3rOTp_mLeKCIT8NVF1lio1dgLEh6C52g_mNo-5joyhlr1HFn5JnlgIJMPaarQlKvNLSEiRNCye2jCxmxChnrM7o6CeMjP4mRRTxI-YtjFP0g-UoT-jXM-PxJkpa36NbhsZIVQ0LITD-PDI6Ga40P7A9_wyGtoHE%3D) Fellow Patriot, **At West Point, we had a code: cadets don't lie, cheat, steal, or tolerate those who do.** _First the New York Times lied about my childhood and family, and now CNN is lying about my business record._ And what's worse, they are doing it all because _I 'm within striking distance of an entrenched career politician, Bob Casey, in the #1 swing state in the nation that will determine control of the U.S Senate._ **Bob Casey is getting Leftist news sources to do his dirty work, and I WON 'T TOLERATE IT. Here's the truth: this is a long message and I hope you will read all the way to the end.** I grew up in Bloomsburg, Pennsylvania. We lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road. I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms. [](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=380edb0b2d3a4e4fa8f333a59513bef3&_e=t09jTnzdbsmJQxGUAtZO1TjmTGcP5WEapZS-gZMDvSpFAmpbC1abTlTfTVs7crqOrpDJ1uXmrS0_1GQeCb_xz4qo9vW94FnxlrgLUi3kieEHdydRYUFoesnZrfCHQu_eMvWLD31C4w9QVm8DUeuNCDwW9RaNGQ8d6kti2zZYBEHchmzugyrSWjGLk5ZCl_bsCl-TFDEhP7VAlqFpnspKhbmviH_9FnsX-b0wfecD4dtIfgrXW7FHheiaQcvnIHwK2uj0LYlqn37Q3rOTp_mLeGaX4RWLSjkwwiTlzL8sTeftGSFKQoNUl3hjybgXTe8ync3QNWqfPwdJ-4HRNIZhXi8cGDuRnLR0qm1cUkKET-ujhWjSJoynnhRaYI_mI-3md3lk59Mz6pQ8YDtu4be0kcZlWCyHSn6kQwqkdxjx1Bk%3D) [](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=380edb0b2d3a4e4fa8f333a59513bef3&_e=t09jTnzdbsmJQxGUAtZO1TjmTGcP5WEapZS-gZMDvSpFAmpbC1abTlTfTVs7crqOrpDJ1uXmrS0_1GQeCb_xz4qo9vW94FnxlrgLUi3kieEHdydRYUFoesnZrfCHQu_eMvWLD31C4w9QVm8DUeuNCDwW9RaNGQ8d6kti2zZYBEHchmzugyrSWjGLk5ZCl_bsCl-TFDEhP7VAlqFpnspKhbmviH_9FnsX-b0wfecD4dtIfgrXW7FHheiaQcvnIHwK2uj0LYlqn37Q3rOTp_mLeIKvzByOR7Ywo9RMAeErUwn-NF9H0ry-YG3jieWf13UjfCTBMxJ9R0LQU0IkaRt0-H_CZtbCRLaGiLxuZ9V4sydwvUKO_myh6Qothvx32xXO09NYm46m3BEvg8YXi-3dy8S_dawOSfh9NOk5qc1Y-JE%3D) My dad started his career teaching history, economics, & democracy at Punxsutawney High. My mom began teaching fourth through sixth graders at a public school near Pittsburgh. The energy at President Trump’s rally in Albuquerque today was palpable. I could feel it on stage while delivering my own remarks, and it was apparent to anyone who was there today **that something special is happening in New Mexico.** We’re on the cusp of flipping this state red and electing new leadership that will secure our border, lower our cost of living, get tough on crime, improve education, and unleash our abundant natural resources. **I need you to keep fighting every single day, every single moment, until the polls close on Tuesday.** Our campaign is working 24/7 to reach remaining undecided voters and get out the vote. We need to keep resources flowing into this campaign to ensure our funding for these operations doesn’t run dry. [**Your $5 or $10 contribution, in addition to your vote, is needed to help us secure more votes.**](http://links.nellanewmexico.com/u/click?_t=bec4f693b6284a4ba56cb04ba05e5b45&_m=af9aa05e713040ffa7be2288227a9e2b&_e=8caZ0_FOqcQhOAzAnzY1W4dVRQj5LuG9jp9KzuTVULrXfYIsIGNM2lGdzqiPYvb0krUZzczHWguWIG0orwF7Yh8IoYDqdpqZoXkASIrdy6BIJEEnZMBO2W5lfkc6DB_2G60ZKtqoTjA2H98UhHEQrltF7muCyQUZtOcQTDo01cO-xd0IeSBsvn_Ad0DIQfainpkYSc0v7WMBDZnEC9DPWHPZNxBZyZU5Er7rB8ZM65RWX7vmcW-MjqPcvfkO45zAu15RU4SU4WLqwkqo0rLU2f9ZpAF0ws4PUzT5lI8s304Cnb1y-zR-Z__xiXcEPGYgACDABpf_GZ8r0Dlal8j3mjue0cJ0Buoty374tqswDLaEotnm93PKK76MgSN-3SBmUrtM_rv0irrv_fgd_hu1OQ%3D%3D) Please chip in anything you can, and let’s win this thing! [ ** Let's Flip New Mexico RED! **](http://links.nellanewmexico.com/u/click?_t=bec4f693b6284a4ba56cb04ba05e5b45&_m=af9aa05e713040ffa7be2288227a9e2b&_e=8caZ0_FOqcQhOAzAnzY1W4dVRQj5LuG9jp9KzuTVULrXfYIsIGNM2lGdzqiPYvb0krUZzczHWguWIG0orwF7Yh8IoYDqdpqZoXkASIrdy6BIJEEnZMBO2W5lfkc6DB_2G60ZKtqoTjA2H98UhHEQrltF7muCyQUZtOcQTDo01cO-xd0IeSBsvn_Ad0DIQfainpkYSc0v7WMBDZnEC9DPWHPZNxBZyZU5Er7rB8ZM65RWX7vmcW-MjqPcvfkO45zAqbAS0QJ_Q0UK7-0UT7oMs0kQBIpR3TCaNsKmflqgIfqtNVb6-dXfMAwuM1feofH6AhHL8I5Q7eV2M-mW7bzNLjU-yf0ene41InqCwoDmOx8BDtLIgFCjVC_7Deg_9rV8seMJhAryNannnRKwZcc8PQ%3D%3D) Thank you, [](http://links.nellanewmexico.com/u/click?_t=bec4f693b6284a4ba56cb04ba05e5b45&_m=af9aa05e713040ffa7be2288227a9e2b&_e=8caZ0_FOqcQhOAzAnzY1W4dVRQj5LuG9jp9KzuTVULrXfYIsIGNM2lGdzqiPYvb0krUZzczHWguWIG0orwF7Yh8IoYDqdpqZoXkASIrdy6BIJEEnZMBO2W5lfkc6DB_2G60ZKtqoTjA2H98UhHEQrltF7muCyQUZtOcQTDo01cO-xd0IeSBsvn_Ad0DIQfainpkYSc0v7WMBDZnEC9DPWHPZNxBZyZU5Er7rB8ZM65RWX7vmcW-MjqPcvfkO45zAc7oYgP5DcW0O2on62n2wcjLRSocLSUIo4Bg2Nwx3cMMNYa7buJYx6OeTWb-YqAVEfi2v9ahwOiKF8Jzx86DKbyTYi-WL7nWLklxln0B6nGHWQ8kYNiM7u7n67H8GykH6dfsVZK8BaNbH2dtQT01vYg%3D%3D) **Nella Domenici** | **ABOUT NELLA** **New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. ** [ ** JOIN NELLA name: Diane Sare
subject: Friday Symposium: Celebrate the American Revolution!
body: | | [](https://www.sareforsenate.com/?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20241101_symposium&n=1) --- Friend -- Join our symposium dialogue this Friday night, which will discuss the 250th anniversary of the American Revolution. I will be joined in this dialogue by candidate Jose Vega and LaRouche Manhattan Project spokesman, Dennis Speed. What better way to wrap up the 2024 election than to discuss the goals of the American Revolution as our road map for the future! The formal beginning of the Revolution's 250th anniversary is April 19, 2025, in recognition of the "shot heard round the world" -- the Battles of Lexington and Concord of 1775. The celebration will continue through the July 4, 1776 signing of of the Declaration of Independence, the 1783 conclusion of the war of independence's eight years of sacrifice and determination, and the 1788 ratification of the American Constitution. The extraordinary success of the Revolution was a fulfillment of centuries of yearning for the liberation from oligarchy. There was a long history before the first shots were fired -- from Solon of Athens [c. 630 – c. 560 BC], through Nicholas of Cusa [1433, "consent of the governed"], through Gottfried Leibniz [1693 \-- "the entire natural law is derived from the human necessity to pursue happiness understood broadly as the obligation to grow in moral perfection"], and on. The Revolution was supported in its day by Schiller, Beethoven, Mozart, and Ben Franklin's international network of scientists. The disastrous wars and resulting economic hardship faced by Americans today show that the ideas of the British Empire have remained a corrupting and dominant influence in American policy. The revolution is not yet done. Join us Friday night to consider: What does it mean to "declare independence?" ### [New York Symposium, November 1 , 2024, 8:00 subject: From bad to worse

body: | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96284828/509536810/553882890?refcode=AU_VAH_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20241031_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDQxOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYTJhZDkyMy1mNTk3LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-1NjuIsqe8-VFMSwJKBEN8DG-hUoAgXZn47TwNmqPfo=&emci=928dd511-bb97-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=da2ad923-f597-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=9636579) --- | | Hi Peter, I wanted to reach out one last time before my campaign’s final end-of-month fundraising deadline of the election. Everything we’ve worked for during this election cycle comes down to these last five days. **[I’m counting on grassroots supporters like you to pitch in and help us close this race out strong.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96284830/509536813/563274594?refcode=AU_VAH_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20241031_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDQxOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYTJhZDkyMy1mNTk3LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-1NjuIsqe8-VFMSwJKBEN8DG-hUoAgXZn47TwNmqPfo=)** As a member of Congress, I’ve been laser-focused on delivering results that make a real difference in people's lives — fighting to protect Social Security and Medicare, restore and defend our freedoms, invest in Oregon’s infrastructure, and lower costs for working families. But National Republicans are dead-set on defeating me to grow their razor-thin House majority. They’ve invested a ton of resources into Oregon to replace me with my anti-abortion opponent, who would be nothing more than a rubber stamp for their extreme Project 2025 agenda. While they’re resorting to negative attack ads to mislead voters, my team is connecting with voters on the ground about the stakes and the clear choice they face in this election. body: I am ready to get to work on DAY ONE with Pres. Trump to secure our borders and fix what the left has broken. | [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=ea42f034c72f4e91970464b0519ccfdc&_e=6vzZDkXE7o6P9yMqC4sBD0sO17cH-woJ2B6t4HD9d6KUuAWca-MJSQEI-iRVyl2YLvW5co24a4b1QrHKxe-gUsr4dMrUCEpxDR6zWD_KLm4Bk3cwlfk4hNmp5i9leGAKkm1QiIqpzezFTJsUXjvMWmhzwdrF-rBiEzLruUMU-sJcxGKSA5CsLgHbTbP1hfXUpSx6neRAPlai3z-pSQWDY24NF6A3-6OSkCG3hoU3AE_K1rvL06uF0eceMSwT6htAJEii0nDnfjsFve-azj0zuvCKfiXc_i2466QoeGor1NdXXShAIdfoQIk1FeFZ_jwq3hvSfsbx4dTzB5UnNvzFgZ2pnMrLy5BE4yJOiAg1YT5Lr8PrFRTPYSgQ01tjyCTwhs_SFZ4OnBEY6Me_g8JstA%3D%3D) --- Peter, I was just boots on the ground at the border in New Mexico, once again assessing the situation and reminding voters just _how bad_ Kamala Harris and Martin Heinrich have allowed it to become. _Of course, “bad” is the understatement of the century._ Words and phrases like “horrifying,” “deadly,” and “worst in history” get closer to appropriate descriptions of what has happened under their watch. And it’s not like they just _allowed_ it to happen – **they curated this disaster!** There’s **NO WAY** we can allow Harris or Heinrich to continue failing us in Washington, D.C., and I need your help to defeat them and their radical agenda here in New Mexico. **I am ready to get to work on DAY ONE with Pres. Trump to secure our borders and fix what the left has broken.** We’re so close to the finish line, and I need your help to get across. [**Please rush $10 or more to help us keep fighting every minute all the way until the end, when we’ve flipped this seat, secured the Senate, and ensured we have the ability to get our country back on track.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=ea42f034c72f4e91970464b0519ccfdc&_e=6vzZDkXE7o6P9yMqC4sBD0sO17cH-woJ2B6t4HD9d6KUuAWca-MJSQEI-iRVyl2YLvW5co24a4b1QrHKxe-gUsr4dMrUCEpxDR6zWD_KLm4Bk3cwlfk4hNmp5i9leGAKkm1QiIqpzezFTJsUXjvMWmhzwdrF-rBiEzLruUMU-sJcxGKSA5CsLgHbTbP1hfXUpSx6neRAPlai3z-pSQWDY24NF6A3-6OSkCG3hoU3AE_K1rvL06uF0eceMSwT6htAu5jkg5d3a1fcmNhcu0YvshLTzhlC9LnyuzPf7RTGm4RHgz11KYxSAavUpA-a2Qrefj2So7euGBYTSTR709jUgWi3hG5llBEryDL-a1_HAeiNX7SHcsdGHZfbKqdq_qElUwkBXkq0eXiGdN90L6K4Iw%3D%3D) Thank you, **Nella Domenici** [ ** Help Elect Nella and Secure the Border » **](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=ea42f034c72f4e91970464b0519ccfdc&_e=6vzZDkXE7o6P9yMqC4sBD0sO17cH-woJ2B6t4HD9d6KUuAWca-MJSQEI-iRVyl2YLvW5co24a4b1QrHKxe-gUsr4dMrUCEpxDR6zWD_KLm4Bk3cwlfk4hNmp5i9leGAKkm1QiIqpzezFTJsUXjvMWmhzwdrF-rBiEzLruUMU-sJcxGKSA5CsLgHbTbP1hfXUpSx6neRAPlai3z-pSQWDY24NF6A3-6OSkCG3hoU3AE_K1rvL06uF0eceMSwT6htAHuTdau6JXGwDQQ5ZIfdrp3DwnjtlkJRwVAXJfNmtkjabSpayIFekapkBVAwa4-0Dt2F1CAYJOBK9ReyVQxUNgJaobvCpoJDvwUFzWLEUp2usLF-H0xrFntMyl0Bc8YBFqtrI017kouft3Phzuxty6g%3D%3D) | **ABOUT NELLA** **New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. ** [ ** JOIN NELLA name: Chairman Richard Hudson
subject: Taking a break to say THANK YOU
body: I'm working to defend our House Majority, but I needed to take a minute just for you ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  | --- | | | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z665drd3uakid9355f5op0sot2otkj4bvqua0ap8_rp22sh2s8i6epj0c5im8or2c9h2bs) --- Dear Friend, As we enter the final days before Election Day, I want to take a moment to reflect on the incredible journey we've shared. From the earliest days of this election cycle, you've been the driving force behind our efforts to grow the House Majority. As Chairman of the National Republican Congressional Committee, I've had the privilege of traveling the country, working with our candidates, and seeing your impact firsthand. Your generosity has allowed us to build a top-notch team, craft cutting-edge campaigns, and fight the Democrat machine. But I know that our success isn't just about House Republicans - **it's about the countless hours you've volunteered, your thoughtful survey responses, and the contributions you've given to fuel our movement. You're the unsung hero of our party, and I'm honored to stand alongside you in this fight.** Now, as we sprint to the finish line, I need your help one more time if you can spare a few dollars. **[We're facing a fierce battle in the final days of this election, and every dollar counts. That's why I'm humbly asking you to make a final contribution to help defend our razor-thin House Majority.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zr8p0tfgpek34b13te90u7jgdo63tubs44c0n0i8_rp22sh2s8i6epj0c5im8or2c9h2bs "We're facing a fierce battle in the final days of this election, and every dollar counts. That's why I'm humbly asking you to make a final contribution to help defend our razor-thin House Majority.")** Your donation will go directly towards our Get Out the Vote efforts, advertising, and other key pieces of our campaign operation. It will help us defend our vulnerable incumbents, _flip key seats, and elect a new generation of conservative leaders._ If you can swing it, one last contribution would mean the world to me, but if not, please don't stress, you've done so much for us already. body: BREAKING: A federal judge is now considering… ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  | [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=cd404ca5820d414f8ae86d0939716216&_e=iXmWUso2HNnL_pK8XYOJ0E_JwEca6XQvJIk0ZDJBF6LcxxlANo8yraIxHKIwAuYcMd-D67uEqVyjpxENG1pBcl_Hp0U1jqpZPmtMPfY8-wOIRMru5blnC6QICW7W_XFx158fXJUEzTX7GyXqHoK9GYrMWHXvsqEEKTdUO0eV0jhM8vIaivTVQ7QmwarzJxP6_eFzY4rGX398nRsGuHKgul37LU0ZS9rLVbgyD5LXDaubClpiFDwHhb4oRmgUHIUJID4vjY-WHJxRbjYUISlGK6GozR-9sN6iQn-ddgRmh5vADXw0MFwSdnfFyQfvW4t2xPObsgx-A6TW3JoHYxrrnSaggL91yY2PaZosEZV7x0umU3vmd11KxZubAcdSriyIxy_uNQ-U3qTacd2NvDj8pw%3D%3D) --- Dear Friend, --- On October 22, a federal judge decreed that I had 7 days to hand over my home in New York – as well as my only car and sentimental keepsakes and heartfelt gifts that I collected over the span of 80 years. --- _I thought that would be the end of the damage…_ --- But with the election right around the corner, Kamala’s Deep State _truly_ wants to ruin me with all they’ve got. They’re now considering dealing one final blow to me. --- **A judge may now order me to give up my _remaining_ home in Florida – __my primary residence.__** --- As my lawyer inquired: _**do they truly want me homeless?**_ --- Over the last few days, we’ve heard ridiculous claims about President Trump being a “fascist.” --- Let me tell you what fascism is… Fascism is weaponizing the legal system to punish your political opponents. Fascism is having your home taken from you. Fascism is taking the law license away from your opponent’s lawyer. Fascism is trying to turn your enemies into political prisoners. --- [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=cd404ca5820d414f8ae86d0939716216&_e=iXmWUso2HNnL_pK8XYOJ0E_JwEca6XQvJIk0ZDJBF6LcxxlANo8yraIxHKIwAuYcMd-D67uEqVyjpxENG1pBcl_Hp0U1jqpZPmtMPfY8-wOIRMru5blnC6QICW7W_XFx158fXJUEzTX7GyXqHoK9GYrMWHXvsqEEKTdUO0eV0jhM8vIaivTVQ7QmwarzJxP6_eFzY4rGX398nRsGuHKgul37LU0ZS9rLVbgyD5LXDaubClpiFDwHhb4oRmgUHIUJHCfIvO9RQ2S3E80r4WW-fatB5EhK-QyNHYWzuoaQhzANIrYUNd9-IjVzOQ8rD_LV0KplxBekTKevvvVV-lnUhD1DzYDijF-g2SkxwQ5VJEvlfGTOnZMRkug-aj97HozJqED2DqCugGjfUZ4JrIJUiA%3D%3D) __ --- _**I am _living through_ the Democrats’ fascism right now.** _ --- I sincerely pray that freedom, justice, and the truth prevail on Tuesday, November 5 – or the damage done to me will spread like wildfire to the rest of our great Republic. --- **But, as I wrote to you in an earlier letter, the Bible reminds us that our earthly possessions will always fade, but greater “heavenly treasures” await us.** --- _The pursuit of truth, freedom, and justice are worth infinitely more than a car or a home. Possessions come and go, but I could _NEVER SURRENDER_ my fight for freedom and for what I know to be _true.__ --- I would be tone deaf if I didn’t acknowledge that times are tough right now for _all_ Americans, not just me, so please stop reading here if you cannot give at this time. --- _But funding my Legal Defense Trust is my last remaining hope of fighting for my freedom and for the liberty and justice of all Americans._ --- [**So, if you can, and, seriously, only if you can, please make a contribution to my Legal Defense Trust – the Rudy Giuliani Freedom Fund – as I keep fighting for my They’re now considering dealing one final blow to me. --- **A judge may now order me to give up my _remaining_ home in Florida – __my primary residence.__** --- As my lawyer inquired: _**do they truly want me homeless?**_ --- Over the last few days, we’ve heard ridiculous claims about President Trump being a “fascist.” --- Let me tell you what fascism is… Fascism is weaponizing the legal system to punish your political opponents. Fascism is having your home taken from you. Fascism is taking the law license away from your opponent’s lawyer. Fascism is trying to turn your enemies into political prisoners. --- [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zv443nnurkebm9c13197qd9ac8v5t54tdqlckbl0_rp22sh2s8i6epj0c5imaoj6c5h2bs) __ --- _**I am _living through_ the Democrats’ fascism right now.** _ --- I sincerely pray that freedom, justice, and the truth prevail on Tuesday, November 5 – or the damage done to me will spread like wildfire to the rest of our great Republic. --- **But, as I wrote to you in an earlier letter, the Bible reminds us that our earthly possessions will always fade, but greater “heavenly treasures” await us.** --- _The pursuit of truth, freedom, and justice are worth infinitely more than a car or a home. Possessions come and go, but I could _NEVER SURRENDER_ my fight for freedom and for what I know to be _true.__ --- I would be tone deaf if I didn’t acknowledge that times are tough right now for _all_ name: Chairman Richard Hudson
subject: Taking a break to say THANK YOU
body: I'm working to defend our House Majority, but I needed to take a minute just for you ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  | --- | | | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zqmdsekp741ofv247h4dd76634f2049anrat4po8_rp22sh2s8i6epj0c5imeo34c5h2bs) --- Dear Friend, As we enter the final days before Election Day, I want to take a moment to reflect on the incredible journey we've shared. From the earliest days of this election cycle, you've been the driving force behind our efforts to grow the House Majority. As Chairman of the National Republican Congressional Committee, I've had the privilege of traveling the country, working with our candidates, and seeing your impact firsthand. Your generosity has allowed us to build a top-notch team, craft cutting-edge campaigns, and fight the Democrat machine. But I know that our success isn't just about House Republicans - **it's about the countless hours you've volunteered, your thoughtful survey responses, and the contributions you've given to fuel our movement. You're the unsung hero of our party, and I'm honored to stand alongside you in this fight.** Now, as we sprint to the finish line, I need your help one more time if you can spare a few dollars. **[We're facing a fierce battle in the final days of this election, and every dollar counts. That's why I'm humbly asking you to make a final contribution to help defend our razor-thin House Majority.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z0ucvjq0ftqfjkvngnpvm18q0hpel594ngfn8hv8_rp22sh2s8i6epj0c5imeo34c5h2bs "We're facing a fierce battle in the final days of this election, and every dollar counts. That's why I'm humbly asking you to make a final contribution to help defend our razor-thin House Majority.")** Your donation will go directly towards our Get Out the Vote efforts, advertising, and other key pieces of our campaign operation. It will help us defend our vulnerable incumbents, _flip key seats, and elect a new generation of conservative leaders._ If you can swing it, one last contribution would mean the world to me, but if not, please don't stress, you've done so much for us already. Thank you and God Bless America, **Richard Hudson ** _Chairman_ , National Republican Congressional Committee --- | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zfr4m2qd3chpn8qmlo0jrk7ru7vs15ams3me2q5g_rp22sh2s8i6epj0c5imeo34c5h2bs) --- | --- | Paid for by the NRCC and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. subject: Taking a break to say THANK YOU
body: I'm working to defend our House Majority, but I needed to take a minute just for you ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  | --- | | | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zkh90a3542lu1bkmr4jkgvdg3vs3749vmep6vvcg_rp22sh2s8i6epj0c5im1o71c1h2bs) --- Dear Friend, As we enter the final days before Election Day, I want to take a moment to reflect on the incredible journey we've shared. From the earliest days of this election cycle, you've been the driving force behind our efforts to grow the House Majority. As Chairman of the National Republican Congressional Committee, I've had the privilege of traveling the country, working with our candidates, and seeing your impact firsthand. Your generosity has allowed us to build a top-notch team, craft cutting-edge campaigns, and fight the Democrat machine. But I know that our success isn't just about House Republicans - **it's about the countless hours you've volunteered, your thoughtful survey responses, and the contributions you've given to fuel our movement. You're the unsung hero of our party, and I'm honored to stand alongside you in this fight.** Now, as we sprint to the finish line, I need your help one more time if you can spare a few dollars. **[We're facing a fierce battle in the final days of this election, and every dollar counts. That's why I'm humbly asking you to make a final contribution to help defend our razor-thin House Majority.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zql5qr43lrp4eg5r96ioac6600lufh4rfq6ll32g_rp22sh2s8i6epj0c5im1o71c1h2bs "We're facing a fierce battle in the final days of this election, and every dollar counts. That's why I'm humbly asking you to make a final contribution to help defend our razor-thin House Majority.")** Your donation will go directly towards our Get Out the Vote efforts, advertising, and other key pieces of our campaign operation. It will help us defend our vulnerable incumbents, _flip key seats, and elect a new generation of conservative leaders._ If you can swing it, one last contribution would mean the world to me, but if not, please don't stress, you've done so much for us already. Thank you and God Bless America, **Richard Hudson ** _Chairman_ , National Republican Congressional Committee --- | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zu03je7gc3rq53mf6uptk4edkrpqkhnvu8e7f5io_rp22sh2s8i6epj0c5im1o71c1h2bs) --- | --- | Paid for by the NRCC and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. And we're not just talking about the presidential race, but Elissa's Senate race as well. So as you read this, Republicans are throwing everything at Elissa but the kitchen sink, and even that is probably coming in these final days as well. You literally cannot turn on the television or get on the internet without seeing ridiculous attacks against Elissa. Fine enough. We're matching them with a positive message about Elissa's vision for the future. But here's our secret weapon: We know there are TENS OF THOUSANDS of Democrats who rarely vote in elections. We are doing the hard work of turning them out. Because there are more than enough of them that if we can – we are going to win. And so will a lot of other Democrats. name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: Uphill battle
body: [ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1001&akid=4398%2E35263%2ERUCvvc ]TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE I wish I had better news to share with you, Peter. My team just let me know that we came up short of our October fundraising goal last night. This was always going to be an uphill battle. We had to raise our goals multiple times throughout the month to keep up with the tens of millions of dollars Republicans continue to spend on brutal attack ads against me. Now, I won’t tell you that the sky is falling because we missed this goal. But I will tell you the truth, which is that we’re starting November with a significant gap in our budget. That’s a problem because if we need to cut back on our campaign ads or get-out-the-vote efforts this late in the race, Republicans could easily flip this battleground seat. Staying competitive in this toss-up race isn’t as easy for me as tapping into a multimillion-dollar personal fortune like my opponent can. Instead, I rely on folks like you who pitch in what you can, when you can, to help power our campaign. name: Ruben Gallego
subject: Thank you
body: I just wanted to take a moment — just a short moment — to thank you for your support last month and for being a part of this team. #                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 Peter, thank you. I just wanted to take a moment — just a short moment — to thank you for your support last month and for being a part of this team. Yesterday was the last monthly fundraising deadline of the campaign. Now, we’ve got four more days to do everything we can to win this election. It’s difficult to believe, honestly. I’ve said it before, but kids who grow up like I did don’t often make it to college, let alone to Congress, or the U.S. Senate. When we launched this campaign I wasn’t sure what to expect. I never would have thought that more than 400,000 people would chip in to help me out. But you did. From that kid who slept on the floor of our apartment, to the Marine in Al Anbar, Iraq, to today... I can’t tell you how humbled I am to have your support. But this isn’t over. [](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-nov24.6f99Bw&refcode=em241101-1-160&t=1&akid=3506%2E734936%2ErcjUlX) We have four days until the voting ends. Four days to keep up the pace and fight back against the millions being spent against us. Four days to turn the tide and retake the lead in this tied race. Four days to win, Peter. So I’m setting one more goal. **We have to raise $1.5 million to close up the gaps, cover the costs of these final days of outreach, and dramatically escalate our advertising through Election Day.** With Kari Lake, the “MAGA Queen,” the most prolific election denier in our country up against us, we’ve got work to do. [**Please. Will you make a $20.24 donation to my campaign? body: Take 30 seconds, review your information and let's win this election. subject: Our rights are on the line
body: | | | | --- | | | | | --- | _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb3e62f47-33c7-4620-8fb6-18b10ddd5a19/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._ --- | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td7088341-a8c6-4fea-85c1-7608192d8905/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Peter, media tracking groups have found that Donald Trump and his MAGA allies have spent more than $21 million to run ads that disparage the LGBTQ community. It’s clear that the GOP wants to stoke fear about LGBTQ+ Americans in hopes these anti-gay, anti-trans messages will win out with voters and implement a red wave on November 5. But we have to push back against their dangerous, baseless narratives. [Will you chip in $5 or more today to Blue Amp Action so we can support Democratic candidates who will protect LGBTQ+ rights and make sure that MAGA Republicans can’t use their power to harm marginalized groups?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4b7591eb-848b-4fec-b0fc-e9499374d2d7/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) --- | | [DONATE](https://default.salsalabs.org/T52966f4f-d767-4255-b2f7-a524e119f984/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) --- | **Republicans are going mask off about** their desire to see protections for LGBTQ+ people stripped away. Project 2025 – which will no doubt serve as the blueprint for a Trump presidency – calls for eliminating sexual orientation and gender identity as protected classes which leaves LGBTQ+ people without a legal safeguard from discrimination. [We can’t let far-right hardliners win on Tuesday and implement their dangerous Project 2025 agenda – but we’re running out of time to guarantee Democrats will win big and keep LGBTQ+ rights SAFE. So please, Peter, can we count on you to make a gift to Blue Amp Action today so we can invest in Democrats before it’s too late?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T720335cd-c633-4274-8f05-40118917746b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) --- | --- | | | | | | [DONATE](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5da1e659-b1f5-404a-acec-5a2c831ef098/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) --- | Thank you. \- Blue Amp Action --- | --- | | | --- | --- | | | --- | | | | | --- | | | | Cliff Schecter President, Blue Amp Action Amplify Good ---|--- | | | --- | | Follow Us | [](https://twitter.com/intent/follow?screen_name=cliffschecter) | [](https://linkedin.com/in/cliffschecter-0873a448/) ---|--- | **Blue Amp Action PAC** PO Box 8384, Cincinnati, OH 45208 --- | Having trouble viewing this email? Right-wing authoritarianism, defeated by a worldwide coalition during WWII, was only in hibernation. Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! people are fully represented in positions of power to create the policies necessary to progress our communities forward. Since our inception in 2016, we have helped 500 candidates win general elections at the local, state and federal levels. We strive to support the next wave of progressive and unapologetic Black candidates who will usher in a sea of change in our political system while helping America fulfill its promise of democracy by name: Kevin Lincoln
subject: Worried you’re sleeping on this
body: Our borders won’t be secured, inflation won’t go down, communities won’t get safer, and government overreach won’t be reeled in. | [](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=31778850267247cb88ebed713a1b62e3&_e=9RgTBhhivqdbFoUgNFYadWyFFBPK7udJ0RDdEs1wIY380TO9RxJvjRjcAv6lwMJL9w_IlNGs782SPDK3wSyQHU2mS59OKELNbX19y0D92VD99mYmYydecCRS6GJ1gRlIHigjpEztR_QWHs9fTdVtisuq-cOtXFdHFtWQtW9VnjNpwcrZz5SpP2498Tlt_LYBsPkXmP0BpW1WsMyvsQhaCkAeULv9G9o0Nj5u3SdoWVD3B-kIkfYsYzAmuzsNLT03VibqkNKUjWs1dP4euOEQdR1JgcWUlfCZdfOIPW2uv2y2R_xjVwQSPtmAEouQ0ERBV43nezSbxCnLZg_E5jPIs59jxLxbgdEFQgbSWuG1cj7XNUC33SMZVIEQ003EDBA-8VWbNSM1ffUAtMNBD30ypIj7H0V-fwecwtYNtKRRnq_hoNA-jkA2XEufriSwMZkQ) I’m worried you’re sleeping on this, fellow American. Democrats have been leading in the Generic Congressional Ballot for three months now, meaning more Americans would rather send a Democrat to represent them in Congress than a Republican. We can take back the White House and the Senate, but if we lose the House – which we only hold by a handful of seats – **we can’t get anything done.** _Our borders won’t be secured, inflation won’t go down, communities won’t get safer, and government overreach won’t be reeled in_. [**That’s why your support for Republican victories in target battleground seats is so critical.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=31778850267247cb88ebed713a1b62e3&_e=9RgTBhhivqdbFoUgNFYadWyFFBPK7udJ0RDdEs1wIY380TO9RxJvjRjcAv6lwMJL9w_IlNGs782SPDK3wSyQHU2mS59OKELNbX19y0D92VD99mYmYydecCRS6GJ1gRlIHigjpEztR_QWHs9fTdVtisuq-cOtXFdHFtWQtW9VnjNpwcrZz5SpP2498Tlt_LYBsPkXmP0BpW1WsMyvsQhaCkAeULv9G9o0Nj5u3SdoWVD3B-kIkfYsYzAmuzsNLT03VibqkNKUjWs1dP4euOEQdR1JgcWUlfCZdfOIPW2uv2zqqxpECBkl-AoNNwbf-zGYV_i3nqicmcylYzvud7J2y4IJOtIPHN-cOw9C-5U4zB27-XqBPyf-Kb8JtrAdTSknhRXawfpttjWiixzxKFpyXmW-0JW9Xam5UBi71wXH6-MsQju_jUbslG2ks2SwhHh4) We can’t miss out on real chances to flip vulnerable Democrat-held seats **like this one in CA-9.** [ ** SEND A MARINE TO CONGRESS ➞ **](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=31778850267247cb88ebed713a1b62e3&_e=9RgTBhhivqdbFoUgNFYadWyFFBPK7udJ0RDdEs1wIY380TO9RxJvjRjcAv6lwMJL9w_IlNGs782SPDK3wSyQHU2mS59OKELNbX19y0D92VD99mYmYydecCRS6GJ1gRlIHigjpEztR_QWHs9fTdVtisuq-cOtXFdHFtWQtW9VnjNpwcrZz5SpP2498Tlt_LYBsPkXmP0BpW1WsMyvsQhaCkAeULv9G9o0Nj5u3SdoWVD3B-kIkfYsYzAmuzsNLT03VibqkNKUjWs1dP4euOEQdR1JgcWUlfCZdfOIPW2uv2wBZ4m10ODpjI42gmKFkSLidEN87V94BeqjwWX_GhvbKQaNvGojR8vFnGvmonVEJEpEGs0KXflZRt6hsUUpA8oT2jClGM67dFrAxZogjVosQ5xA8UbafHFpFIxJsP-3zzMKI_AYUBxqPVLJup5mrk14) I’m fighting tooth and nail down the home stretch, [**and I need your help to close the deal.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=31778850267247cb88ebed713a1b62e3&_e=9RgTBhhivqdbFoUgNFYadWyFFBPK7udJ0RDdEs1wIY380TO9RxJvjRjcAv6lwMJL9w_IlNGs782SPDK3wSyQHU2mS59OKELNbX19y0D92VD99mYmYydecCRS6GJ1gRlIHigjpEztR_QWHs9fTdVtisuq-cOtXFdHFtWQtW9VnjNpwcrZz5SpP2498Tlt_LYBsPkXmP0BpW1WsMyvsQhaCkAeULv9G9o0Nj5u3SdoWVD3B-kIkfYsYzAmuzsNLT03VibqkNKUjWs1dP4euOEQdR1JgcWUlfCZdfOIPW2uv2yHAn29d5xN88TryTHCbH2OFsSn2voM5hNhZrofDUFj0Uh1XuLmWvphtqeuZ9a4YcoP7Fw5AoWcF33WxqFx2muR114ngq9p69G1MtPXSbKOVTQo0sCH5D_yzHxI4WMgAemcnFpugaTu-ia36oqemYtj) name: Barbra Streisand
subject: No one has ever regretted getting off the sidelines
body: #                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 [](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-nov24-casey.Z22WRp&refcode=em2401101-1-30&refcode2=9348.3935704.lsUzAV&t=1&akid=9348%2E3935704%2ElsUzAV) --- I’m an actress, director, singer, longtime activist, and, above all, a citizen of our great democracy. And as a citizen with a platform larger than most, I believe it is not only my right but also my duty to express my concerns. So here goes: **I’m concerned by what I’m seeing in Pennsylvania and national Republicans’ ruthless efforts to unseat Bob Casey and flip this battleground red.** If the GOP succeeds in flipping Pennsylvania red, they’ll almost certainly regain control of both the Senate and the White House, threatening everything from voting rights to women’s rights to the fight against climate change. That’s why outside interest groups have started spending upwards of $150 million to defeat Bob. The stakes this November are higher than ever before. [**So before I go on, can you please split a donation between Bob’s re-election campaign and GIFFORDS PAC?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-nov24-casey.Z22WRp&refcode=em2401101-1-30&t=2&akid=9348%2E3935704%2ElsUzAV) **[DONATE NOW >>](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-nov24-casey.Z22WRp&refcode=em2401101-1-30&t=3&akid=9348%2E3935704%2ElsUzAV)** I’m committed to electing lawmakers like Bob Casey, who believes that everyone deserves a fair shot at getting ahead and staying ahead. Bob’s opponent on the other hand is a Connecticut mega-millionaire who will do and say anything to help his own bottom line. With the most extreme Republican party of my lifetime teetering on the edge of regaining power, we need all hands on deck. committee: Jocelyn Benson for Secretary of State
name: Jocelyn Benson
subject: Checking in on your plan
body: With less than five days left, I’m checking in on your plans to vote. Friend, I can count the days left on one hand! I’ve been driving around the state, checking in on operations county by county. Tuesday’s somewhat of a Super Bowl for secretaries of state like me. I couldn’t be more excited to see Michiganders make their voices heard. **This will be the smoothest, safest, and most secure election in Michigan history. ** Free and Fair Elections Improvements Under Sec. Jocelyn Benson **🖥️ Modernized Voter Registration:** Implemented online and automatic voter registration, plus same-day registration on Election Day. **👥 Recruited 30,000 New Election Workers:** A new generation of poll workers is ready to assist you at the polls. **📮 Installed Secure Drop Boxes:** Over 1,000 secure drop boxes are available statewide for convenient and safe ballot returns. **🏠 Enabled Voting from Home:** Every voter has the right to vote by absentee ballot, making it easy to vote from the comfort of your home. **✉️ Mailed Absentee Ballot Applications:** We sent absentee ballot applications to all registered voters to remind them of voting options. **🌐 Launched Online Absentee Applications:** You can easily download and submit absentee ballot applications online. **📣 Engaged Underrepresented Voters:** We've launched programs to increase voter participation in areas with historically low turnout. **🔍 Conducted Comprehensive Election Audits:** We've worked diligently to affirm the integrity and accuracy of our elections. --- I’m so proud of all we’ve accomplished together since my election in 2018. But this coming Tuesday isn’t about me or the Secretary of State’s office. It’s about you! Now, I want you to take a moment to think about your vote in this election. **Already voted?** Think of three friends or family members. Send them a quick text and ask, “Have you voted already? If not, do you have a plan to vote?” You can always refer them to IWillVote.com if they need help. **Haven’t voted yet?** Take just two minutes to write down your plan. When are you voting? Do you know how you’re getting there? And, do you know where to go? **[Learn more »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96316859/509618280/-1612268846?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5Nzk4NWIwZS01ZTk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eV4gTuAv9LUgugMLAorKFGVt4mv4suIcinb6IFpZl0Q=&emci=1cc24ad7-aa97-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=97985b0e-5e98-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=9636631)** Your voice matters, and your participation is what makes our democracy strong. Together, we can ensure that every vote is counted and every voice is heard. Democracy is a beautiful thing—thank you for being a part of it. body: [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/coordcampaign.png] Dear Peter- we're SO CLOSE! The finish line of this election is just around the corner, and now is NOT the time to let up! Just take it from our Coordinated team. Last week they: * Knocked 10,000 doors * Made 100,000 phone calls * And in the month of October they sent over 2 MILLION TEXTS! Our incredible staff and volunteers are doing everything they can up until the moment the last polls close- and they need your help to finish strong. There are countless volunteer opportunities across Massachusetts as well as out of state in the last few days of this election. Our Coordinated team has just one ask for you: please take a look at this list [https://docs.google.com/document/d/10p55SReGb9MCbD1v7p8fzNIc2JaEigaq4vARo163azM/edit?tab=t.0] and find a volunteer opportunity that works for you- and then take the plunge! While you're at it, spread the word to friends and family, and help them make a plan to volunteer. FIVE DAYS TO GO! BE A PART OF HISTORY! [https://docs.google.com/document/d/10p55SReGb9MCbD1v7p8fzNIc2JaEigaq4vARo163azM/edit?tab=t.0] We're so grateful to all of the incredible people reading this who have given their time to help out this campaign, and we're so excited to see everyone else at their first volunteer shift in these next five days. When we fight, we win! So I wanted to take a few minutes to tell you about my decision to run for president – and why your support for the DLCC and my campaign is so important to our success on Election Day in four days. Before I continue, if you’re short on time, will you split a donation between the DLCC and my campaign at my personal link below? [https://dlcc.org/dlcc-hfp](https://an.dlcc.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvLlvOtFHcHSW1T-Hwi1Or_qAhxADN84Z4n8sRDvVCFw5k5dcqsb4FNz7b2sSLTDVPUeYil06k1twKUI8bebKbUA5K8cBClIxic4of3DGMjEuzTV1xtf_v4gQiyuy8aMhZ4Ue7kuxaOw9_BCSSe2TRsQqgkD9Yw9AKaBQ_TXEHimsI1nSmXm-YDxJrzPRPCIJcwM_2N718CmNOqdBaqNdCKGz7HaSHPFFr7ofGwsdkzadPhyY2BCxd8BUXuk8B40JmhS3ZargfE_9TseF98jh3MQJCcsBfWW2sqJFtKM6MpGb0NczVIHQRRi8PatFSL6qXLNfciR2ZHmoOHIdCLAmqPcHw_flzyshLgpJIdirA3TrGNExCUPwLmRfX7uZFn8nFW8DG3yzxvweYfJP7takRYycfn_DuDXhuwi2hcvz3T-1E2qXgViB79sCeEPlsEtqw3YqPR-8vxIIyqey3OMjeJRNhLPOyTnpeQfX1v_C8ocg/4b3/JmlnAhwITM-SWnHwopOTlQ/h1/h001.OFsJjtvbRYGve93nqIaysT8saOwYUQQsuIRVgAA0_44) **The truth is: I am no stranger to unlikely journeys.** Where I grew up in the Bay, you either live in the hills or the flatlands. We lived in the flats. It was a working-class neighborhood of firefighters, nurses, and construction workers. I grew up immersed in the ideals of the civil rights movement, and at a young age I decided I wanted to be a lawyer. I wanted to protect people because I believe everyone has a right to safety, dignity, and justice. Today, my decision to run for president has everything to do with this opportunity to move past the bitterness, cynicism, and divisive battles of the past. We have the chance to chart a new way forward – not as members of any one party or faction, but as Americans. I want you to know that I will be a president who unites us around our highest aspirations. A president who leads and listens, who is realistic, practical, and has common sense. A president who always fights for the American people. I cannot do it alone. No one person could. It takes a team. It takes millions and millions of people coming together at once to shape the outcome of this election and elect Democrats up and down the ballot. If we are going to win this election and elect Democrats in swing districts across our country, I need you to step up and join this team. Millions of Americans have already voted, and millions more will vote on Election Day. And we need to do everything we can – and I mean everything – to reach every last voter to win the White House and elect Democrats to state legislatures across the country. **So, with time running out to make an impact before Election Day, I am asking for your support one last time:** [Will you help us get out the vote over these final days by splitting $10, or whatever you can afford, between the DLCC and my campaign before our midnight deadline? Every dollar will help us reach more voters and elect Democrats in key swing districts before the polls close on Election Day. subject: Fox News attacked my family
body: The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous Dobbs decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96321107/509630752/872526041?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YjNhNzdmOS02MTk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=m8zECREV6VOuHtLI8Fs64TB0MKdmxAxe7y2F40Z1jrM=&emci=8662d771-4397-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=4b3a77f9-6198-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=19445147) [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96321108/509630754/872526041?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YjNhNzdmOS02MTk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=m8zECREV6VOuHtLI8Fs64TB0MKdmxAxe7y2F40Z1jrM=&emci=8662d771-4397-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=4b3a77f9-6198-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=19445147) Hello, The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous _Dobbs_ decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father. For decades, Dad was an OB-GYN. He delivered thousands of babies and wrote books on how to get pregnant and to navigate menopause. Dad provided women with full access to all kinds of reproductive health care, including abortions, in the years right after _Roe_ – and he has now had to watch as women’s reproductive rights are gutted in the aftermath of _Dobbs_. Dad and his clinic faced many threats over the years. It’s no exaggeration to say that he put his own safety – and that of his family – at risk in order to protect the rights of women to make their own medical decisions. But I’m not sure he ever expected to see a sitting member of Congress attacking him – or my sister who followed in his footsteps – in a national news outlet. **It’s disgusting. These kinds of personal attacks against my family have no place in our politics and do nothing to serve the people of Western and Southern Colorado.** If extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want to have a conversation about reproductive rights in this country, I am more than happy to have that debate. We can talk about how I support _freedom_ and _liberty_ – and how they support big government intruding into the lives of women. We can talk about how they support a national ban on abortion – with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. And we can talk about how they are so extreme, they even want to ban the pill that’s been used by women for decades. I am willing to talk all day about the fringe view that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions. **But what I won’t accept is extremists like Lauren Boebert and Fox News attacking my father and my sister.** I am _incredibly_ proud of my father. He provided health care to women when they needed it during some of the happiest – and most devastating – moments of their lives. Before retirement, he would drive two hours to Planned Parenthood and help teach the next generation of health care providers, like my sister. And no one – not Fox News, and especially not extremists like Lauren Boebert or my new Republican opponent – is going to stop my family from continuing to stand up for a woman’s right to choose. **We already scared off Lauren Boebert. In 2022, I came just 546 votes shy of winning this House seat. I’m ready to finish the job and replace Boebert in Congress, but these are the kinds of ugly attacks that I’m up against.** [**Please, if you can afford to, will you give $5 or more right now to my campaign to help me win this critical House seat? Our race was the closest in the entire country in 2022. But I’m not taking money from corporate PACs, so I’m counting on grassroots donors like you if I’m going to win.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96321109/509630756/1610638071?refcode=em20241101am2-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=4b3a77f9-6198-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YjNhNzdmOS02MTk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=m8zECREV6VOuHtLI8Fs64TB0MKdmxAxe7y2F40Z1jrM=) name: Ken Mitchell for Virginia
subject: T-Minus 4️⃣ Days
body: | | | | | --- | | | | --- | Four days. Four days are all that stand between us and victory for the sixth congressional district. After months of hard work, thousands of miles traveled, and hundreds of events we can see the finish line. But we cannot give up yet – we have so much more ground to cover as things really heat up—[**and we need your support to make it happen!**](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=5f69d40477&e=0fced71d8c) --- | **We need to raise another $10,000 between now and Election Day.** We have the opportunity to bolster our TV advertising during prime NFL and ACC football games. **More than 50% of our congressional district still has not voted.** We need to do everything to make sure voters know they have a better choice. We are running a true grassroots campaign all thanks to your generosity, time, and dedication. We wouldn’t be where we are at without your help. --- | Together, we are fighting for a better future for our community and nation. To ensure that our message reaches every corner of our congressional district, we’ve launched our billboard campaign, are releasing TV ads, and have been running radio ads left and right. --- | Our opponent doesn’t have what it takes to represent the people of the sixth congressional district. He is a proud Trump MAGA loyalist. My focus is revitalizing the economy, creating jobs, and ensuring fair wages and protecting workers. I support women’s right to choose, workers and their right to collectively bargain, increased funding for public schools, expanded and optimized broadband, equitable access to technology, and respect for personal privacy and healthcare choices. I am committed to transitioning to renewable energy, tackling climate change, and advocating for a diplomatic resolution to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. My platform offers practical solutions and progressive leadership for a brighter future in Virginia’s vast, beautiful sixth congressional district. --- | Do you know what my opponent brings to the table? --- | ❌ Voted against the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act❌ Voted against the Infant Formula Supplemental Appropriations Act❌ Voted against the American Rescue Plan❌ Voted against the Affordable Insulin Now Act❌ Voted against the PAWS Act❌ Voted against the Ending Forced Arbitration of Sexual Assault and Sexual Harassment Act❌ Voted against the Pregnant Workers Fairness Act❌ Voted against the Protecting Older Workers from Discrimination Act❌ Voted against the Lower Drug Costs Now Act❌ Voted against the Equality Act --- | As you can imagine, the list goes on and doesn’t get any better. My opponent proudly stands with a convicted felon, Marjorie Taylor Greene, Matt Gaetz, and Speaker Mike Johnson. The sixth congressional district deserves so much better. --- [Donate Now!](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=7baa458cad&e=0fced71d8c) | So, to make it to the finish line, we need your help. **Every dollar counts** , and with your generous support, we can make sure that our campaign is visible and impactful. Click the link below to contribute and be a part of this vital effort: [**CLICK HERE TO DONATE NOW!**](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=d2ecd3a604&e=0fced71d8c)[ ](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=aed02f77b2&e=0fced71d8c) Thank you for your continued support towards our shared vision for the future. Together, we can make sure our message is seen, heard, and acted upon! --- | [**Can you donate $50, $100, or $250 dollars to help us defeat Ben Cline and reach more voters?**](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=9101114af9&e=0fced71d8c) We should be in this fight together. Not pandering to party loyalists and being bought by large corporations. If we don’t get back to pragmatic problem solving, mutual respect, and putting country before party, our democracy will not survive. We can do better. Join me in defeating Ben Cline and bringing real representation to the sixth congressional district. **—Ken Mitchell, Democratic Candidate for Virginia’s 6th Congressional District** --- [Donate Now!](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=8184611830&e=0fced71d8c) | | | | | | | | **Authorized and Paid for by Ken Mitchell for Virginia** PO Box 1795 Harrisonburg, VA 22803[Facebook](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=69c27b9951&e=0fced71d8c) --- | --- | This email was sent to [dpwillis67@gmail.com](mailto:dpwillis67@gmail.com) [_why did I get this?_](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/about?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=548b15aa7d&e=0fced71d8c&c=5385752ac3) [unsubscribe from this list](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=548b15aa7d&t=b&e=0fced71d8c&c=5385752ac3) [update subscription preferences](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/profile?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=548b15aa7d&e=0fced71d8c&c=5385752ac3) Ken Mitchell for Virginia * 850 W Market Street * Harrisonburg, VA 22801 * USA ---

body: If you haven’t voted yet, I need your vote to change what’s happening in our country. | | | | | [](https://ackramerforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0681592302c29e74ce410ea82&id=761e0a7fe5&e=d9ccafcb33) --- | | | | | Dear Peter, --- | If you haven’t voted yet, I need your vote to change what’s happening in our country. Below is how my opponent voted in his first term in Congress and in the State Legislature. If you don’t vote, that means you agree with my opponent. If you disagree, then go vote. --- [](https://ackramerforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0681592302c29e74ce410ea82&id=5fe7dd9adc&e=d9ccafcb33) | We need common sense in Washington and we need to enforce our laws. Instead of focusing on gender and divisive issues, we need to protect Americans with public safety and build a strong economy. I have a business background, an Economics major with an MBA. I want to bring back the America I immigrated to: where Americans respected one another and was respected by other countries. We can be proud Americans when our country is strong and united. name: Jon Favreau
subject: We need to do everything we can to make sure Bob wins
body: Jon Favreau here. If you’re way too online like me, you’ve probably seen a ton of headlines about a bunch of rich guys running for Senate in states where they don't even live. Connecticut mega-millionaire David McCormick is one of those rich guys, and he’s running against beloved Pennsylvania Senator, Bob Casey. So look, this will be a _very_ close race, and we need to do everything we can to make sure Bob wins — [**which is why I’m asking if you’ll contribute $5 towards his campaign today.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241101-2?refcode=em20241101-2&refcode2=4745_552475_IPLfG2&akid=4745%2E552475%2EIPLfG2) David McCormick is a former Wall Street hedge-fund exec who wants you to think he grew up on a Pennsylvania farm, which is only true if you think that living in a mansion 10 minutes down the road from a farm where your family raised Arabian horses counts as “growing up on a farm.” But wait, Peter, there's more: McCormick also thinks the most popular beer in Pennsylvania is called “YANG-ling,” which is like running for Senate in Massachusetts and saying you want coffee from "DOON-kin’ Donuts." **If it wasn’t obvious before, it’s crystal clear now: David McCormick is wrong for Pennsylvania.** But this will be one of the toughest races of the year for Democrats. McCormick has millions upon millions of dollars of his own to dump into this race, in addition to the backing of Donald Trump and billionaire-funded super PACs. **Pennsylvania is as competitive as it gets, and with the Senate majority and the White House depending on it, we can’t take anything for granted.** [**So please, will you chip in whatever you can to Bob’s campaign today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241101-2?refcode=em20241101-2&refcode2=4745_552475_IPLfG2&akid=4745%2E552475%2EIPLfG2) [Donate $15 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241101-2?amount=15&refcode=em20241101-2-el&refcode2=4745_552475_IPLfG2&akid=4745%2E552475%2EIPLfG2) [Donate $25 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241101-2?amount=25&refcode=em20241101-2-el&refcode2=4745_552475_IPLfG2&akid=4745%2E552475%2EIPLfG2) [Donate $50 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241101-2?amount=50&refcode=em20241101-2-el&refcode2=4745_552475_IPLfG2&akid=4745%2E552475%2EIPLfG2) [Donate $100 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241101-2?amount=100&refcode=em20241101-2-el&refcode2=4745_552475_IPLfG2&akid=4745%2E552475%2EIPLfG2) [Donate $250 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241101-2?amount=250&refcode=em20241101-2-el&refcode2=4745_552475_IPLfG2&akid=4745%2E552475%2EIPLfG2) [Other amount »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241101-2?refcode=em20241101-2&refcode2=4745_552475_IPLfG2&akid=4745%2E552475%2EIPLfG2) --- Thanks, Jon [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241101-2?refcode=em20241101-2&refcode2=4745_552475_IPLfG2&akid=4745%2E552475%2EIPLfG2) Jon Favreau Co-host of Pod Save America Former Speechwriter to President Obama * * * This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. subject: The very soul of America
body: | | | My fellow Americans, you've heard me say it before -- and I really mean it: **We're in a battle for the very soul of America.** As my friend Vice President Kamala Harris works to defeat Donald Trump and keep our future strong, we need to have her back. But that goes beyond just winning the White House -- we've got to win the Senate too. **[Will you donate $5 or whatever you can to ensure we keep the Senate out of Donald Trump's grasp? We _must_ keep America on track, but we'll only get there together >>](https://go.dscc.org/go/20088?amount=5&t=3&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20241101-JoeBiden-BidenNovemberFR-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20241101-JoeBiden-BidenNovemberFR-Pros-sl1&akid=18595%2E9716520%2EeWziNE)** Here's the deal: I proudly represented Delaware in the United States Senate for over 30 years, and it taught me a lot. body: How did we get here? | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96329042/509648537/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQzYWQxZDVmLTY4OTgtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=j-aEe00NPebGugJowhMq4xODHW7xgDgqnc-VApfGnwc=&emci=97450681-5898-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=d3ad1d5f-6898-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=8431045) ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Peter, As Attorney General Eric Holder put it, North Carolina is **“one of the most egregiously gerrymandered states in the country.”** **Let’s talk about how we got here and how we’re fighting back right now — as we work to win a North Carolina election that’s flying under the national radar.** In October of last year, Republicans in the state legislature manipulated the maps to gain unearned power. And state supreme court justices acted as ideologues instead of neutral arbiters of the law — reversing the court’s own very recent precedent and allowing those maps to move forward. Shockingly, the current gerrymandered maps allow Republicans to hold supermajorities in the legislature _even if_ Democrats win statewide elections. And it’s important to remember that even if Democrats hold the governor’s seat this year, a Republican supermajority in the legislature can override his veto. You’ve probably heard a lot about the governor’s race in North Carolina this election, even if you don’t live there. But here’s the critical North Carolina race not enough people are talking about: A state supreme court candidate has openly said he wants a Republican majority on the court for the upcoming redistricting cycle. He praised North Carolina’s extreme congressional gerrymander. And he joined a deeply controversial ruling that would have established precedent for so-called personhood laws in North Carolina — the foundation for restricting abortion and banning IVF. [**We are working to defeat candidates like him in races across the country. Peter, step up with a donation to help ensure the NDRC can do everything we can between today and November 5th to elect Democracy Defenders in battleground The election happening in just a few days will help shape the future of fair maps for North Carolinians. We’ve proudly endorsed Justice Allison Riggs for the North Carolina Supreme Court because she has proven to be a fair-minded and independent voice on the court. She is a tenacious civil rights attorney who has been a champion of every American’s fundamental rights, including voting rights.
