name: Eric Swalwell
subject: thanks, friend
body: Democrat Eric Swalwell represents California's 14th Congressional District. https://ericswalwell.com/ [https://ericswalwell.com/] Friend — November??? Wow. It's been one hell of a ride. I genuinely couldn't have done this work without your support. Thank you for your never-ending dedication, passion, and support over these past few weeks. We're now literally DAYS away from the election. The work we've put in together — you've put in — will decide whether or not we can put an end to the MAGA circus that's taken over Washington. It's not easy fighting a bunch of far-right extremists day in and day out. The MAGA agenda is dangerous — which is why our work is so important. I'm glad to say that we've made it through October. subject: Second Chance - Free Viewing of Zurawski v Texas
body: I HIGHLY recommend you watch this documentary this weekend. | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/987033b5a265/amanda-zurawski-vs-texas-12709419?e=ebba716312) --- [](https://theresa4texas.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be937c1781d002a370f5841dc&id=f2f9fd9bf5&e=ebba716312) | | | | | Hi Friend, ### If you didn't get a chance to watch the documentary, Zurawski v Texas, I HIGHLY recommend you watch it this weekend. ### The Center for Reproductive Rights sums it up: "In the new documentary feature film Zurawski v Texas, independent filmmakers Maisie Crow and Abbie Perrault show the stark and terrifying reality of what it means to be pregnant in a U.S. state that has banned abortion—and the bravery, grit and determination that it takes to speak out. Crow and Perrault followed three Texas women who were denied medically necessary abortion care—Amanda Zurawski, Samantha Casiano, and Dr. Austin Dennard—as they brought their stories and battled their case up to the Texas Supreme Court, with the help of the Center for Reproductive Rights’ Senior Staff Attorney Molly Duane." --- [Watch Zurawski v Texas for free Nov 2 and 3 here](https://theresa4texas.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be937c1781d002a370f5841dc&id=d185adb41d&e=ebba716312) | | | | | | | | | | | ### If you are able to give, I am sure the Center for Reproductive Rights could use your donation. --- [Donate the the Center for Reproductive Rights here](https://theresa4texas.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be937c1781d002a370f5841dc&id=77e9f00e46&e=ebba716312) | | | | | | | | | | | They have cases across the country and could use our support while they fight against the extreme abortion bans that put women's lives in jeopardy. ### If you haven't voted yet, today is the last day of early voting and Tuesday is Election Day. Last night, we fell $4,701 short of our $25,000 end-of-October fundraising goal — and my opponent is certainly taking notice. We’re running out of time. Election Day is now 4 days away, and without having met our goal, our critical voter outreach campaign is going underfunded. The good news: We can come back from this — but only together, and only if we do it QUICKLY. If all of my top supporters stand up with just $, we’ll have more than enough to not only reach, but exceed our goal and give our team the resources they need to get out the vote in these final days. I’m counting on your support. Will you pitch in $ today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ruiz-em-fr-nov24?amount=] DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ruiz-em-fr-nov24?amount=] Thank you for your commitment to our cause. — Raul https://www.facebook.com/DrRaulRuiz/ [https://www.facebook.com/DrRaulRuiz/] https://www.instagram.com/doctorraulruiz [https://www.instagram.com/doctorraulruiz] https://twitter.com/Dr_RaulRuiz [https://twitter.com/Dr_RaulRuiz] https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ruiz-em-fr-footer [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ruiz-em-fr-footer] The son of hardworking farmworkers, Dr. Ruiz grew up in Coachella, CA and learned at an early age that the key to attaining the American Dream is hard work and a great education. In the summer of 1990, Raul walked in the desert heat from business to business in the Coachella Valley asking them to invest in their community by contributing to his education. With each investment for college, he made a promise to come back home and serve his community as a physician. In 2012, he decided to take his service to the community to the next level by running for Congress. Dr. Ruiz needs our help to continue fighting for us in Congress and to flip the House blue this November. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without subject: Asking you to support Ruben Gallego in Arizona.
body: As a filmmaker, I've always been deeply interested in the moments that defined the American spirit — the Civil War, the Great Depression, the Second World War, the Vietnam War, the Civil Rights Movement. #                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 [](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-nov24.6f99Bw&refcode=em241101-2-160&refcode2=3508.734936.-81Ecl&t=1&akid=3508%2E734936%2E-81Ecl) --- Hello, Peter. This is Ken Burns. As a filmmaker, I've always been deeply interested in the moments that defined the American spirit — the Civil War, the Great Depression, the Second World War, the Vietnam War, the Civil Rights Movement. These were inflection points where we were forced to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens. As Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it." Today, we face a new generational challenge. Our system of government is in great peril. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It has never been more important that we come together to ensure that our republic endures for future generations. To meet that challenge, we need leaders who understand how important our democracy is and what it truly means to serve. That's why I’m writing to you on behalf of Ruben Gallego. Ruben is the son of immigrant parents, the first in his family to go to college, a Marine veteran, and a father. His opponent, Kari Lake, attacks our elections at every turn. She sows the very same discord that is tearing our country apart. She is dangerous. Where Ruben would unite us, Kari Lake seeks only division. We need more people like Ruben serving our country, and it would mean the world to me if you could support his campaign. subject: I have a quick, respectful question for you, Peter:
body: | I'm here to tell you, crunch time is NOW.                                                                                                                                                                                          _Tammy Baldwin here — I wanted to make sure you saw this message from Colin Allred. subject: Heading out to vote
body: # [#] Election Day is just 4 days away. It’s hard to believe, but I wanted to reach out and ensure you’re prepared to head to the polls on Tuesday. Here’s all the information on same day registration, poll locations and additional voting information for California. [https://www.sos.ca.gov/elections?%5D=] . This is the most critical Election of our lives, which makes it more important than ever that we get out there to the polls and encourage the people around us to do the same. Your voice matters, and it’s important that you get out there and exercise your right to vote! See you at the polls! — Zoe Congresswoman Zoe Lofgren is a strong fighter for California’s values in Washington. As the Chair of the California Democratic Congressional Delegation, she has been on the front lines of expanding and protecting the Democratic Majority. Zoe has dedicated her career to fighting for our diverse communities and needs your help. subject: A Letter from Minnesota, With Love
body: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/schultz-october-2024?refcode=20241031 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/schultz-october-2024?refcode=20241031] Dear Americans, I’m a Minnesotan, home of Lake Wobegon, where all the women are strong, all the men are good-looking, and all the children are above average. Minnesotans have grit, a strong work ethic, love to join community clubs, gladly shovel their neighbor’s sidewalk, and have never been able to accept a complement. We’re okay being a flyover state or being confused with Wisconsin—we’re humble and it’s not our place to correct folks or tell them what to do or what to think. We’re fiercely independent, believe we can pull ourselves up, but realize not everyone can and we’re happy to give others a boost. I’m writing to you because I love our country, our America. I’m losing sleep because I’m worried about our future. And sleep is very important to a Midwesterner. I’ve been campaigning for Congress for two years in a district that was solidly blue with strong labor unions for 70 of the last 77 years, but in the last presidential election supported Trump by 15 points. I was a state legislator for 8 years, and have seen our communities become divided, so unusual because they have survived by being together. Our country is strong because of our diversity. It is something that should be cherished. Our country is wealthier and more powerful than the rest of the world. We opened our doors—immigrants came to America to build their dream, find their freedom. Immigrants became Americans, proudly serving our country, waiving the American flag. Our melting pot created a country that is the envy of the world. Our experiment has held. Minnesota is the state that has provided two vice presidents, Hubert Humphrey and Walter Mondale, scrappy Senators like Paul Wellstone, and smart, respected Representatives like Jim Oberstar. Leaders are not born they are molded by their experiences. And Minnesota shaped these leaders. Our leaders cared about their neighbors, wanted to ensure that the most vulnerable had the opportunities and resources to live a good life. Humphrey laid the foundation for civil rights and fought for fair employment, organized labor, and humanitarian foreign aid. Mondale changed the role of the Vice Presidency, making it a true part of the executive branch. He knew his role was to help and to support the President, he said “I wanted to be a trouble shooter, and I wanted to take on chores around the country and around the world.” He called for a more accountable Presidency under the checks of the Cabinet, the Congress, the media, and the public. He carried on the Minnesota tradition of championing civil rights, the Equal Rights Amendment, and progressive values. After he lost the presidential race in 1984, he told his children that even if he hadn't won the people's votes, he felt he had won their respect by telling the truth, and he was proud of that. You see, Minnesotans are truth tellers, to such a degree that it may hurt their own cause. Mondale told voters that if they wanted to reduce the national debt, we would either need to cut spending or increase taxes—neither a popular option. When Mondale lost his bid to be President he said, “I'd rather be the underdog in a campaign about decency than to be ahead in a campaign only about self-interest.” Reminding us about the importance of respecting others, having empathy, and wanting our neighbors to succeed. After the election, Mondale told his children, "There are many things worse than losing a campaign, including losing your integrity or your self-respect." After spending the last two years listening to people, I realize we need Minnesota values now more than ever. Minnesota has shaped Tim Walz as well. He truly is humble. He knows the importance of being a team, helping your neighbors, and earning your respect. Walz has learned and grown as a Minnesota politician—he’ll be the Midwestern humble voice giving support and encouragement. He’ll be a cheerleader for America and a coach creating a team that is united to help face what’s to come. He will make us proud to be Americans and will spread the joy that so many of us need. Minnesota has offered up another leader and the rest of the country should seize the opportunity to take him from us. Paul Wellstone said, “I don't think politics has anything to do with left, right, or center. It has to do with trying to do right by people.” I’m relying on you, Americans, to do right by people; to participate in our democracy, to vote with compassion—you have the power to protect our experiment, to keep our dream alive—it’s in your hands. name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: I’m used to being written off
body: I’m used to being written off, Peter. When I first ran for Congress in Wisconsin, no one thought I could win — especially when an extremely popular challenger jumped into the race. I remember huddling with one of my staffers at the time, and she said, _“Well Tammy, maybe you want to rethink what you’re doing because it’s going to be tough.”_ I looked her right in the eye and asked, _“Do you think I should wait my turn?”_ The next thing I said was this: **I believe that women have to run — especially when it’s hard — and not wait our turn. We can’t wait until we get a tap on our shoulder or we’ll never get anywhere.** I ended up winning that race and became the very first woman elected to the House of Representatives from Wisconsin. And it wouldn’t be the last time our team would make history. When I ran for U.S. Senate in 2012, an incredible team of grassroots supporters like you fought alongside me — even as some people wrote us off. You helped me become the first woman elected to the chamber from our state and the first openly gay Senator in our nation’s history. In 2018, despite being a top target for national Republicans and enduring over a year of attacks, you stood with me again, and we won. Time and again, grassroots supporters like you have helped us defy the odds. The battle to protect my seat this year will be no different, with this race being my toughest election yet. **Eric Hovde and his Republican allies have already spent more than $51 million to buy this seat and recent polls are showing this race in a dead heat. Protecting this seat won’t be easy, but together, I know we can defy the odds once again.** **[So Peter, I’m humbly asking: Will you split a donation between my reelection campaign and Lucas Kunce body: It is going to take all of us to win this November and create the future your community deserves. | | | | --- Friends, I was just in Nevada. We have the momentum, and we still have work to do to earn every vote in this critical battleground state so that we can elect Democrats down the ballot. Donald Trump, JD Vance, and their allies are going to throw everything at us for the next few days – **and we cannot counter their attacks without your support. name: Lt. Governor Sara Rodriguez
subject: It's never been more important to vote
body: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/srodriguez-email?refcode=20241101_em_fr_b1_SR_NGP [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/srodriguez-email?refcode=20241101_em_fr_b1_SR_NGP] Friend, it's Lt. Governor Sara Rodriguez. I'm reaching out one last time before Election Day with one simple reminder: This is one of the most important elections of our lifetimes. Wisconsin is one of the most important swing states in the country. Our 10 electoral votes are some of the most important in the country, and it's crucial that we deliver them to Kamala Harris on Election Day. And at the state level, we have a task that's just as important: flipping the state legislature. The new, fairer maps for this cycle give everyone the chance to win, which makes this the first time in a long time that we can win a majority this November. When we win next Tuesday, it'll let Governor Evers and I focus on passing our agenda that truly serves the people of Wisconsin rather than fighting back against Republican attempts to bully working-class Wisconsinites. With just a few days left in this election cycle, it's more important than ever to make your voice heard at the ballot box. Whether that means voting early or voting on Election Day, the most important thing is that you vote. I'll be doing my part this weekend, knocking on as many doors as I can with my team—can you chip in to help us cover the expenses for this last big GOTV push? Gov Sara Rodriguez Lt. Gov. Sara Rodriguez, MSN, MPH, RN, was sworn in as Wisconsin’s 46th Lieutenant Governor on January 3, 2023. A working mom, wife, and proud Wisconsinite, Lt. Gov. Rodriguez was elected on November 8, 2022. Before her election, she served in the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Assembly District 13, comprising a portion of Waukesha and Milwaukee Counties. While serving as a state representative, she worked on the Committees on Health, Insurance, Energy and Utilities, and Science, Technology and Broadband. https://secure.actblue.com/donate/srodriguez-email?refcode=20241101_em_fr_b1_SR_NGP [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/srodriguez-email?refcode=20241101_em_fr_b1_SR_NGP] Lt. Gov. Rodriguez is an experienced healthcare executive who has worked in various leadership roles for over 20 years, including founding her own small business. Prior to serving in the Wisconsin State Assembly, Lt. Gov. Rodriguez was the vice president of Population Health and Integrated Care Management at one of the largest healthcare systems in the Midwest. In this role, she provided strategic direction to the teams that managed population health interventions for risk-based contracts and direct-to-employer products. Before running for office, Lt. Gov. Rodriguez built a career in public health and population health management. She held positions with public health departments at the local, state, and federal levels, including serving as an epidemic intelligence service officer with the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, the chronic disease director for the state of Colorado, a healthcare systems consultant, and a vice president at a Fortune 100 Company. body: It’s full of millionaires, formers business execs, lawyers with Ivy League degrees, and trust fund kids born with so many silver spoons in their mouths that they have no idea the reality for working-class people like me. _[Click here to stop receiving emails about Dan Osborn's campaign in Nebraska from us.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96341619/509689090/1647001491?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ODQxMGVlYi03Njk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Q41wOp6ickW93Q0wUGSvXXdJ944eJTh7QhBZwx4_Ft8=&emci=5a52c302-4497-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=98410eeb-7698-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=19445147)_ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96341621/509689092/92586991?refcode=em20241101mid-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=98410eeb-7698-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ODQxMGVlYi03Njk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Q41wOp6ickW93Q0wUGSvXXdJ944eJTh7QhBZwx4_Ft8=) Hey there, **The U.S. Senate is a country club.** It’s full of millionaires, former business execs, lawyers with Ivy League degrees, and trust fund kids born with so many silver spoons in their mouths that they have no idea the reality for working-class people like me. **If I defeat my opponent Republican Senator Deb Fischer in November, I will be the poorest member of the U.S. Senate.** I don’t come from money, and I’m not rich. I’m a steamfitter and mechanic who works 50 and 60 hour weeks to give my kids a better life. **I will be the only senator without a college degree.** After my wife and I found out we were expecting a baby, I had to drop out and kill my dream of hanging a diploma on the wall because my family needed health insurance, diapers, and food on the table. **I will be the only senator who is a blue-collar, card-carrying, union member.** When Kellogg’s tried to cut our benefits and workers’ pay, we risked it all, went on strike, and walked the picket line for 11 weeks through the bitter cold Nebraska winter. We won and saved hundreds of good-paying jobs – before I was fired for being the union president who led the strike. There is no one who represents working-class people like me in the U.S. Senate. Which is why this is such big news: **Five brand-new polls show I am narrowly LEADING my opponent Republican Senator Deb Fischer. And FiveThirtyEight now says this is the CLOSEST Senate race in the entire country!** I’ve taken on a big corporation before and won, and now I’m going to defeat one of the most corporate senators – my opponent Republican Deb Fischer – and win this Senate seat. But I need your help to do it. **We’ve set a goal of raising another $200,000 before our next fundraising deadline at midnight tonight, but I’m not taking money from corporate PACs like my opponent. subject: Our final weekend
body: This is it, friend. We have just four days to go in this race, and this final weekend could be the difference between victory and defeat.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96341660/509689305/476240633?amount=10&refcode=em_fr_2024.11.01_b1_jb_all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTE2ZmExOWUtNzc5OC1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=pn1l4jTwIL35p7ncKhilkZgpn0rew1EM2ZfqbugmP_A=) This is it, friend. We have just four days to go in this race, and **this final weekend could be the difference between victory and defeat.** We need to knock on a lot of doors _(and I mean a lot!)_ this weekend to turn out voters – but we can’t do it without your help. **[Will you chip in $10 today to help us maximize turnout and win this toss-up race? Polling shows that we’re tied, so any extra voter we can reach this weekend could make the difference.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96341661/509689306/476240633?amount=10&refcode=em_fr_2024.11.01_b1_jb_all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTE2ZmExOWUtNzc5OC1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=pn1l4jTwIL35p7ncKhilkZgpn0rew1EM2ZfqbugmP_A=)** | [CHIP IN](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96341662/509689307/-440113138?amount=10&refcode=em_fr_2024.11.01_b1_jb_all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTE2ZmExOWUtNzc5OC1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=pn1l4jTwIL35p7ncKhilkZgpn0rew1EM2ZfqbugmP_A=) --- Here’s why my team and I are working so hard to connect with voters over these last days of the campaign: * Lori Chavez-DeRemer and her GOP allies have been spreading misinformation about me and my record. [Donate](https://secure.winred.com/michael-goldstein-for-congress-2024/donate-today?sc=winred-directory&money_bomb=false&recurring=false) Please also amplify our messages Website www.goldsteinforcongress.com - Substack: https://drmichaelgoldstein4ct.substack.com/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/drmichaelgoldstein/ X: https://x.com/DrMGoldstein Facebook https://www.facebook.com/goldsteinforcongress/ Dr. Michael Goldstein (ROW 3B) - Early Voting this weekend 10-6 [www.goldsteinforcongress.com](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/0792eb01-0780-42a7-b192-81590b7f85dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Paid for by Goldstein for Congress * * * This is the Inquiry Sent below: Dear Editors and Investigative Journalists of Connecticut's Major News & Media Outlets and Other Independent News Channel Outlets: The Doctor Michael Goldstein for Congress Campaign for the 4th Congressional District has received numerous inquiries and concerns about Yonkers Contracting as the Primary Contractor for most CT DOT projects throughout Fairfield County and other parts of the state. We see these trucks everywhere every night along the campaign trail when the roads are being worked on for improvements. The concerns they raise are seeing New York License plates and why these are not Connecticut trucks. Have you looked into: 1. How are these contracts awarded? 2. If an out-of-state contractor is hired, will it use Connecticut Union Construction workers and other ancillary Connecticut residents to participate in the construction or are all these workers New York as well? 3. If an out-of-state contractor is hired, will it use local suppliers of various materials or are all these suppliers New York as well? 4. Whether all contracts are awarded to the lowest bidder? 5. Are local contractors considered if their bid is slightly higher? 6. How is a contractor rewarded or penalized by its previous project for change order usage as the winners always seem to be the same? 7. The percentage of payrolls to Connecticut residents (if any)? 8. The benefit to local communities and economies in Connecticut if a local contractor is awarded the contract? 9. The benefits of contractor profits being re-invested into the local economy rather than exporting profits outside of CT for the out-of-state contractor and its out-of-state suppliers? 10. Additional Fees such as fuel surcharges and other distance based issues on logistics? As Climate Change and Health Hazards associated with slow-moving traffic are also major concerns, are the following also included in the calculation: 1. The environmental impact of greenhouse gas based on travel distance of workers and equipment out of state to the project site? 2. The additional congestion of the workforce commuting to the construction site and how it will disrupt traffic for commuters? We have been concerned about the I-95 traffic and the challenges to the Fairfield County corridor and now a project is starting. We saw the Yonkers Contracting banner and also wondered why there are no Connecticut Companies that win these bids. While most of the highway funds are from the Federal Government, it is still Connecticut taxpayer funds as CT has traditionally received only 70 cents back on each federal dollar. As a candidate for Congress in Connecticut and campaigning on improving the Fairfield County corridor, it is not just about improving the roads, but having a lasting impact on the local economies of Fairfield County and surrounding counties that keep federally spent dollars in Connecticut. Some Links we have briefly assembled as this is really investigative reporting: [https://www.thehour.com/news/article/i-95-delays-norwalk-westport-ctdot-bridge-replace-18404086.php](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/d4cea959-130c-45a1-87c9-bb5673ae36bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [https://www.thehour.com/news/article/norwalk-i-95-fairfield-avenue-bridge-fire-crash-19525562.php](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/3dfdbb5e-3c89-41f9-81bc-73e39cbe841f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [https://www.yonkerscontractingco.com/stamford-parking](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b1b72f22-dc20-4f0b-bb40-c46fb871a308?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [https://newyork.news12.com/sick-of-backups-on-i-95-new-project-promises-relief](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4fb34e9a-65c8-4294-a642-5b73b3afd819?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [https://www.ctinsider.com/projects/2024/news/ct-norwalk-bridge-i95-demolition/](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/44c3fd94-a47e-42ff-8045-03dc6ef127cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) The voters want to know why tax dollars leave for out-of-state contractors when they know there are contractors in the State (not necessarily in the Congressional District) to do the work. We would appreciate your prompt attention to this matter as this is a major concern for our Voters. **Traffic** , **Infrastructure** , **Climate Change** and **Health** are on the Ballot and the voter should be informed. Connecticut has also some of the highest costs per mile for road repair and construction and our constituents are concerned about inefficient use of taxpayer funds at the state and local level as poor spending hurts each resident in the pocketbook. We are thoroughly concerned about these issues. Sincerely, Dr. Michael T. name: Sara Jacobs
subject: GOTV weekend is here
body: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em] Hi friends! After what feels like a lifetime of this election cycle, we’ve made it to GOTV (Get Out the Vote!) weekend, and I for one am fired up about it! Here’s what I’ll be up to over the next four days: After campaigning in San Diego and other parts California the past two weekends, I’m heading out to the presidential battleground state of Michigan to get out the vote as much as I possibly can for Kamala Harris and Tim Walz and for a whole host of fantastic Democratic House candidates. Here are just a few things you could do to GOTV wherever you are: * Join a virtual phone bank and call voters from home. * Text voters in battleground districts around the country. * Reach out to your friends and family to make sure they’re voting. * Post on your own social media about the importance of voting. * Carpool to a canvass in a battleground district or state. You can find all that and more right here [https://go.kamalaharris.com/] . And of course, if you haven’t voted yet yourself – GO VOTE! In San Diego County, you can return your completed ballot to any official ballot drop box or drop it in the mail (no postage needed to vote in California!), or if you prefer, you can go vote early in person at one of the more than 200 early vote centers open around San Diego County. Get the details here [https://iwillvote.com/] . Happy GOTV! -Sara https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em] Congresswoman Sara Jacobs California’s 51st District CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em] If you can’t give much right now, I want you to know that even $1 or $5 makes a difference. body: We’re entering the FINAL WEEKEND before the election. | | | Peter, We’re entering the FINAL WEEKEND before the election. Just four more days to put our noses to the grindstone, turn out voters, and advocate for candidates that will put the needs of the many above the needs of the few. There are TONS of ways to get plugged in and help. Here’s what we need you to do: 1. [Join one of our final phonebanks for Kamala Harris and Tim Walz](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMbGj-ca0TYSsYMZBvIweYdJxZAP5xLg1YZaKIinIFmIxFCyCvJLems1KcPFgsU1EWyX8OQEazETxNSnqt53ogsyp0pn18wfpWA-yitL5tFTEug5RxVMey9uE0zyzJG61hGXAx6zxJVOX8AykDed23xGRzQIaAYrICbsp6ocVgeYI-oE6pwnnxCrh7cNu9f-BUHNOWVIQAujrc9t8SfSj9qFaPL4mymKqDFzhyVvaYxAJNKEZDIBO4OWt9NNpgjMZwQ/4b3/wC8fjMQSTnuI2z986yw92Q/h0/h001.5gWF_3wkjGtTRj1ixsviOxqOtRFYtx8p27mnh-Tc6iI) — either tonight (Friday) at 6pm ET or tomorrow (Saturday) from 11am - 1:30pm ET. 2. If you want to focus specifically on Pennsylvania — one of the most critical swing states this cycle — [join our PA WFP phonebank here.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMbGj-ca0TYSsYMZBvIweYdJxZAP5xLg1YZaKIinIFmIx1dcc6Q5b4fLQC6iO88OzKYKHZ6-3lnlxyEaPq8x7Q_RlENvFem0Z3UMcI7FlJvO8oki6GClsBOxu-P27ONC3eN3RMOmS2C8nLxq6q42NUxxgrsrfnV3VvmqJ5ISEBVivJDADk04rhOzw09BC5Ws_hMF2kD7zoUuaAz6fNyGACfWDax9BItQN-ix1w9RXixVx3h89_ZNDtArjY0wcgGKhbw/4b3/wC8fjMQSTnuI2z986yw92Q/h1/h001.l2etJnvdm2VSi0bMS0_cxvZPI-EKgp7VZZUV5iZAbxk) We’ll be hitting the phone lines on Sunday and Monday. 3. [If you live in a swing state or are willing to travel to one, sign up to join a door knocking shift in key battlegrounds.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMbGj-ca0TYSsYMZBvIweYdJxZAP5xLg1YZaKIinIFmIxT1EI76bBBH_yZOsYu-pvo1tA__aujMZGMDMqxRzAjd0ofrrAbIYUdGexjkz0QFmiIdfqZSYDhP5DMeas97GBjKrkQef3g-voPG-3Ty7nlcBVTK1BtY6j_mDdwDs-MYgu5oCoxTKOMoNGt0nmcCmR4TS9OpWSQ_9uA9aoYd5PBeEYHzBgczCJ6VqrOBSTaXjmWW9HoWpf21GrxtN5jvpSXg/4b3/wC8fjMQSTnuI2z986yw92Q/h2/h001.fF2VjXIL6Z2Vi_JAiyu6QWAF6Lcv0R2B5di2jiVVK_g) Our partner, Seed the Vote, can help book transportation and housing, and offer financial support for those who need it in order to travel. 4. Lastly, and perhaps most importantly, you can easily find ALL the volunteer opportunities nearby (if they exist) by **texting "WIN" to 30403** You all have already done SO MUCH for our movement this cycle, Peter. All we’re asking for is one BIG push over these final four days. In solidarity, Team WFP P.S. name: Governor Ed Rendell
subject: Susan needs your support!
body: We just can’t afford to lose Susan; she is more than a good congressperson and a certain vote for the things we believe in. | Peter, I know by this time, with a week to go before the election, you are probably sick and tired of getting requests from campaigns. So, I will make this last one cognizant of the fact that I have asked you to do so much in this pivotal election. The Pennsylvania Democrats Congressional Delegation improved immeasurably in 2018 when we elected the “Fab Four” of Madeleine Dean, Mary Scanlon, Chrissy Houlahan, and Susan Wild. Fortunately, three of the four are in districts where their good work makes it easy for them to win re-election. But one of them, Susan Wild, is in a district that will always be a swing district because it is nearly equally populated by democrats, republicans, and independents. [_**So I am asking you to help one more time and give Susan the money she will need on election day and get it to her as quickly as possible.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96342976/509692352/-1389333692?refcode=BLU_EM_SWC_2024-11-01_2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODczMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZjEzNmE5MS03OTk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Kg5uIQErmIWJBLPJOqBQQLyK-Hm755fd3mD94iy6KGA=) We just can’t afford to lose Susan; she is more than a good congressperson and a certain vote for the things we believe in. She is a tremendous person with a great heart, tremendous political courage, and the ability to bring other congresspeople from both parties to support good causes. Her loss would be tragic. body: [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=8121%2E5257348%2EnSb5EY ]Adam Schiff for Senate Derek, stop me if you’ve heard this before: Donald Trump’s campaign claims that he’s a serious candidate, taking the rally stage to defend his record and talk about his agenda. When Trump takes the stage, he launches into an incoherent, meandering speech, lacking in policy proposals, and chock full of lies and attacks against his political opponents, including me. body: Team -- the New York Times literally has the video recordings of the zoom calls hosted by major vote suppressors as they plan how to challenge voters and try to get our votes thrown out: Image of "For years, opponents of voting rights have huddled in video meetings to talk about remaking democracy and plan for the election." [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/NYT_Suppressive-election-network-video-topper-640w_Small.gif] Their calls for " election integrity " are little more than a costume they throw over their voter suppression efforts to make them appear legitimate. They're coming for our votes, not just this year but for the future as well. Please, RUSH $25 or more right now to help us defend the right to vote and fight back against their voter suppression plans >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=110124_3&amount=25] Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=110124_3&amount=25] The Atlantic: What Election Integrity Really Means [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=110124_3&amount=25] Sometimes figuring out what opponents of voting rights are saying feels like you need a translation device, Team. But this one has gotten pretty easy -- for the vote suppressors, "election integrity" means elections they win . Despite no evidence of widespread fraud and millions of taxpayer dollars wasted investigating false claims, a relative few cases and convictions have happened, despite the avalanche of voter suppression legislation passed since 2017 . Florida alone spent millions of dollars to create a new division of state police and run investigations into voters, only to find 20 formerly incarcerated voters who voted before their rights had been restored. 20 out of a state of nearly 14 million registered voters. Yet these opponents of voting rights continue to spread lies and misinformation. They know that by passing these laws in states they control they are able to shave off enough potential voters to make sure their suppressive candidates win. They want us scared to vote and scared to support our fellow citizens voting. We can't let them win. We must fight back against their rhetoric, their lies, and their suppressive legislation. name: Team GIFFORDS
subject: TONIGHT: Phone Bank with Gabby Giffords and Congresswoman McBath!
body: Sign up for our upcoming phone bank to support gun safety. #                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 Friend, Don't miss your chance to join us TONIGHT for a special phone bank opportunity! **Join us[at 6 pm ET/3 pm PT](https://go.giffords.org/go/58003?t=1&akid=9350%2E3935704%2EF0qqLC) for the Gun Violence Prevention Voters for Harris-Walz Phone Bank.** This is a unique opportunity to hear from former Congresswoman **Gabby Giffords** and Congresswoman **Lucy McBath** from Georgia, two women who have had their lives turned upside down by gun violence. Your voice matters in this fight, and this event is a powerful way to connect with others who are dedicated to preventing gun violence. **[RSVP](https://go.giffords.org/go/58002?t=2&akid=9350%2E3935704%2EF0qqLC)** Thank you for your commitment to this important cause—**together, we can make a difference!** We hope you’ll join us tonight. In solidarity, The team at GIFFORDS PS: Help us spread the message online—use this [**Social Media Toolkit**](https://go.giffords.org/go/57507?t=3&akid=9350%2E3935704%2EF0qqLC) to share how Team Harris-Walz is fighting to make our communities safer. Your voice can inspire others to join the cause! Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.Giffords.org This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=4&akid=9350%2E3935704%2EF0qqLC) if you'd like to unsubscribe. Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

The House majority is up for grabs. **That means Democrats have a chance to give Kamala Harris a Democratic trifecta to make meaningful progress for working families in Washington and across the country. **3\. Elections at every level of government are critical as Democrats work to rid Washington state – and the country – of the Trump extremism that is holding our nation back from moving forward.** We need everyone doing their part from now until Election Day to send a loud and clear message that Washington state is ready to keep making progress. name: Kevin Faulconer
subject: Lawson-Remer: Missed Meetings, Missed Votes, and Missed Opportunities to Address Our Challenges
body: Lawson-Remer: Missed Meetings, Missed Votes, and Missed Opportunities to Address Our Challenges | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/3b0f9d762537/lawson-remer-missed-meetings-missed-votes-and-missed-opportunities-to-address-our-challenges?e=784f78234b) --- | | --- | | | # Dear Friend, # When you’re elected to represent the people, showing up isn’t optional—it’s a basic responsibility. When I was Mayor, I showed up every day and met with my staff, the City Council, and department leaders to ensure the City was doing its best to address our challenges. What’s important? Showing up to work. Yet, Vice Chair Terra Lawson-Remer has failed to attend a single meeting of the homelessness task force, despite claiming homelessness is her top priority. This task force isn’t just a title; it’s a critical opportunity to address our county’s homelessness crisis. Under Lawson-Remer’s watch, [homelessness](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=8234edce5f&e=784f78234b) and related [deaths](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=7cea6485b4&e=784f78234b) have reached unprecedented levels. But instead of engaging, she’s missed meetings and critical votes—neglecting her duties and abandoning core responsibilities. It’s not just her—her staff has failed to show up as well. Lawson-Remer has even admitted that her representatives [haven’t attended meetings](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=78d158e2cf&e=784f78234b), leaving important issues unaddressed. In any other job, failing to attend mandatory meetings would be grounds for termination. But when it comes to serving our communities, she expects a pass? **San Diego deserves a leader who is accountable, dedicated and, most importantly, present.** I understand the urgency of San Diego’s homelessness crisis and have a track record of hands-on leadership, proven solutions, and a transparent commitment to our community. I won’t sit on the sidelines or turn a blind eye to the issues that affect us all just to collect a paycheck. Let’s work to address the pressing challenges we face as a county—together. When my boys were young, my husband and I were both working full-time. As soon as I got off the night shift from the Chapel Hill Police Department at 7am, I would go straight to my sons’ classrooms to volunteer. Not only did this serve as an opportunity for me to spend more precious time with my children, but it opened my eyes to the social disparities affecting students firsthand, especially Black and brown kids, in the classroom. **I couldn’t stand by as students were being underserved, so after doing everything I could do as a volunteer — I ran for School Board.** On the School Board, I fought tooth and nail for better funding for our schools. But eventually, **I knew I had to run for Orange County Commissioner to make concrete changes.** As Orange County Commissioner, I championed the construction of two schools, two senior centers, and affordable housing initiatives — **but knew the next step to securing long-term progress for our children’s and communities’ future was running for State House.** I championed legislation for women, voting rights, and environmental protection. **But, when I could do nothing more as State Senator, I ran for Congress.** I got into this line of work in pursuit of building a better life for my community and followed my heart throughout every single step. [Now, there’s still SO much more I can do. In just 4 days, you can send me back to Congress and keep building progress for NC-04. Hitting our October goal makes the difference in having the resources we need to reach undecided voters and get out the vote every day for the next four days. **And thanks to you, we didn’t just hit our goal, we surpassed it.** Now, we have just four days left. That’s four days to reach every undecided voter in OR-06 and tell them what exactly we’re fighting for in this race: protecting abortion rights, defending democracy, and putting working families ahead of special interests. [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-nov24.k4yPYt&refcode=em241101-3-900&t=2&akid=2173%2E135344%2ExhEnQx) It’s a race we cannot afford to lose. Now, I know a thing or two about winning in Michigan, so hear me when I say: Michigan is the swingiest of swing states. National Republicans and outside groups are spending tens of millions to turn Michigan red and keep Elissa out of the Senate, and polls show that this race could not be closer. name: GallegoForArizona.com
subject: Requesting your support before Election Day.
body: If everyone gives just a bit more than they typically would, we'll raise more than enough to hit these goals and be ready for whatever comes our way in these final days. #                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 Peter — Ruben reached out this morning about an ambitious goal: $1.5 million raised between now and midnight on Election Day. We’re hoping you can lend a hand before then, because this final goal is critical. Here’s why: As our fundraising fell off, Kari Lake’s picked up. She escalated her advertising alongside the outside groups backing her up, and spent millions of dollars attacking Ruben as voters started returning their ballots. We saw this race tighten, gradually at first, and then earlier this week, two polls showed us TIED with Lake. The timing couldn’t be worse. We’ve got to meet the moment here, but our fundraising hasn’t picked up yet. The way we see it, there are two options ahead of us: 1. We either need more people to chip in. 2. Or we need everyone who chips in to give a little more than they usually would. Most people give $10 or so the first time they donate. But today, we’re asking you to chip in $20.24. If you can give that much, it would really help us make up some ground. [**Can you make that $20.24 donation to Ruben’s campaign and help him reach this final goal? name: Indiana GOP
subject: The Final Push Towards Victory!
body: | | | --- | | --- | | _**Final Push Towards Victory!**_ --- Friends, We’re in the final push for this election! Now is the time to ensure Republicans get out and vote. Our work has been building toward this moment, and every single vote matters in securing victory. Last week, we celebrated surpassing 400,000 voter contacts, and now we’ve hit over 450,000 contacts through door-to-door efforts and phone banking. Let’s keep this momentum strong through Election Day! Make sure you go out and vote and bring friends and family with you! On Election Day itself, we encourage everyone to participate in a phone bank with local parties or volunteers in your area to help make those last-minute contacts. If you want to help out please reach out to your local party leaders to get involved! For Election Night, you’re all invited to join us at the JW Marriott as we watch our hard work in action! If you plan to attend, please RSVP to [RSVP@indiana.gop](mailto:RSVP@indiana.gop?subject=RSVP Election Night "RSVP@indiana.gop"). Just a reminder: Election Night will also see the close of our [Bourbon Auction](http://links.email.in-gop.com/u/click?_t=9a0b7d408bc44ce9bb6828c91a267dbf&_m=731fdbc4793049d4bedb94b9948b12a2&_e=EBHBgDMQGYlew2DXt2WNlyN7yUgdgwv186nBYNKJE7j9izyj_ZQpb-ATCS6mVR0Tv6tdy0AEoWUWCDwacDPMOn3bPOfUmKs72YeP8piw_gticawyiRrxvrwO7Tn223O8dViKpK_bG-eeAY0OesjwxnG0iRCjqkx2zO5rXpT7vLLJIfOxRr0_1z9FkT1QOKJQHVFKgu5yK2Lob-YoHZJ81bKJuWceVOhEct8NWI76ecDD2b0vu9ZX3fJ8cr2QoWnUzrBNg2VzNh0lLFDMdFurNleFwHTsLzA2z0NjCtpNVGYq7jdj7v5Cyrp3Awoas7xxJmAEi4R1vtm1iUQ2LbxuUEw7DHdlXANXJfI23g_2K55kx-6LnXFSvREX8Q4fcf07dJ4dPTbu7KlEpeqsWaKW9Q_59jMv7D2ywjLddHYrROSRjSaILyjxodjlXLqUbm10jwcRUB9FMMhM6QfZ1abqFYYSrKYis6zmT7SfLCD-a6GvzpLjG77h-NA3uAQmHwpONXCfuIz0i5h-cr88p4fV1HN-Vx_TmyrfnBGiLTQ4xZjQZPLgetO7hLVYT8-K7sUaC2M3JUKepxc7lXmlS4LrlaRqOWmJ36CnPPNKsZEhpRE%3D), so please share the link with anyone who may be interested! Lastly, we have one more weekend of Bus Tour stops beginning this Friday, with stops in Howard, Boone, and Marion counties. Saturday’s tour will visit Hendricks, Vigo, Knox, and Vanderburgh counties! The tour has been fantastic for building excitement and giving our candidates a chance to speak with Republican Hoosiers across the state. For more information or to RSVP for one of our bus tour stops, please contact Alex Hickner at [ahickner@indiana.gop](mailto:ahickner@indiana.gop "ahickner@indiana.gop"). Thank you all for what you do! --- | | --- | | Chairman Randy Head --- | --- | --- | | --- | | _**Mike Braun Tele-Rally w/ President Trump & Freedom and Opportunity Bus Tour**_ --- [ | | | ---|---|--- ](http://links.email.in-gop.com/u/click?_t=9a0b7d408bc44ce9bb6828c91a267dbf&_m=731fdbc4793049d4bedb94b9948b12a2&_e=F9ehgBvJanf7GvXqJLqhGrVpqA4jimEbGM5wW9P_kxUdP7ZOvs4TuGI-mwgicgytyfANSEsnwqOd-awO7kEKABesM9bxVlauHxeEWmd5nnLrjHGXDY4QreuPgDgZY5ndUAIM3FuyJXJZ9q7HDh2Jvug5oHl8bLluXFuCZY-zZSI0nLgs_Ra1T0yHZ-Y49ERPUIoQzcbiirZd5vSBFa7m2DZNKqPOsj2lKZJQKaJDMD0%3D "Trump Tele-Rally for Mike Braun") **Senator Mike Braun** [was joined](http://links.email.in-gop.com/u/click?_t=9a0b7d408bc44ce9bb6828c91a267dbf&_m=731fdbc4793049d4bedb94b9948b12a2&_e=F9ehgBvJanf7GvXqJLqhGtNnsIUz9jLLRbPJXCmXxSUUNfSRUMEDo702FEGONovJDBiISNq2phuiyRBNaPrGzmcH1QqFUqBrJKq1EI2TFcsAfv2f8Brd7b2QIe3crj6zVKb25qXXREubV_9wWRhR4DawqOUjyyut0WgPD8QxjbBplqiBxenBa6eA5-g_skqAhBBEOTXYKmJbUUGZw5APAn65Q95z9OeZg16y8RSulfs9UCxSiC4Q8o4uJ8Mv_tEn) by President Donald Trump for a Tele-Rally in support of his campaign for Governor! **What's he saying** : "We have to get out and VOTE, and you have to vote for MIKE BRAUN." - President @realDonaldTrump" \- **Sen. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: Sacrifices.
body: [ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1001&akid=4435%2E35263%2EbzyJWt ]TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE Peter, I have a personal story I’d like to share with you. Growing up, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital. When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, wanted to make sure I was protected in case I got sick again. But they couldn’t find any insurance policies that would cover me in the future. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. That meant my grandparents had to pay for my health care out of pocket, and they had to make significant sacrifices to do so — all because I had a pre-existing condition. I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried that I might fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care. No one should ever have to go through that. But my story is not unique, Peter, and I knew they weren’t the only ones. That’s why I got into public service. I’m one of 133 million Americans who have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to our care — and before the Affordable Care Act was passed, many of us could be denied coverage. Now, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and wrote the amendment to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan up to age 26. And when I meet with young people across Wisconsin, almost every hand in the room goes up when I ask who is on their parent’s health insurance. So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health care and threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions — including my opponent Eric Hovde, who called my amendment a “stupid idea” and said young people on their parent’s health insurance need to “grow up and move on.” If Eric Hovde flips this seat and secures the Senate majority for Republicans, the ACA will be on the chopping block and countless Americans could find themselves in a place where insurance companies are putting profits over people. That’s not right. And that’s why I need your help to defeat him. name: John Duarte
subject: Local Democrats Endorse Congressman John Duarte
body: | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/911f3712028b/john-duarte-launches-campaign-for-13th-congressional-district-10344798?e=76a47b375f) --- | | --- | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE November 1, 2024 Contact: Duane Dichiara Phone: (916) 997-4784 --- | **Local Democrat Leaders Endorse Congressman Duarte’s Re-Election Campaign** --- | | **Merced —** Local Democratic leaders have endorsed Congressman John Duarte’s re-election campaign, highlighting his commitment to working across party lines to deliver results for the Central Valley. Democratic endorsements include: * San Joaquin County Sheriff Patrick Withrow (D) * Kerman Mayor Maria Pacheco (D) * Mendota Mayor Victor Martinez (D) * San Joaquin Mayor Julia Hernandez (D) * Dos Palos Councilman Thomas Pigg (D) * Firebaugh Councilman Freddy Valdez (D) * Firebaugh Councilman Brady Jenkins (D) * Firebaugh Councilman Felipe Perez (D) * Huron Councilwoman Arelly Arellano (D) * Lathrop Councilwoman Minnie Diallo (D) * Madera Councilman Jose Rodriguez (D) _“I’ve built a track record of working with both Democrats and Republicans to get things done for the Valley. Whether it’s lowering costs, securing water for our farmers, or improving public safety, I’m ready to work with anyone to get things done,”_ said Congressman Duarte. _“I’ve had the pleasure of working with these Democratic elected officials over the past two years, and I’m grateful for their support in my re-election campaign.”_ For more information about John Duarte and the campaign, please visit www.JohnDuarteforCongress.com. ### --- | | | | | | | [](https://johnduarteforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d614871a572868b235b65477d&id=4de7c9ca79&e=76a47b375f) --- | | [](https://johnduarteforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d614871a572868b235b65477d&id=1ef77f0036&e=76a47b375f) --- | | [](https://johnduarteforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d614871a572868b235b65477d&id=d001502c2e&e=76a47b375f) --- | | Paid for by John Duarte For Congress --- | --- | **Our mailing address is:** PO Box 730, Hilmar CA 95324 Want to change how you receive these emails? body: |                                                                                                                                                                 --- [](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1142?refcode=kh_em_do_20241101_b17_gww_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-srg&amount=47&amounts=47%252C75%252C100%252C250%252C500&utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241101_b17_gww_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-srg&t=1&akid=233%2E2563979%2E5UnF2l) Hi Peter. Four days to go. We've made it to the final stretch. I'm so proud of Tim. I'm so proud of this team. I want you to know that, but our work isn't over yet: **[In these final four days before Election Day, I'm asking you to volunteer to reach voters in your community.](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1218?utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241101_b17_gww_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-srg&t=2&akid=233%2E2563979%2E5UnF2l)** | | [VOLUNTEER](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1218?utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241101_b17_gww_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-srg&t=3&akid=233%2E2563979%2E5UnF2l) --- My mom used to say: _“Do the work that’s in front of you.”_ She was asking me to look around, and see how I might serve. How I might contribute. **For the next four days,_this_ is the work in front of you.** Volunteer. Bring a friend. Have conversations in parking lots. Make calls. Knock doors. Bake cookies for those people who are making calls and knocking doors. Let's do every single thing we can, and let's do it together. That is the way we win. **I can't say enough how important it is to remind everyone that your vote is your voice. The margins are so close that each one of us stepping up to volunteer truly makes a difference.** **[So, are you with me, Peter? Sign up to volunteer in these final four days, and let's get this done together. As a voter in Pennsylvania, one of the most critical states of this election, your support is all the more important. Any time you can spare is well worth it.](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1218?utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241101_b17_gww_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-srg&t=4&akid=233%2E2563979%2E5UnF2l)** **[The Final Stretch Canvass with PA Dems in Stroudsburg!](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1219?c0=713578.1u3fBm&utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241101_b17_gww_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-srg&t=5&akid=233%2E2563979%2E5UnF2l)** Saturday, November 2nd, 9:00 a.m. Stroudsburg, PA 18360 | [RSVP HERE](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1219?c0=713578.1u3fBm&utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241101_b17_gww_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-srg&t=6&akid=233%2E2563979%2E5UnF2l) --- **[The Final Stretch Canvass with PA Dems in Tobyhanna!](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1219?c0=706997.lWjb-n&utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241101_b17_gww_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-srg&t=5&akid=233%2E2563979%2E5UnF2l)** Saturday, November 2nd, 9:00 a.m. Tannersville, PA 18372 | [RSVP HERE](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1219?c0=706997.lWjb-n&utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241101_b17_gww_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-srg&t=6&akid=233%2E2563979%2E5UnF2l) --- _Not seeing an event that works for you? body: A small form of celebration of this great democracy | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96353769/509723123/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFjNTBlYjUwLThiOTgtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=CbLbZSE1sgyyxzlzKgt-3KEryQsba4PvxETH2gicy9E=&emci=206ecef2-8198-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=1c50eb50-8b98-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=8431045) ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Peter, One of my favorite parts of election season is running into someone who is wearing their “I voted” sticker. If I’m in the grocery store and catch a glimpse of a fellow shopper with a sticker, I’ll give a little thumbs up from across the produce section. I’ve even been known to shout, “I like your sticker!” to a stranger as they pass on the sidewalk. And, Peter, if I see you out at a bar and you have your sticker on — game over. Next round on me. **Voting feels good — we _should_ celebrate our democracy. But right now, we also have to do everything we can to PROTECT it. And this year that means more than just voting.** Extreme MAGA Republicans pose a critical threat to our democracy. They are actively undermining redistricting reforms, electing Election Deniers, and threatening mid-decade map redraws. [**Please make a donation today to the NDRC to help protect fair maps, combat ongoing gerrymandering, and prepare for upcoming redistricting battles.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96353770/509723124/1464966451?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_IVotedSticker_email_20241101-NDRC-Tier1-IVotedSticker_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20241101-NDRC-Tier1-IVotedSticker_&utm_campaign=IVotedSticker&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFjNTBlYjUwLThiOTgtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=CbLbZSE1sgyyxzlzKgt-3KEryQsba4PvxETH2gicy9E=) I believe, as I know you do, that this democracy is worth standing up for. Thanks so much, Brianna Brianna Shamsuddoha Director of Mobilization P.S. In my home state of Michigan, it’s the _first ever_ presidential election with early voting. You know what this means: More Michiganders voting!! AND EXTRA DAYS OF STICKERS! And this year, the Michigan Department of State hosted a sticker design contest. body: $10. That’s the donation I am asking you to split between my campaign and Tim Kaine’s campaign. I’ll explain more, but if that is all you need to hear, you can make a donation at this link below: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-kamala [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-kamala] If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: DONATE $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-kamala?express_lane=true&amount=10] DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-kamala?express_lane=true&amount=50] DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-kamala?express_lane=true&amount=100] DONATE OTHER [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-kamala] In four days, Virginia will decide who they want as their next U.S. Senator and their next President. Tim Kaine and I believe in a future where every person has the opportunity not just to get by, but to get ahead. Where no child has to grow up in poverty. Where every worker has the freedom to join a union. Where every person has affordable health care, child care, and paid leave. Where every senior can retire with dignity. But Donald Trump and his extremist Republican allies want to take our country backward. They intend to cut Social Security and Medicare, to give tax breaks to billionaires and big corporations and to make working families foot the bill, and end the Affordable Care Act. America has tried these failed policies before. We are not going back. Generations of Americans before us led the fight for freedom. Now, the baton is in our hands. To protect the right to vote. To get assault weapons off of our streets. To restore reproductive freedom, reversing Donald Trump's extreme abortion bans. Tim Kaine has spent his entire career fighting to improve the lives of everyday Virginians, and he knows there is more to be done. If you are ready to join us in the fight for freedom and opportunity for all, please split a donation of $10 to our campaigns. Because when we fight, we win. name: Mary Trump
subject: re: the house Donald Trump grew up in. -
body: | | | Friend, I'd like to talk to you about my uncle, Donald. He and his running mate JD Vance have touted so-called "family values" -- but I'm Donald's family, so I know firsthand… he has none of the values it takes to be president. The fact is, a man who refuses to say he'd veto a national abortion ban will not stand up for reproductive freedom. A man who bragged about his role in overturning _Roe v. Wade_ doesn't have the humility to support American families. And quite simply, a man who fails to respect women does not have the morals to champion them. Period. I spent much of my childhood in the same house that Donald grew up in, and this is the man I've always known: Cruel, fragile, and weak. **The fight to defeat him is deeply personal to me.** **[If you agree, please rush $5 immediately to defeat Donald's allies in the Senate. subject: You don’t need ten fingers to know right from wrong.
body: | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96356112/509730765/772549307?refcode=emaillogo&amount=25&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY0NjciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTk5NmI4MWItOGU5OC1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=53uM-lmorsayOiO5OkWOq7JVm6xQXK7seM0-6Ge-njI=) Team—it’s Jon. Can I have a moment of your time? It’s important. Voting has already started in Montana—and there are just days until Election Day. _This is it._ [**Make a split donation of $10 or more before midnight -- between my campaign and Lose Cruz \-- to help me fight back against Mitch McConnell’s attacks, reach as many Montana voters as we can, and win this race.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96356113/509730766/635992257?refcode=241101&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY0NjciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTk5NmI4MWItOGU5OC1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=53uM-lmorsayOiO5OkWOq7JVm6xQXK7seM0-6Ge-njI=) When I was a kid, I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident in my family’s butcher shop. I don’t even remember putting my hand in there— _but I can damn sure remember pulling it out._ **But here’s the truth: You don’t need ten fingers to know right from wrong.** My multimillionaire opponent Tim Sheehy is wrong for Montana. He wants to return health care to “pure privatization”, rip away women’s freedom to choose, and transfer off our public lands. Tim Sheehy is a rich out-of-stater who doesn’t know the first thing about Montana values. But he’s already dropped $2.5 million of his personal wealth to defeat me, and this race is too close for comfort. body: I’m sending out a couple of signed postcards.                                                                                                                                                             | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96357378/509734738/1328794144?refcode=ea.e8d253be-9098-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.e8d253be-9098-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU4ZDI1M2JlLTkwOTgtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0bUx43nurg4_FmHda4_EKOmAswU7JMf4IaedlTID91I=&emci=1b925bb8-9098-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=e8d253be-9098-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=4823105) --- [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96357379/509734739/824180983?refcode=ea.e8d253be-9098-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.e8d253be-9098-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU4ZDI1M2JlLTkwOTgtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0bUx43nurg4_FmHda4_EKOmAswU7JMf4IaedlTID91I=) Hi — After weeks of traveling across the country — fundraising for Vice President Kamala Harris, rallying support for our JanePAC-endorsed climate champions, and speaking to voters about what’s truly at stake in this election — I’m finally back home in California, just in time for the final stretch. On the ground this past month, I met people who are fired up and ready to elect leaders who are prepared to use every power available to address the climate crisis. Every state brought unforgettable moments, each one a reminder that our future is worth fighting for. In Washington State, I joined volunteers fighting a Big Oil-backed initiative that could strip away crucial environmental protections. In the battleground state of Arizona, I went door-to-door to support candidates for local office and reminded folks what’s at stake if Donald Trump and his allies down-ballot win. And in Michigan, I talked to voters face-to-face and shared a hug with a woman who answered the door with tears in her eyes. We talked about why this election matters so deeply, and it reminded me exactly why I’m in this fight. The hope and energy out there are _real,_ and it’s kept me going through this whirlwind election season. YOU have kept me going. **[As a small way of saying thank you, I’d like to send a couple of signed postcards from my journey after Election Day. If you can chip in to this email — even just $5 — you might find one in your mailbox as a token of my gratitude.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96357380/509734740/824180983?amount=5&refcode=ea.e8d253be-9098-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.e8d253be-9098-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU4ZDI1M2JlLTkwOTgtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0bUx43nurg4_FmHda4_EKOmAswU7JMf4IaedlTID91I=)** subject: weekend update
body: | | | | --- | | | | | --- | _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T044f7e75-fe74-468f-bd81-719e117b4a12/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._ --- | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5fc3fec7-fbe3-47f3-b1e8-a02a80278759/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Peter let's get one thing straight: The comments made about Puerto Rico at Donald Trump's rally this weekend were NOT a joke. They were racist, insulting, and entirely unacceptable. Ya no mas. Any person or party who espouses this kind of vile rhetoric against other humans — let alone citizens of the United States — is unfit to run the White House. And anyone who would tie themselves so closely to a candidate who does, like Rick Scott, has no business in any position of power — especially in Florida. [Please split $15 or more between Blue Amp Action now to help me reach my $10 million end-of-month goal and build the resources to retire him from the Senate.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tda08d6b1-35eb-4e84-9347-503916bba9d8/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) --- | | [DONATE →](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7e7e2f67-b883-419a-bb74-4abdfd594205/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) --- | And what's more, Peter, is that they know full-well that what they're doing is wrong — and they're terrified of facing the consequences. How am I so sure? Well, when I went to vote yesterday, I had the displeasure of running into Rick Scott myself, as he rallied Miami Republicans in a misguided attempt to try and intimidate me for social media clicks. As soon as he saw me there, he sped off in his chauffeured getaway car. Disappointing? Yes. Surprising? Hardly. It's just who he, Donald Trump, and the GOP are: Bigots, cowards, and losers. First, Rick took a note out of Trump's playbook when he refused to debate me. Then, he comes to my home district and doesn't even have the courage to face me, not to mention answer for his puppet-master's despicable attitudes. Now, he's panicking, and desperately trying to placate Florida's large Puerto Rican population, whose votes he's courting to win and stay in power. The best way he could earn our forgiveness now is by leaving my people in peace, starting by staying out of politics entirely. Sadly, cowards like him don't have the decency to do the right thing and leave us be. But with the massive fortune he used to buy the 2018 election, he won't leave without a groundswell of Florida voters saying ya no mas, too. And with just 4 days left in this race, I won't galvanize the movement to unseat him if I can't make my crucial $10 million goal by midnight on Thursday. In short, I can't bring him to account at the ballot box on Election Day without your grassroots support, tonight. [Will you please rush $15, or anything you can spare to split with Blue Amp Action and help me flip Florida blue, retire Rick Scott, and stop the GOP's hatred from getting ahold of the Senate majority?](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta30eb19f-50b1-480d-9ff7-2406ad2c722e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) --- | | [DONATE →](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tcdb08bcd-9310-4539-8d1c-fc12da03e184/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) --- | --- | | | Let's get this done. Right-wing authoritarianism, defeated by a worldwide coalition during WWII, was only in hibernation. Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! Last night, that determination helped us exceed our final monthly fundraising goal of this campaign. In the closing hours of October, you showed exactly why this grassroots movement is so strong. **You've been the heart of this campaign** – powering us through long days of door-knocking, sharing our message across Delaware, and showing what's possible when a community comes together with purpose and hope.
