name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: A moment of light and possibility 🎇
body: Join us in making this festival of lights truly historic.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          # [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20241101-4478-footer&t=1&akid=4478%2E420207%2EstGsbt) Peter, This week, South Asians across the world are celebrating Diwali, a festival that speaks to the deepest hopes of our community. Also known as the Festival of Lights, it’s a moment of illumination, of connection, and of profound possibility. And this year, it just so happens to coincide with an election in which we’ll have the chance to elect the first-ever South Asian as President of the United States. [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241101-2?refcode=em20241101-4478&refcode2=4478_420207_stGsbt&akid=4478%2E420207%2EstGsbt) On election night in 2016, Kamala Harris and I broke barriers together. I became the first South Asian woman ever elected to the House of Representatives, and she became the first South Asian woman ever elected to the Senate. Now we stand at the brink of an even more transformative moment. It’s not just a political milestone. It's a testament to the journey of generations of people who have worked, dreamed, and persevered to get us to this moment. Our community's story is one of resilience — of voices that refuse to be dimmed and of traditions that continue to shine brightly across continents. We see this in the vibrant celebrations happening in homes and communities across the nation. In the glow of clay lamps, in the warmth of shared meals, in the sparkle of joy that connects us. To our diverse South Asian community — Hindus, Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Jains — this is a moment to honor our collective strength. To recognize the challenges we face, the fears that sometimes shadow our experiences, and also the power we have to uplift, to support, and to create meaningful change. As we gather with family and friends, let us recommit ourselves to a future of true belonging. Where every voice matters, where every story is heard, where our collective light can transform our shared landscape. [**If you’re with us in the fight to build that future, consider splitting a donation between my campaign and Kamala Harris today. We need your support to get out the vote and elect the first South Asian president on Tuesday.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241101-2?refcode=em20241101-4478amount=3&refcode2=4478_420207_stGsbt&akid=4478%2E420207%2EstGsbt) **[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241101-2?amount=3&refcode=em20241101-4478&refcode2=4478_420207_stGsbt&akid=4478%2E420207%2EstGsbt)** From my home to yours, Happy Diwali, Peter. With hope and solidarity, Pramila Jayapal **[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20241101-4478-footer&t=2&refcode2=4478_420207_stGsbt&akid=4478%2E420207%2EstGsbt)** --- [](https://www.facebook.com/pramila.jayapal) | [](https://twitter.com/pramilajayapal) | [](https://www.instagram.com/pramilajayapal/) Email us: info@pramilaforcongress.com This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Exercising your right to vote is the cornerstone of our democracy, and being involved in the democratic process at every level is equally important. I know your contributions to this election extend far beyond just casting a ballot, which is why I want to extend my heartfelt gratitude to all the volunteers, supporters, and donors who have powered our campaign. To put all this hard work into perspective, just last week, I delivered over 7,000 handwritten postcards to the post office, and in total, our campaign has sent out more than 50,000 hand-addressed letters and postcards. Reflecting back, I am truly inspired by the remarkable support we’ve received from Republicans, Democrats, and Independents as I seek to represent all of us in District 28. --- [](https://voteshaffer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5a4998b6ce4b01517c474232e&id=8795beb717&e=8c80cba7e7) | **Have A Plan To Vote** Be sure to verify your polling location by clicking the button below. If you can spare a few hours to distribute campaign information, please reply to this email, and we’ll coordinate a convenient time and place for you. --- [](https://voteshaffer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5a4998b6ce4b01517c474232e&id=10f9c59f7c&e=8c80cba7e7) | **Pick Up Your Election Day Supplies** If you’ve signed up to assist on Election Day, please stop by the Republican office to collect your instructions, supplies, and a Shaffer T-shirt. Our office is located at 120 Church Rd, Wexford, PA 15090, and will be open during the following hours: ● Friday (11/1): 3 PM - 6 PM ● Saturday (11/2): 1 PM - 9 PM ● Sunday (11/3): 2 PM - 9 PM ● Monday (11/4): 11 AM - 8 PM If you are unable to pick up your items, we’re happy to deliver them to you. Just call or text Connor McDonald at 724-355-2045. **Election Night Celebration:** Join us for our Election Night Party at the North Park Clubhouse, starting at 8:30 PM after the polls close on Tuesday. The clubhouse is located on Route 8, across from Richland Mall (near Shop ‘N Save/Kohl’s) at 5301 Ranalli Rd, Gibsonia, PA 15044. name: Shawnna Bolick
subject: Have you voted?
body: | | | [ ](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=81ca6d468c&e=a7ab36849c) --- | | Dear Freedom Fighters, As you can imagine, I am ready for November 5th to be here-- it's less than 4 days away. The Bolick Brigade has put in the time and we know our hard work is paying off because our targeted voters are returning their early mail-in ballots. We have been stopping by voter's houses, making phone calls and texting them to return their ballots. In the process, we have been reminding early voters to take their mail-in ballots to the closest open voting center or to simply vote in-person between now and Election Day because the deadline has passed ensuring timely delivery of early ballot back to the county in time to be processed. If you still have an early mail-in ballot you would like to return, you can still drop it off at an open voting center or place it inside the nearest drop box. Today, is the last official day of early voting. Under state law, if you need to cast a ballot after today and before Election Day, the county has designated a few [emergency voting locations](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=f173cf0585&e=a7ab36849c) on November 2nd and 4th between the hours of 9am and 5pm. This year's Arizona ballot is [two pages long and double-sided](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=daf09e5b27&e=a7ab36849c), so be sure to set aside enough time to research how you will vote before going to the nearest polling location with your ID. If you vote in-person you should have received a lengthy sample ballot last week. I received my sample ballot last Wednesday in the mail and then I voted early in-person at ASU-West the following day. I tracked my ballot. It took two days for Maricopa County to receive my ballot and earlier this morning my signature was finally verified and my ballot was counted. In Maricopa County, the tabulation center is understaffed by several hundred during early voting according to a local news report. Maricopa County's ballot processing is working in 24-hour shifts to get everything tabulated, working around the clock 24/7 due to heavy turnout. If you would like to keep an eye on the Maricopa County Elections Department you can [watch their live feeds](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=24d01dc6c4&e=a7ab36849c) showing signature verification, early ballot processing and ballot tabulation. If you live in Maricopa County and you still haven't made a plan on where to vote, you can search for a location [HERE](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=af58b7868f&e=a7ab36849c). If you'd like to help our campaign make phone calls or texts to voters, please [email my campaign](mailto:info@BolickforArizona.com?subject=I%20can%20call%20or%20text%20voters)[.](mailto:info@bolickforarizona.com?subject=make%20calls%20or%20texts%20to%20voters) If you'd like to [volunteer with us this weekend](mailto:info@BolickforArizona.com?subject=volunteer%20this%20weekend) as we continue targeting Election Day voters, we will put you to work. If you have time to [help us electioneer](mailto:info@bolickforarizona.com?subject=help%20us%20electioneer) between now and Election Day at the polls, let us know. Thanks again for your continued support! Take care, Shawnna --- | [Donate](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=4c9034fdac&e=a7ab36849c "Donate") --- | | [Volunteer](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=0c94324aff&e=a7ab36849c "Volunteer") --- | --- | | | | | | | [](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=158d265a61&e=a7ab36849c) --- | | [](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=264f1919ee&e=a7ab36849c) --- | | [](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=0407f8627e&e=a7ab36849c) --- | | PAID FOR BY VOTE BOLICK. subject: There have been very few times when your donation could have a greater impact than right now
body: Kari Lake has the edge on us. She has more resources than we do. She is outspending us in a critical region of the state. And, frankly, she’s got the momentum over these final days.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Peter. Our launch day. The day Kari Lake launched her campaign. The day Kyrsten Sinema decided not to run for re-election. The day we won our primary. The day Ruben addressed the Democratic Convention. Each of those are some of the most important moments of this campaign. Each of those are moments where donations, large and small, had an absolutely massive impact on our ability to win this race. And today. Today is one of those days. Kari Lake has the edge on us. She has more resources than we do. She is outspending us in a critical region of the state. And, frankly, she’s got the momentum over these final days. We have four days to take it back. Four days for a surge in fundraising the likes of which we have never seen. Four days to do everything we possibly can to hold the line in Arizona and win this race. If we don’t get it, we could very well lose this race. So, if you’ve been waiting for the right moment… this is it. **[Make a split donation of $10 with Lucas Kunce — or anything at all that you can afford to give — and help us take the fight to Kari Lake. name: Jon Tester
subject: Brand new poll
body: | I’m in the toughest race of my life to win Montana’s Senate seat, **and a brand new poll has me tied against Tim Sheehy.** [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/83937?t=6&akid=17874%2E878179%2ERFLm4a) I can feel that the momentum is on our side and we can't afford to waste a single second of it over these next six days. I need you now more than ever: [Will you split a donation of $5 to help us finish these final days in the best possible position to win this race? >>](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/83937?t=7&akid=17874%2E878179%2ERFLm4a) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Jon Tester and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $5 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/83938?t=8&akid=17874%2E878179%2ERFLm4a) --- [CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/83939?t=9&akid=17874%2E878179%2ERFLm4a) [CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/83940?t=10&akid=17874%2E878179%2ERFLm4a) [CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/83941?t=11&akid=17874%2E878179%2ERFLm4a) [Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/83942?t=12&akid=17874%2E878179%2ERFLm4a) Look, I’m no stranger to tough elections—I won my first Senate race by less than one percentage point. But I’ve never run a race like this. Mitch McConnell is making it his #1 mission to defeat me. His big money buddies have poured in millions of dollars to boost their handpicked candidate, and flood the airwaves with attacks against me—right as Montanans vote. But today, I’m just reaching out as a mom and a Tennessean who wants to see real change happen in our state. **That’s why I am all in for Gloria Johnson.** **_[Gloria is exactly the leader Tennessee deserves, but she needs all the support we can give. Will you join me and chip in a few dollars to power her campaign in these final days?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96360750/509745240/209297649?refcode=ea.ab89ac74-9898-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.ab89ac74-9898-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYjg5YWM3NC05ODk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Eg-SMBWHQ-YVT9T3M2r5Oih6lrM4sN_gv9ibGT9v_HQ=)_** So, let’s talk about why this election matters — in plain, simple terms. Gun violence is something no family should ever have to fear, yet it’s a reality we face every day. If you’re like me, you’re done with the routine of “thoughts and prayers” without action and want leaders who will actually do something tangible to make our communities safer. **Gloria Johnson is exactly the leader we need in the U.S. Senate to achieve real solutions.** Not many politicians know what it’s like to be inside a school when the theoretical threat of gun violence becomes reality. _Gloria does_. She spent decades as a public school educator, and she confronted that threat firsthand. Gloria is not afraid to stand up and demand policies that will protect our kids, our schools, and our communities. But she’s up against Marsha Blackburn, a senator who’s consistently sided with special interests and blocked common-sense gun safety measures. With only four days until Election Day, Gloria’s team is working around the clock on their GOTV efforts to reach every last voter. They’re calling, texting, and getting the word out across Tennessee — but they need our help to keep it going strong and win this race. **_[So, I’m asking — will you chip in a few dollars of any amount today to power this final push? Every bit of support helps them mobilize Tennesseans and brings us all closer to real But Republicans have the upper hand in Nevada – and they are on the path to flipping our state red, taking back Senate control, and electing Donald Trump. **Nevadans are already voting, so we need to turn this around RIGHT NOW. subject: I’ve spent a lot of time with Tim Kaine
body: I’ve had the honor of being Tim Kaine’s friend since we met at Harvard Law School in 1980 | ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96361441/509747253/-119006532?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Kainesplit_241101_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZWM3OGViNS05OTk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XZsOuXonHb3jRFNDevebRzoS5_YQ1RFLHJHQcHlgHyY=) Derek, I’ve had the honor of being Tim Kaine’s friend since we met at Harvard Law School in 1980. For over 40 years, I’ve watched him wholeheartedly serve Virginia, first as mayor of Richmond, then as my Lieutenant Governor, and later Governor, before serving together in the United States Senate. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96361442/509747254/-119006532?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Kainesplit_241101_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZWM3OGViNS05OTk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XZsOuXonHb3jRFNDevebRzoS5_YQ1RFLHJHQcHlgHyY=) (We also make a pretty good band – here’s us jamming at the Floyd Country Store in VA) This means I’ve spent _a lot_ of time with Tim and gathered plenty of intel on him. So as I sat down to write this email **_[**asking you to support Senator Kaine’s re-election campaign,**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96361444/509747256/-119006532?amount=5&refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Kainesplit_241101_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZWM3OGViNS05OTk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XZsOuXonHb3jRFNDevebRzoS5_YQ1RFLHJHQcHlgHyY=)_** I found myself wondering exactly what I should say to you to assure you that Tim is the right choice to represent Virginia in Congress. And then it dawned on me: **I want to tell you the top 3 things that annoy me the most about Tim Kaine.** First off, Tim is way too nice! As a former civil rights attorney and missionary, he’s spent his entire career committed to social justice, being driven by the value of kindness and the belief that it can change peoples’ lives. And he’s a genuinely good guy on top of that. Second, he’s ridiculously good at playing the harmonica. Seriously, he carries them in his briefcase, just in case a jam session breaks out on the Senate floor. Third and finally, and I’ve said this before, he’s a deeply optimistic person. Sometimes I can be a glass half-empty kind of guy, but Tim’s always seems about ⅔ full. We need someone like Tim Kaine in the Senate. Tim’s value of kindness and decency is what drives his undying dedication to serving the people of Virginia. And in a Congress plagued by partisan division, Tim’s relentless optimism keeps him from giving up in the crucial fights to protect voting rights, safeguard a woman’s right to choose, and more. Now the harmonica… that one might not always translate to his work as a Senator, it’s just really great to watch. The thing is, Tim’s seat could very well determine if the GOP takes control on Tuesday. Republicans are working overtime to oust him and take back control of the Senate. **_[**So I’m asking you today if you can split a $5 donation between my campaign and Tim Kaine’s so we can send him, his kindness, impressive harmonica playing, and optimism back to the Senate?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96361446/509747258/-119006532?amount=5&refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Kainesplit_241101_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZWM3OGViNS05OTk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XZsOuXonHb3jRFNDevebRzoS5_YQ1RFLHJHQcHlgHyY=)_** subject: The most important week
body: What matters most right now is that we do whatever we can to fund a campaign that can win. That’s the most important thing. Winning this race. | | | ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         --- | | --- --- | | Peter,I have an important message that I didn’t think I’d be sending you today. In just a moment, I am going to ask you to make a contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate. November 5th is _days away_ , and I’d really appreciate the chance to explain why this request — especially today — is so critically important.Here’s the truth:Right now, we have a week of media buys to pay for — the most important week of the entire campaign. And if we don’t raise what we need now, we will be forced to give up the airwaves and let Adam Schiff and the Democrat-machine backing him up run their attacks on me unopposed.What matters most right now is that we do whatever we can to fund a campaign that can win. That’s the most important thing. Winning this race. Not just for the sake of winning, but because of what it would mean to substitute my presence with Adam Schiff’s in the Senate.That’s a reality I don’t think any of us want to consider, but it’s what will happen if we come up short.Now, time is running out. So, this is the part where I ask, one more time, and very humbly: **[Can you please use this link to make a donation to my campaign for U.S. Senate in California before Election name: AOC
subject: I’ll tell you what I believe:
body: I refuse to give up.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          # We live in a constant state of injustice. We are always struggling against systems of mass incarceration, of extreme income inequality, of late stage capitalism. Those conditions do exist. But one thing that I think is important is that we must mobilize for an affirmative vision for this country — we can’t just mobilize on fear**. We need to be clear about what the stakes are. We do. **But I don’t believe in a ‘fear only’ approach**. I’ll tell you what I believe: I believe in a bare minimum. $15 minimum wage needed to be passed several years ago. I believe in guaranteed, improved, and expanded Medicare to every single American. We can’t give up. I’ve been in that place when I was a waitress. I did spend some time giving up and being cynical and saying, “F*ck this.” And you know what it got us? Nothing. Depression, cynicism, and a sense of purposelessness. Giving up is a privilege that people just can’t afford. Movements wax and wane. And there are times when it feels like our power is waning, and it’s really easy to take our ball and go home. **But the strength of a movement really depends on the durability of it, and the commitment to it**. That black pill of cynicism is the death of movements, not the birth of them. name: Carrie Anne Templeton
subject: Forward Friends: Volunteer Updates
body: News you can use this election season!                                                                                                                                                                                                              | | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=JgyyvCfQwldlSeD7KJl_Ih7269o_4hwqOhPs1_PHvgI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_6&n=1) ---  Friday, November 01, 2024 | Peter-- Here is your weekly **Forward Friends** volunteer update! The election is only 4 days away, hopefully you have already cast your ballot or made your plan to vote. I'd like to encourage everyone to text 3 friends or family members, and make sure they cast their vote too. _Last Week’s Highlights:_ You guys have been on fire this week! Over _100,000_ text messages went out since last Friday! With your help 6 more candidate campaigns were completed. We had a wonderful evening Wednesday night with Gov Whitman and Lindsey Williams Drath introducing more of our amazing candidates during Meet the Forwardists 2. Thank you so much to everyone who joined us, if you missed it the recording will be available soon. _Upcoming Opportunities:___ We still have about **13,000** texts that need to go out before Tuesday, the sooner the better! You can watch our [4 minute training video](https://home.forwardparty.com/voter_outreach_text_phone_banking?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_6&n=2), follow the prompts in the email from Forward upon completion, and then you will receive an email from CallHub to get started. If you need more assistance please respond to this message and I will help! * Monday November 4th we will have [Monday Night Madness](meet.google.com/ssu-wudq-uxd) at 8pm ET. If there are no remaining texts we can work on survey responses for data, so please join! * Utah is hosting an election night [watch party](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=4h2u19b4cTAhgCD-RT-MfucisWAapKTztiYbrCzE4E2sDznYXoA3RfZqhljjD0-e1scnmDE8lxy0N5kW7iPAIiBjmvByHMc1XhInXYHISVA&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_6&n=3) in Salt Lake City from 7-11pm. * **Maryland** is having a [post-election social](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=xWBO20UkZAmlbQAE537pzTFWzUi0z7NcXzZvOsIJ7zueD6fPZI3prwdPjjB8Lfg20AKMJrV0PPzOYQEDX-vuM05sN_APVlndaQ5oR88my8w&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_6&n=4) in Baltimore on 11/14. * The states need volunteers for last minute canvassing and polling place support! [Find where you can get involved.](https://home.forwardparty.com/volunteer_find_your_state?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_6&n=5) * We want to see what you're up too! Take pictures of yourselves canvassing, going to vote, or watching results and post them with #2024ward so we can share! And stay on top of the [events page](https://home.forwardparty.com/public_calendar?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_6&n=6) many states will be holding post election debriefs you can participate in. _Candidate Spotlight:_ This week I would like to bring your attention to our candidate **Jevona Armstrong** in South Carolina. She is running for Beaufort County Council District 1, as a write in. We featured her on our Meet the Forwardists Part 2 this past week, and I was struck by her passion, not just for serving her community, but for continuing the work of building the Forward Party in SC after the election, regardless of her race's outcome. You can learn more about her [here.](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=GeXqj6rOijKqZ60xcJKZpxRAILcwG68UKiI8h5jMUJg&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_6&n=7) As always thank you so much for all the support. I am blown away at how many texts we have managed to send out, and can't wait to see the direct impact that work has on those races. Make sure to tune in next week when I report victories! body: With all this noise, it is easy to lose sight of what is important | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96362850/509751623/-201694504?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NTFmZjQ1Yi05ZDk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CorvnSV19P-sSoI1pluXVxgZcbobk4_ygBIpZ9xQ9SQ=&emci=3f1e401b-9698-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=951ff45b-9d98-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=9494239) --- | | This month, we have spent a lot of time campaigning, talking about next week's election, and emphasizing the urgency around taking back the House. House Speaker Mike Johnson's comments this week are a prime example of why Democrats need control of the House. This week, during a GOP campaign event, Speaker Johnson indicated that if Republicans gain control of the presidency in 2024, they will pursue "massive reform" to the ACA as part of a "very aggressive" first 100-day agenda. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96362851/509751624/1596212816?refcode=2024-11-01-aca&recurring=&amount=9&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=951ff45b-9d98-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NTFmZjQ1Yi05ZDk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CorvnSV19P-sSoI1pluXVxgZcbobk4_ygBIpZ9xQ9SQ=) The Affordable Care Act (ACA) has been a lifeline for Washingtonians, improving health outcomes, offering financial security, and enabling equitable access to health care across diverse communities in the state. **Make no mistake: the Chaos Caucus**** _still_****wants to undermine critical health care programs and unwind health insurance regulations and safeguards despite the overwhelming support for the program.** **ACA enrollment has hit a historic level, with 21.3 million people opting for ACA marketplace coverage during the Open Enrollment Period.** This statistic includes more than five million people — about a fourth — who are new to the ACA Marketplace and 16 million people who renewed their existing ACA coverage. **With enrollment reaching a record high and millions of American families relying on the ACA for coverage, it simply does not make sense that the Chaos Caucus' agenda is to repeal this landmark legislation.** Rolling back the ACA would not just rip away critical care from the 21.3 million folks using Marketplace plans — **but 45 million Americans could lose their health insurance provided through other provisions of the ACA**. Think young adults afforded the option to stay on their parents' plans until age 26, people suffering from pre-existing conditions that could legally be denied care, and more. We cannot let this happen to the millions of people relying on the ACA. We must take back the House next week. ****[**Our final weekend Get-Out-The-Vote canvassing efforts start tomorrow. The far-right's eagerness to roll back health care in America — to a time of runaway corporate profits, coverage denials, and politicians inserting their extreme ideology between you and your health care provider — is not new. Extremists voted upwards of 50 times to repeal the ACA. **Time and again, my Republican colleagues in the House propose a budget that would destroy this life-saving legislation.** We will not let that stand. I believe health care is a right. As always, we are going to fight back for Washingtonians and the millions of Americans who benefit from the provisions of the ACA. That is why I voted to reduce premiums for ACA members and am actively working to expand access to high-quality, affordable health care that fits Northwest Washington families' budgets. That is why I am continuing to work to lower the costs of prescription drugs. I voted to reduce prescription drug costs by letting Medicare negotiate drug prices, by imposing a tax penalty if drug companies increase their prices faster than inflation, and by capping the price of insulin at $35 per month. Millions of Americans are counting on us. **This is the type of policy-making that has a tangible impact on Northwest Washington, and we must protect the ACA in Congress.** Your support now means I can continue this important work in 2025. body: Hey, Jane Fonda here. With Election Day right around the corner, I’m reaching out to see if you will join the Jane Fonda Climate PAC and PCCC in supporting a slate of climate champions in the final stretch of this critical election. [_**I want to tell you more about why I’m so excited to support these candidates, but first, can you chip in $20 to split a contribution for these candidates ahead of Election Day?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96363002/509752303/165661984?refcode=email_110124_salinas-fonda-split&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YjM0ZmQyZS05ZTk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=L595gXQEYk7llhKtqs4UjdB9E6b6BxkmgNZOwqLUYIQ=) I’m excited to team up with the PCCC to support a slate of incredible climate candidates running in competitive congressional races who are committed to tackling the climate crisis, including standing up to powerful special interests like the fossil fuel industry. These candidates need our help: * **Andrea Salinas is running for re-election in Oregon’s 6th Congressional District**. In Congress Andrea has been a tireless champion for our environment and the well-being of the entire Pacific Northwest. She’s fighting for a clean energy future for her daughter and all Americans. In 2022 Andrea won by less than three points, so it’s critical we defend her seat this year. * **Kristen McDonald Rivet is running to flip Michigan’s 8th Congressional District**. In the state senate, Kristen helped pass ambitious clean energy legislation to address the climate crisis, create clean jobs, and save Michiganders money. She also secured funding to replace lead pipes and ensure kids have clean drinking water at schools. * **Dave Min is running for California’s 47th Congressional District**. As a state senator, Dave chaired the Natural Resources and Water Committee and introduced legislation to terminate offshore oil and gas leases and secured funding to improve beaches. Corporate special interests and far-right extremists are pouring millions into these races to defeat these progressive climate champions. For the sake of our environment and electing a pro-environment Congress, we must have their backs. [_**Can you help us ensure these climate champions have the resources they need to win? Your support – whether it’s $5, $10, or $50 – makes a HUGE difference in building a movement to protect our planet’s health.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96363003/509752304/165661984?refcode=email_110124_salinas-fonda-split&amounts=5,10,25,50,100,250,500&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YjM0ZmQyZS05ZTk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=L595gXQEYk7llhKtqs4UjdB9E6b6BxkmgNZOwqLUYIQ=) name: Ruben Gallego
subject: We did not come this far to lose to Kari Lake.
body: #                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 Peter — When I was in Iraq, in urban combat, we had a special knock we’d use when we were surrounded by insurgents. The comfort in that knock was knowing that while danger was all around you, the person on the other side of the door was friendly — someone you could depend on. I’ve never been afraid to ask for help when I needed it. And right now, I’m knocking. I’m coming to you for help, Peter. Kari Lake is on the offense. With just a few days until voting ends, she has a resource advantage over us. She’s got more money to spend, and she is funneling all of it into a massive surge. She’s outspending us on television in one of the most important regions of the state. **But I refuse to let her win.** I did not swear an oath to support and defend the Constitution to lose against someone who has spread more lies and disinformation about our elections than any other politician in the country after Trump himself. [**If you’re with me, donate $20.24.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-nov24.6f99Bw&refcode=em241101-4-160&t=1&akid=3510%2E734936%2EKJDVXX) I did not lose some of my best friends in combat to cede the democracy they fought for to Trump, Lake, and the MAGA Right. This election is bigger than just who controls the House, the Senate, or the White House. It is about ensuring our democracy survives for our kids and our grandkids. [**If you’re with me, donate $20.24.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-nov24.6f99Bw&refcode=em241101-4-160&t=2&akid=3510%2E734936%2EKJDVXX) In the toughest times of my life, I have been incredibly fortunate to have the support I needed to get through. My mom, my sisters, my community, my Marines. body: “Democracy is the right that protects the rest.” | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96363843/509754973/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjNmNWE1MmQyLWEwOTgtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ANnhwuWmvR5W5nMqPCj6z3z97UA4FOb1TpnQJiRtnhg=&emci=686f6e4e-6e98-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=3f5a52d2-a098-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=8431045) ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  What's the one thing you care about most about this election process, Peter? Is it making sure everyone has access to quality, affordable health care, including the right to an abortion? Reforming the criminal justice system? Reducing the gun violence that plagues our schools and communities? Dealing with the urgent threat of climate change? If we’re going to make progress on any of the important issues that we care most about, we NEED to protect fair maps and combat ongoing gerrymandering. name: Hung Cao
subject: Knock knock knock
body: | | | [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=39f70aa5afd946029c49c2b14acb4a80&_e=NbF-skVtbOz-Lm2MK2FWG4nzuDb5KjoThGhEIyibI7TPx4sySeFccyXHddugKBbsKAYexWqBsqYJ2IzASbD7De1dA9H1WWLoaUvkdnRIuFM48gU_R3GPazmHJUHhZX2OmpU8FJBJsFVzZPlTGoWxGMfp2uenBxMuxFevjcNwW9JDmJT_qi-G_TkD_QE2EhiTrBWl0FrMkp4Fe2NNnaSJ9vRK8SlvDypHDjFVPODCIcJT-Mu5BV2crxXf2nJ3OsFPqWkFOkpKHRUns3fhA6aoyved7nFsvTxMlCBDZDbhm6jmoNvzg-OFp5g3gUIE30cthafswN5HNJR2fpIJCqBSPSKvkeFSL__FSW7z28Poz1IIfqwwIGs1GfzSln_KYJVX) --- **Knock, knock, knock.** _It’s the scariest sound you’ll hear when you live in a communist country._ _It’s the last sound my parents heard when their fathers were taken away._ _It’s the sound of always living in fear, and it’s my family’s real-life story._ We escaped from Vietnam just days before Saigon fell to the communists, and we were given a new life in the most generous country on Earth. **America saved my life, and I dedicated my life to paying her back.** I graduated from the United States Naval Academy and served for 25 years in Navy Special Operations in Iraq, Afghanistan, Somalia, and Pakistan and 40 other countries around the world. I love this country - but right now, it’s taken a dark turn. Now, the knocks are coming from Joe Biden’s Department of Justice. Sending two dozen armed agents to arrest a pro-life activist in front of his family. Raiding gun shops and seizing records from law-abiding gun owners. Arresting his challenger in the next election. _And he’s doing it all while real criminals are free to roam our streets._ We are losing our country. You know it. But you also know we can save it. body: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-gallego [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-gallego] When I was in Iraq, in urban combat, we had a special knock we’d use when we were surrounded by insurgents. I’ve never been afraid to ask for help when I needed it. And right now, I’m knocking. I’m coming to you for help. Kari Lake is on the offense. With just a few days until voting ends, she has a resource advantage over us. She’s got more money to spend, and she is funneling all of it into a massive surge. She’s outspending us on television in one of the most important regions of the state. But I refuse to let her win. I did not swear an oath to support and defend the Constitution to lose against someone who has spread more lies and disinformation about our elections than any other politician in the country after Trump himself. If you’re with me, donate $20. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-gallego] I did not lose some of my best friends in combat to cede the democracy they fought for to Trump, Lake, and the MAGA Right. Rashida Tlaib, Cori Bush, Ilhan Omar, and Summer Lee are putting pressure on President Biden to explain why his administration deployed U.S. troops to Israel without congressional authorization. They warn a member can force a vote to remove troops from the region. André Carson, Ilhan Omar, Summer Lee joined. Our progressive champions for peace are leading the way on this issue once again by holding this administration accountable for ignoring the law and continuing to enable right-wing Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s genocide against Palestinians. Despite the War Powers Resolution of 1973 requiring Congressional approval to send troops to war, President Biden has provided Israel with U.S. soldiers on the ground, as well as billions of dollars worth of weapons and bombs used to carry out war crimes, all while Israel has largely blocked food and other humanitarian aid from reaching Palestinians in need — which violates federal and international law. In their letter to the President, Rashida, Cori, Ilhan, and Summer made it clear that he “cannot continue to ignore the law without Congressional intervention,” and warned that a member of Congress can introduce a resolution and force a vote to remove U.S. forces from Israel. But I thought a little reminder would be helpful, especially contrasted with who Rick Scott is 🤢. Maybe it will even motivate you to **[make your very first online donation](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96365475/509760932/849749119?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2476-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzUyMzY5YjUtYTU5OC1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=aXEJynEjUaGsJqRIlHPxElkbD99cXWiTrMP_Q2ek7FY=)** before tonight's fundraising deadline to ensure I can defeat Rick Scott! First and foremost, I'm everything I am today because of my mother. She brought my sisters and me to America when I was just 14. Mom knew we had to get out of Ecuador, which was transitioning to democracy after suffering under a military dictatorship. She knew America was the key to a better life. Well, with a whole lot of hard work (including working in a doughnut shop to help my family get by), long hours, and a ton of hope, we were able to win our American dream. My story is what inspires me to give back to this incredible country and state that gave me so much. After putting myself through college, I worked for several nonprofit organizations across Florida, helping to **protect our wildlife and preserve our coral reefs**. Rick Scott, on the other hand, banned saying the words "climate change" when he was governor of Florida, and the League of Conservation Voters gave him a whopping 0% score last year. During my time working at Florida International University, I spearheaded a new program to **expand affordable health care access** to more Floridians. But Rick Scott has voted to repeal the Affordable Care Act more times than I care to count. And who can forget he committed one of the largest Medicare frauds in the history of our country. Eventually, I had the honor of serving my community in the U.S. House of Representatives, where I became the first South American immigrant to be elected to Congress! In the House, I wrote the bill to **expand seniors’ Medicare Advantage coverage** , worked with Republicans to provide **economic relief** to families and small businesses, and secured $200 million for **Everglades restoration**. I'm proud of my record — but can Rick Scott say the same, friend? He has used his time in office writing the plan to end Social Security and Medicare, attempting to undermine our elections, attacking our rights, and making it harder for working families to get ahead. **As a result, Rick Scott's approval ratings with Floridians are underwater. Even a large percentage of Republicans don't approve of him! Now, polling shows me statistically tied with Scott, and in just 4 days, we can defeat him and protect our Democratic Senate majority in the process.** **[But with Rick Scott outspending me 3-1 on the airwaves, it's going to take a surge in grassroots support from people like you to truly defeat him. name: Keith Ellison
subject: If you’re considering sitting out this election because of Gaza
body: Peter, I suspect the majority of you reading this email have already voted or have made a plan to vote for Kamala Harris for President and Tim Walz for Vice President. If so, thank you, and please sign up for a GOTV shift at https://www.mobilize.us/2024mnvictory/! You don’t need to read this email any further. But I am aware some of you may be considering sitting this election out, or voting for a third-party candidate, because you strongly disagree with Kamala Harris about Gaza. This email is for you. Please read on. We have many things in common. Like you, I am outraged by the suffering in Gaza: the massive and indiscriminate loss of life, the displacement of millions of people, the deliberate destruction of hospitals, the use of food as a weapon, all of it. Every nation, including Israel, has the right to defend itself, and all hostages must be released now. But no nation, including Israel, has the right to collectively punish another people, including the people of Gaza. But that is what has happened, and like you, I believe American policy has not done enough to stop it. Now to Kamala Harris. Kamala Harris has said she’s for a cease fire. She’s said she’s for more humanitarian relief now. She stands for international human-rights laws, and she has the active support of members of Congress who are insisting on the enforcement of international human-rights law. And she has publicly called out Rudy Giuliani’s violent rhetoric about Palestinian children at Trump’s racist Madison Square Garden rally. And as she said in her speech in Washington on Tuesday night, she will listen to everyone, including people who disagree with her. I’ve known her for years, so I know from personal experience that this is true. On the other hand, Donald Trump, who put in place the illegal Muslim ban as president, has said he’ll let Benjamin Netanyahu “finish the job.” Donald Trump, whose own chief of staff says he is a fascist, has promised to deploy the military against constitutional protest and be a dictator on Day One. So if you care about the people of Gaza — and the right to protest about Gaza — you don’t want Donald Trump in power. Now I doubt any of you reading this email plan to vote for Donald Trump. But — and this is critical — if you sit this election out, or if you vote for a third-party candidate who will not win, you are letting Donald Trump get one vote closer to power. Donald Trump in power will increase suffering in Gaza and the world. If Kamala Harris is elected, we will have someone in the White House who will use the powers of the presidency to alleviate suffering at home and abroad, not increase it. Just as importantly, we will have someone in the White House with whom we can be in dialogue, not someone who will turn our country against us. Don’t take only it from me. Senator Bernie Sanders supports Kamala Harris even though he strongly disagrees with current Gaza policy, because he believes that Kamala in the White House is the best chance to change that policy. Hear more: https://x.com/berniesanders/status/1851040553745432775?s=42 Georgia State Rep. Ruwa Romman supports Kamala Harris for the same reason. Hear more: https://www.rollingstone.com/politics/political-commentary/ruwa-romman-harris-dnc-gaza-uncommitted-vote-1235144105/ Nada Elmikashfi of Wisconsin, a Sudanese American and Muslim activist and political organizer who supports the people of Gaza, supports Kamala Harris because she believes that supporting Harris — and not a third-party candidate — is the only way to keep Trump from making everything she cares about worse and harming far more communities than her own. Hear more: https://x.com/nadaelmikashfi/status/1851465420097585482?s=10 And former President Jimmy Carter, who brokered the Camp David accords and has worked tirelessly for more than 40 years for a comprehensive peace in the Middle East that includes dignity, opportunity, and self-determination for Palestinians, supports Kamala Harris. I strongly encourage you to listen to them. And finally, even as Gaza is first in many of our thoughts, even more is at stake in this election. Racial justice, abortion rights, climate change, and economic fairness: it’s all on the ballot, along with the very soul of this country. Trump’s racist Madison Square Garden rally leaves no more room for doubt about that. For the sake of all the people that would bear the brunt of Donald Trump’s deliberate cruelty, and for the best chance of building a better future for the people of Gaza, the Middle East, the United States, and the world, I am asking you not to sit this out: I am asking for your vote for Kamala Harris for President and Tim Walz for Vice President. - Keith Prepared and paid for by the Keith Ellison for Attorney General committee, PO Box 17224, Minneapolis, MN 55417 Keith Ellison for Attorney General PO Box 17224 Minneapolis, MN 55417 United States If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please unsubscribe: https://secure.ngpvan.com/p/rnmAh_BZp0CUaBw6XYl7Xw2?unsubscribedata=2W3VAJdw0Km2QlWjWSNn5jILNXUrlnEvliKA4k45I5pVyuqoBa4Y3UFm3BhbuqHtqqYrTIxbuJjziosllmOXfejlaoFG7D3AFDxJQG93VgilTx6DNsKdZMq%2FC2O3PQ%2F7BSpw91OasYmadv2hVJ%2F4elgiqlhVrEn8xl2lKfAyhd87jzDY6fFGwvfYWo7%2BOwui6dGaOsBEWAoyDu%2BaV7KBvNKX8hASP2M4qjbsfyGIzPQ7TxfTZTFaQgp3IYTwE9WBLAlxcSLEA5OK5pJjTWRqM6PnUTx%2B%2BQtqhSH6S%2B5v6nmHFpYEVkzLQ0tDTItkioUCjKTmQHt%2Bg9VoP1RJTtAVnAuUK8ObOKuEtRLoGf9z8Vv%2B9lwyIdQN0jkW8gZoR6D0H3taZ70cUxj55pabsOMrgUZPOCStGYjYt%2B55QwokiuMqRzJHxx8BVU5cxIFJ4Thh .

name: Katie Porter
subject: What you can control
body: # [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=39253%2E3422442%2E4ZkRXw) Derek, _**A lot is happening this week**_ —it may be the most stressful week of the year. With the stakes so high, it is human nature to be worried, even if you can’t control what’s happening. Put that restless energy to work, and _**focus on what you can control.**_ At this stage in campaigns, the only thing that matters is voter contact. Here’s how you can help: 1. **[Chip in](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20241101?refcode=em20241101-39253&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39253_3422442_4ZkRXw&akid=39253%2E3422442%2E4ZkRXw): **Your donation helps campaigns keep up their communications until polls close. Campaigns make projections based on how much money they think they’ll raise; if they have a shortfall, they may have to scale back the pace of their advertising.****[Donate to a campaign you care about, or chip in to Truth to Power to help us get our endorsed candidates over the finish line. ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20241101?refcode=em20241101-39253&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39253_3422442_4ZkRXw&akid=39253%2E3422442%2E4ZkRXw)** ** 2. **[Volunteer](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21197?source=em20241101-39253&t=2&akid=39253%2E3422442%2E4ZkRXw):** Knocking on doors is the best, most effective form of voter contact there is. If you have a couple hours to spare before Election Day, sign up for a canvassing shift or two. How many people we’re able to get to the polls in California swing seats could decide which party controls the House. **[Visit mobilize.us to find volunteer opportunities near you.](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21197?source=em20241101-39253&t=3&akid=39253%2E3422442%2E4ZkRXw)** Even though I’m not on the ballot this November, I’ve still been raising money and knocking on doors for candidates in California I believe in: [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21197?source=em20241101-39253&t=4&akid=39253%2E3422442%2E4ZkRXw) I know that elections have a way of making folks lose perspective. During my first campaign, I briefly thought that an unexpected package on my doorstep could be a secret Republican tracking device. (It was actually my son, with my credit card, ordering himself an Xbox without permission.) My advice to avoid being overwhelmed: spend a day door knocking and then take some well-earned time for self-care. One of my most important stops: **_**campaigning in Ohio with Bernie Moreno.** _ ** [](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=a3b7abe0f9a7463f8f9917475c26ccac&_e=cIkDLLkbZkatV2cbLm8elRqcdLhb0uQ2qUVvoi6ij41zhRpJ2BDWMNRlM21h_kDGEDCtk_CDkVVtsI5PIBLrWxf93XGolVzOUBRqZnH9nM0-clzHS05wyNURoYsF4AXyS2DSJg_gZ5H3bJpg6HETiwP8hZcD575KfayJBCU70b0lVAG2NwNJqyKCPe28IVlaiKplA4E8XxEBpcY3Jpy6sm2nWu8CIj454b6ewteAPlfSvANnMp5cgkzrJPcUUZxdgevKGiDr6nmzML_ZVBo9MOCMF0MNHz-tW858daoDGMpp_6wEV2yC-YmCJskTEZIvdUTGvYVH1PQoGLlR2LbCN_ORR-PifcextA-z0Pb2bA2C6izRMNVQqS8wN-6vOTe4fnjeYMqL_z-j11pCYeq28A%3D%3D) President Trump and a Senate Republican majority will end the disastrous Biden-Harris agenda, but we cannot win a Senate majority without winning in Ohio. [**Will you join me in supporting political outsider, Bernie Moreno?**](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=a3b7abe0f9a7463f8f9917475c26ccac&_e=cIkDLLkbZkatV2cbLm8elRqcdLhb0uQ2qUVvoi6ij41zhRpJ2BDWMNRlM21h_kDGEDCtk_CDkVVtsI5PIBLrWxf93XGolVzOUBRqZnH9nM0-clzHS05wyNURoYsF4AXyS2DSJg_gZ5H3bJpg6HETiwP8hZcD575KfayJBCU70b0lVAG2NwNJqyKCPe28IVlaiKplA4E8XxEBpcY3Jpy6sm2nWu8CIj454b6ewteAPlfSvANnMp5cgkzrJPcUUZxdQttko6ongWmWQtjok0Tt4rOqVKYsPFb6Y2WRQhbvAOUPfCfTCKzR47ClPB3wzdPHFLcfjdYnfqLhYArUlF-7-1h-6emI1Tma0YYcPWtFJAYfexRg3G7nyyzVhw4Hugf9XNCsOdknTIucIvQX2iN1xQ%3D%3D) Bernie Moreno is the type of Senator we need in Washington. He’s lived the American dream - and wants to make sure our grandkids have the same opportunities he had when he came to America at the age of five. He hasn’t made a career as a Washington insider - just the opposite. He’s an entrepreneur who built a successful business from the ground up. This November, we’ve got a great map—unlike anything we’ve seen in a few decades—and with high-quality candidates like Bernie, I know we can win back the Republican majority in the Senate. body: I am thrilled to invite you to our election night victory party at Baldoria On The Water in Lakewood, CO on Tuesday November 5th... | | | | [](https://ghwh6lbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0019vPYcIDuiDKH_v0AbqpPuVqqEzNdWwWW8SEac6eSs9HPYvh7yFnveVTj5qdwXsEmMG8_PhpWYVCkhRr5guqoSR_4V1V8rk-wKGQxJJbASoa0NlYzXEFRHuaqn3ICHu7TlW3H7Jyb9XC0wZ8CG7I3pQ==&c=VUfKToxqrcthIMLuQ6WCOXJSz3LyXqefD6WSEcX4BDlTVOwOecpLAQ==&ch=bAoCgdhNTzM7tKhyWBOkcVqrLJKWcy2hohzpVPeqxQmznacevytyIg==) --- --- | Friend, I wanted to remind you to join Team Imer on Election Night in Lakewood, CO, as we watch President Trump be elected as our country's 47th President! War Room access and additional ticket options are also available. body: Here's where we're at, Peter: | | |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     --- [ ](https://click.contact.kamalaharris.com/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqtYXn23Vc47XoqSNCs0I8w8tkJkn-ZRihM7l-2lKANZKQ4lz_ihMUs7-JknfhicoMHTPf7JepfZa7Uf9Xff5wbamU5S2-EGjE6EPtuJM2E_eCc-q1dsViHziAES38M8g0bqli5KV48C2tyCNeBB4gstBGAU2OVXxZ3lOmBsxgCkUNB33tM4SaWBGqQeXL0gV4M4gIdmON92Bw6x3ohu2KpIqHf8UX6NffJ0KIE_BZ77hmw0XNaQasKOjzGNTTkLwvTnOnTu1zBizsdyC_rBkT6ReK2WVFhoErVU8USli081hh1s3-754Cv0jn4p4FF2g-I/4b3/16Rv68HATdy8axnjpwLjLw/h0/h001.DtP1sDq9v4Gijjw31kEDakBtvdKfzXycEuD_srcfJgw) Here's where we're at, Peter. We know the final voters we have to reach and get to the polls in battleground states. They are Democrats, but they don't vote in most elections. There are a lot of them. **But right now, we don't have the resources to turn out enough of them to win.** So, we need everyone -- yes, everyone -- to make a contribution to Kamala Harris's campaign today. body: | | | [](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=195e685f69234cc4aa26f22ae2ab031c&_e=yXGc-K7PfuqJ_yd9whMUKNbUTE_N5FsQ_UadHSdFlK5VMWa0501I-_IGy-Mhc6YXpIYWVTpkTwY9enRAQS7YC8Kj9oAZQsYtZmse6tAeY-W5MngQnJzUvQ4rQfAUQZ5Cfgr2rJS1LemPFSJFHu7273Le1y9_w3R-lz3o3R0Clbgugg1Zz_j8dHanDkIqVOYe_nS7Q2vhbQse4LV1qtRSQyXhobtSqEJYRV6O_uPxoQgkI9h89F9DMuBxZ2xAvPQHOZGwVbYxxUvXL3NP4JDqj65QwlfEcktSK43ssH0XFMH2TQFIQJSCdT99GQ1hWLKcxwHcHvrss198APbcgmyiLGQP0uJnY_w-WQZmQ9drSxJnO-K0c5rnTis9ubLlp291) --- **Knock, knock, knock.** _It’s the scariest sound you’ll hear when you live in a communist country._ _It’s the last sound my parents heard when their fathers were taken away._ _It’s the sound of always living in fear, and it’s my family’s real-life story._ We escaped from Vietnam just days before Saigon fell to the communists, and we were given a new life in the most generous country on Earth. **America saved my life, and I dedicated my life to paying her back.** I graduated from the United States Naval Academy and served for 25 years in Navy Special Operations in Iraq, Afghanistan, Somalia, and Pakistan and 40 other countries around the world. I love this country - but right now, it’s taken a dark turn. Now, the knocks are coming from Joe Biden’s Department of Justice. Sending two dozen armed agents to arrest a pro-life activist in front of his family. Raiding gun shops and seizing records from law-abiding gun owners. Arresting his challenger in the next election. _And he’s doing it all while real criminals are free to roam our streets._ We are losing our country. You know it. But you also know we can save it. I’ve been all over the world. Believe me when I tell you, if America fails, there is nowhere else to go. **It’s time to save America while we still have a chance.** **I’m Hung Cao, retired Navy Captain, and I’m running for the United States Senate.** **[If you’re all-in to defend the greatest country on Earth, join our team today.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=195e685f69234cc4aa26f22ae2ab031c&_e=yXGc-K7PfuqJ_yd9whMUKNbUTE_N5FsQ_UadHSdFlK5VMWa0501I-_IGy-Mhc6YXpIYWVTpkTwY9enRAQS7YC8Kj9oAZQsYtZmse6tAeY-W5MngQnJzUvQ4rQfAUQZ5Cfgr2rJS1LemPFSJFHu7273Le1y9_w3R-lz3o3R0Clbgugg1Zz_j8dHanDkIqVOYe_nS7Q2vhbQse4LV1qtRSQyXhobtSqEJYRV6O_uPxoQhVF3s4JxHeuTKOEY3kBtrIs9wBhQyfyv38OlN5ZeqfnbJRzjVbZd78bOGby4s7LOhkKlmofAi0LkSd2AVNS3coQhYE6RjVErYUXkcg2FwX3C7zl7dlM_C8DkrlDdQ51PehYkunb7hhz6_OApoRGWc6)** --- [**JOIN THE TEAM - STAND WITH ME TODAY**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=195e685f69234cc4aa26f22ae2ab031c&_e=yXGc-K7PfuqJ_yd9whMUKNbUTE_N5FsQ_UadHSdFlK5VMWa0501I-_IGy-Mhc6YXpIYWVTpkTwY9enRAQS7YC8Kj9oAZQsYtZmse6tAeY-W5MngQnJzUvQ4rQfAUQZ5Cfgr2rJS1LemPFSJFHu7273Le1y9_w3R-lz3o3R0Clbgugg1Zz_j8dHanDkIqVOYe_nS7Q2vhbQse4LV1qtRSQyXhobtSqEJYRV6O_uPxoQi9Jld32dZbA_wgsvtWUAEBfmvW0qkiWHtzF2YiwMCMu81CuYx8JGtavbtRNO0o-Bfm98zlzqOOoIpnFvabxB1QC6S16EqN9t1ib2CjB-i9EXf9SxqTmQvPslw4oH5acLvDwVk8KNcZ3gXzRna8a-0P) --- I still believe America can be the land of opportunity, Fellow Patriot. And as someone who owes their life to the American Dream, I have an obligation to fight back against those who have trampled on it. We need REAL fighters. Not politicians, not bureaucrats, and not keyboard warriors acting tough in custom made suits. If we’re going to preserve our freedoms, we can’t be intimidated. We must be fearless. **[It’s time to fight for the American greatness that lies within us. Join our team today - because I know you haven’t given up on America yet either.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=195e685f69234cc4aa26f22ae2ab031c&_e=yXGc-K7PfuqJ_yd9whMUKNbUTE_N5FsQ_UadHSdFlK5VMWa0501I-_IGy-Mhc6YXpIYWVTpkTwY9enRAQS7YC8Kj9oAZQsYtZmse6tAeY-W5MngQnJzUvQ4rQfAUQZ5Cfgr2rJS1LemPFSJFHu7273Le1y9_w3R-lz3o3R0Clbgugg1Zz_j8dHanDkIqVOYe_nS7Q2vhbQse4LV1qtRSQyXhobtSqEJYRV6O_uPxoQimlXwCJ4jy8thO8FQDSqR68-YFxV9um98HGtscOY7MJwxdlDmUK7X7XqkDXP4PNy-yJOmabFZc6SGK0VUpnVhiyBd2XnT8eL13OBOV8ZLo34iXdMayCsm9_SEIStfKuNW-kr3xJYulXgnZT3osojQo)** --- [**JOIN THE TEAM - STAND WITH ME TODAY**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=195e685f69234cc4aa26f22ae2ab031c&_e=yXGc-K7PfuqJ_yd9whMUKNbUTE_N5FsQ_UadHSdFlK5VMWa0501I-_IGy-Mhc6YXpIYWVTpkTwY9enRAQS7YC8Kj9oAZQsYtZmse6tAeY-W5MngQnJzUvQ4rQfAUQZ5Cfgr2rJS1LemPFSJFHu7273Le1y9_w3R-lz3o3R0Clbgugg1Zz_j8dHanDkIqVOYe_nS7Q2vhbQse4LV1qtRSQyXhobtSqEJYRV6O_uPxoQi6S2zu-KfmYuc3tJfUgGBEuK8WJGWCeY4Y9KabfAGN2kNsVQEF1syZafS9jEehRQhQ2MY-XTDdpiaQZL_l5rjfCgDyYqb4tM8rIDnrszFJdcslCmFF0AvcS4zZsvFIN5r093saTKGnVjWgH2r_bHFr) --- Let’s win this. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Your conversations with voters this weekend can add up to swing a whole state.
body: The work we put in this weekend will determine the outcome of the presidential election ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ | | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2404%2E4032634%2EAhE-I2) --- It’s go-time. If you’ve been meaning to volunteer for the Harris campaign, now is the moment. This is the final weekend before Election Day, and we’ve got two full days — or as the Swifties for Harris coalition would put it, 288 All Too Well (10 Minute Version)’s — to connect with and turn out voters. [**Click here to see the best volunteer opportunities near you, and pitch in a few hours to help set the direction of our nation for the next few generations. The work we put in this weekend will determine the outcome of this election.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2804?t=8&akid=2404%2E4032634%2EAhE-I2) | [**YES, I'LL VOLUNTEER**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2804?t=9&akid=2404%2E4032634%2EAhE-I2) --- One conversation with a voter could determine whether or not they make a plan to cast their ballot. A few ballots per precinct could add up to swing a whole state. And one state’s electoral votes could make the difference between President Kamala Harris (it feels wonderful to type those words) or four more years of Donald Trump in the White House (you know how it feels to read those words). This fight won’t be easy — but if we run uphill with joy and courage in our hearts, we can get it done. As Vice President Harris often says: _“When we fight, we win.”_ [**Take a look to see where you can get involved this weekend. Even if you’ve never volunteered for a political campaign before, you’ll get all the information you need to be set up for success. If you’ve got time, we need you in this fight.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2804?t=10&akid=2404%2E4032634%2EAhE-I2) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth --- | | | | --- | [DONATE](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2805?t=14&akid=2404%2E4032634%2EAhE-I2) --- | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/365?t=4&akid=2404%2E4032634%2EAhE-I2) | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/367?t=5&akid=2404%2E4032634%2EAhE-I2) | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/368?t=6&akid=2404%2E4032634%2EAhE-I2) | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/369?t=7&akid=2404%2E4032634%2EAhE-I2) ---|---|---|--- | Paid for by Warren for Senate --- All content © 2024 Warren for Senate, All Rights Reserved PO Box 171375, Boston, MA 02117 | | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com --- We'll miss you, but you can always [unsubscribe](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&t=11&akid=2404%2E4032634%2EAhE-I2).

body: Jason Crow For Congress [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/88523/images/logoJC%20(1).png] Eugene Vindman is running for Virginia’s open 7th Congressional District. Eugene served 25 years in the Army and is ready to fight with Jason Crow to defend our democracy against Donald Trump’s allies. We hope you’ll read his message below, and then split a donation between his and Jason’s campaigns. Hi team — it’s Eugene Vindman. I had some things on my mind I needed to share with you. I never envisioned myself running for Congress. It wasn't part of the plan. But over the past 5 years — since Trump made that phone call attempting to extort Ukraine — the Republican party has shown the dangerous path they are willing to tread. And we have seen firsthand the threat that extremism poses to our democracy. So I launched this campaign because I needed to do something — I needed to continue defending our democracy in whatever capacity I could. Because our children and families deserve better than the extremists we have now in Congress, controlling the People’s House. I’ve only gotten this far with pure grassroots support. Support from folks like you. And I can only pass the finish line with you by my side. With only four days to go until the most critical election of our lifetimes, I am asking: Can you please split $10 between my campaign for Congress and Jason Crow's today? That’s it. Just $10. Because when you and everyone reading this email give $10, we will have the power to defeat our MAGA extremist opponent at the polls in four days and flip the House majority blue. body: | [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/26910?t=1&akid=22488%2E4449941%2EHXaCWg) --- [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/56580?t=7&akid=22488%2E4449941%2EHXaCWg) Hello—we are just hours away from our midnight deadline, and I have to put out a call for help 🤙 – Polls have me **tied** with Mitch McConnell’s handpicked candidate. – Tim Sheehy’s allies have thrown in almost **$90 million** to win this race. – **And as of 4 pm, we’re still $202,478 short of our midnight goal and quickly running out of time to close the gap.** Unlike Tim Sheehy, I can’t dump $1 million into my campaign. But polls are tied, so I’m counting on you to help stand up against his mega-donors—especially as Montanans start voting. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without name: Voter Action Project HQ
subject: So many crucial states
body: Folks: With the restrictions opponents of voting rights put in place in many states - like Texas, Georgia, Florida, and Wisconsin - turning out as many voters as possible is our greatest hope to defend our right to vote and stem this tide of voter suppression. RUSH $25 or more right now to supercharge our efforts to get out the vote and make the voice of the people heard in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-gotv?refcode=110124_5&amount=25] Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=110124_5&amount=25] Folks -- This critical election is days away with the future of voting rights, abortion, and more in the balance. Opponents of voting rights have long worked behind the scenes to make it more difficult to vote . The MAGA movement is pushing hard to bring back the bad old days with limited early voting, reduced voting hours, more restrictions on mail-in ballots, and anything else they can ram through if they take control. The vote suppressors have spent years honing their playbook for important states and elections. They have the advantage over us in both money and time. That's why we need your help to keep our turnout efforts running full steam until Election Day on November 5th. We must raise another $50,000 for our Voter Mobilization Fund before Tuesday to make all our goals. Team: Can we count on you to pitch in and help surge voter participation these last few days? I grew up in a 24-by-36 foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and my grandparents before me. **In fact, I’m very proud to be the U.S. Senate’s only working dirt farmer.** Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive. I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand. The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy — but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded. **And rather than spend my days hobnobbing with special interests, I rely on hardworking folks like you to power everything we do.** **[That’s why I’m personally asking you to join my reelection team and split $5 between Jeanne Shaheen and my campaign today to help us defend Montana’s Senate seat. name: Erin Phillips, LCV Victory Fund
subject: Want to win in PA, MI, WI, NC, NV, and AZ? It takes organizers. And they STILL NEED you — please read this today.
body: To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTE3MTM1NjYS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjEwMDAyNjUwNAS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser. Peter — I just got off a call with LCV Victory Fund field directors in Pennsylvania, Michigan, Wisconsin, North Carolina, Nevada, and Arizona — and I wanted to pass along an important update: Our team has now knocked on 2,834,856 doors to turn out environmental voters in this election. The team needs you to know: → We are STILL reaching voters who are deciding between Trump and Harris. → We are STILL reaching voters who don’t know who their House and Senate candidates are. → We are STILL reaching voters who don’t yet have a plan to vote. Our organizers are about to go into the most GRUELING weekend of the election season — and it would make a HUGE difference if I could tell them that you have their backs. So I’m asking one more time: Please, make a TRIPLE MATCHED gift to LCV Victory Fund to help us get out the vote in this final weekend >> https://links.messages.lcv. MAKE YOUR 3X GIFT >> https://links.messages.lcv. I’m really hoping I can report back to our organizers just how many people are out there cheering them on — so please, even if it’s just $5, every bit helps. Here’s an example of the conversations our canvassers are having on the ground in swing states: One of our organizers in Michigan just told us about a voter who had heard wild lies about how Kamala Harris had been locking up Black men for marijuana infractions. We were able to set the record straight. We’re having hundreds of in-depth conversations with voters who need more information every day — we HAVEto keep this up until Election Day, because we’re looking at states and districts that could be decided by a tiny number of votes. Our team of canvassers is 3,000 people strong — on the ground in Pennsylvania, Michigan, Wisconsin, North Carolina, Nevada, and Arizona. We’re working nonstopto get pro-democracy, pro-environment voters in these key states to turn out on Election Day. Tomorrow is the last day of our pre-election fundraising campaign leading up to November 5.If you’ve been waiting to pitch in, please — don’t wait anymore! A group of donors will 3X MATCH every gift to LCV Victory Fund up to our $100,000 goal, tripling your impact. TRIPLE YOUR IMPACT: Help turn out environmental voters in PA, MI, WI, NC, NV, and AZ. Let our organizers know you’ve got their backs! Even $5 helps >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/bxyvTVA~ MAKE YOUR 3X GIFT >> https://links.messages.lcv. I know it will mean so much to our team if we hear back from you today. Thank you for everything, Peter! Onward, Erin Phillips National Field Director LCV Victory Fund Paid for by LCV Victory Fund,www.lcvvictoryfund.org https://links.messages.lcv., and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. There will be virtually no check on his power. We are sorry to put that thought into your head, but that is the reality. The good news is, we are not without power in making sure that outcome never comes to pass. Elections are not something to sit back and witness - they are something we can shape. But that requires participation. For some, it will be volunteering. For others, posting on social media. But probably the most important thing you can do today is donate. Donate to Elissa Slotkin's Senate campaign in Michigan. [**If you contribute $24 today, we'll put that donation right to work reaching the voters we need to keep Michigan blue in November. But we cannot do that without people who care about the outcome contributing what they can.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-nov24.k4yPYt&refcode=em241101-5-900&t=2&akid=2174%2E135344%2E9Ov8Ap) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly:_ | | **[Donate $24](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/127?c0=ebs-em-nov24.V9-yok&amount=24&refcode=em241101-5-900&t=21&akid=2174%2E135344%2E9Ov8Ap)** --- **** | **[Donate $35](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/2881?c0=ebs-em-nov24.NiOeKF&refcode=em241101-5-900&t=22&akid=2174%2E135344%2E9Ov8Ap)** --- **** | | **[Donate $50](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/122?c0=ebs-em-nov24.bZPF4p&refcode=em241101-5-900&t=23&akid=2174%2E135344%2E9Ov8Ap)** --- **** | **[Donate $100](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/123?c0=ebs-em-nov24.k3-qsD&refcode=em241101-5-900&t=24&akid=2174%2E135344%2E9Ov8Ap)** --- **** | | **[Donate $250](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/124?c0=ebs-em-nov24.DNN5wV&refcode=em241101-5-900&t=25&akid=2174%2E135344%2E9Ov8Ap)** --- **** | **[Other Amount](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/127?c0=ebs-em-nov24.V9-yok&refcode=em241101-5-900&t=26&akid=2174%2E135344%2E9Ov8Ap)** --- **** Time is running out fast. He's a bum, he lied like hell, Adam shifty Schiff.” Then a third time last night with Tucker Carlson in Glendale, Arizona: “We deal with real scum. A guy like Adam Shifty Schiff.
