Kennedy Jr., and the unity coalition need your help in nominating individuals of integrity and courage for over 4,000 appointments in the future Trump Administration. This isn’t the old system of backroom deals; this is your chance to shape the administration through the new [NomineesForThePeople.com](https://www.mahanow.org/r?u=gdQik7DwppSEU7VAQ-Mm9sPM5K_hVNREx9rltplBvlfnOf1Io9ych-PeO0ge_JRf9Lvf3NDlpX8RXCf5y67Uqv93RtrnOJ-6H7MWbDhxasH7Bwr00r_oqUL-T9OmMyZx&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=nominees_11_1_24_1&n=5). **Restore America’s Health and Integrity** The Make America Healthy Again movement isn’t just about keeping our bodies healthy and toxin-free—it’s about restoring the Republic by draining the swamp and ending corporate influence. We can’t rely on the same revolving-door D.C. crowd. We need the best public servants our country has to offer—and we believe you know who they are. **Nominate Someone Today** Submit your nominations for those you believe should serve. These can be public figures, those you know, or even yourself. 👉 [Submit Your Nomination Here](https://www.mahanow.org/nominees-for-the-people?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=nominees_11_1_24_1&n=6) Nominees are needed across all areas of government such as: * • **Health, Food, and Agriculture** * • **Housing, Economy, and Environment & Natural Resources** * • **Education, Labor, Peace at Home, and Peace Abroad** * • **Technology and Government Efficiency** Your input is essential. Please participate as soon as you can before **November 5th** to help rally and motivate our community in these final days before Election Day. Your nominations will play a role in supporting Bobby’s work on the Transition Team and within the future unity administration. **Share This Opportunity** Encourage friends and family to join in—share [NomineesForThePeople.com](https://www.mahanow.org/r?u=gdQik7DwppSEU7VAQ-Mm9sPM5K_hVNREx9rltplBvlfnOf1Io9ych-PeO0ge_JRf9Lvf3NDlpX8RXCf5y67Uqv93RtrnOJ-6H7MWbDhxasH7Bwr00r_oqUL-T9OmMyZx&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=nominees_11_1_24_1&n=7) widely so others can nominate and comment on future leaders too. We’re excited to read your submissions and to see the vibrant discussions around these nominees. Your feedback on the site is also welcomed! Thanks for being a part of this historic movement to bring the people’s voice to Washington. name: #6 Steve Garvey
subject: The most important week
body: What matters most right now is that we do whatever we can to fund a campaign that can win. That’s the most important thing. Winning this race. | | | ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         --- | | --- --- | | Fellow Patriot,I have an important message that I didn’t think I’d be sending you today. In just a moment, I am going to ask you to make a contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate. November 5th is _days away_ , and I’d really appreciate the chance to explain why this request — especially today — is so critically important.Here’s the truth:Right now, we have a week of media buys to pay for — the most important week of the entire campaign. And if we don’t raise what we need now, we will be forced to give up the airwaves and let Adam Schiff and the Democrat-machine backing him up run their attacks on me unopposed.What matters most right now is that we do whatever we can to fund a campaign that can win. That’s the most important thing. Winning this race. Not just for the sake of winning, but because of what it would mean to substitute my presence with Adam Schiff’s in the Senate.That’s a reality I don’t think any of us want to consider, but it’s what will happen if we come up short.Now, time is running out. So, this is the part where I ask, one more time, and very humbly: **[Can you please use this link to make a donation to my campaign for U.S. Senate in California before Election APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/katieporteroc/p/four-canvass-tips-to-get-you-off?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app) --- In close campaigns, from the presidential race to your local city council contest, who the winner is comes down to turnout. That's why campaigns dedicate so many resources to Get Out The Vote, or GOTV, in this final stretch. They are trying to get potential voters not to stay home. The best form of voter contact is knocking doors. For those who can't canvass, phone banking and texting are options, but the simple truth is that they aren't as effective as face-to-face conversation. **Go to[mobilize.us](https://substack.com/redirect/f7a2c697-c790-42b7-87e5-ce79f0b1f458?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to sign up for a shift near you.** Thanks for reading Beyond the Whiteboard! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work. [Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9rYXRpZXBvcnRlcm9jLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9hY2NvdW50IiwicCI6MTUxMDU2NzAxLCJzIjoyMDUyNTY4LCJmIjp0cnVlLCJ1Ijo5MDUwMTE5MiwiaWF0IjoxNzMwNTE3NDI2LCJleHAiOjE3MzMxMDk0MjYsImlzcyI6InB1Yi0wIiwic3ViIjoibGluay1yZWRpcmVjdCJ9.oUZbd6F8k-N-gjGNAaw_ayF0KKaQOMwFZggc_h6FaqU?) If you haven't knocked doors before, I know it can sound intimidating. But, take it from someone who's knocked hundreds of doors, if not thousands, over the course of three incredibly tough campaigns: it's easy, it's fun, and most importantly, it really does make a difference. | [](https://substack.com/redirect/67b801ac-2a2d-4f69-b2b1-ad519cb3a021?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)| ---|---|--- Here are my tried-and-true canvassing tips that will prepare you for any situation: 1. **Knock loud; be proud.** Your first instinct might be to knock softly, hoping that the person isn't home. Absolutely not! Think about it: if there were a fire and you were trying to rescue your neighbor, would you quietly tap on their door? You are saving democracy. Pound on that door. 2. **Dropping lit ain 't it. **Lit dropping is not canvassing. You leave campaign literature if the person isn't home, but dropping lit does not win campaigns. You want to have a real conversation. So, walk up to that door, hope they're home, and knock really loudly. 3. **The ask is the task.** If you go spend ten minutes talking to someone and you leave without saying, "Will you vote for Kamala Harris and Democrats," guess what we have to ultimately do? Ask again. It's not enough to feel like you had a good conversation. Just make the ask. 4. **Don 't fear; bring the cheer!** Much like teenagers--and I speak from experience--voters can sense your fear. And if they sense fear, they will prey on you. You might be asked tough questions, but the harder the question gets, the bigger your smile has to be. We need to do everything we can from now until polls close to elect people who share our values. Sign up at [mobilize.us](https://substack.com/redirect/f7a2c697-c790-42b7-87e5-ce79f0b1f458?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), lace up those shoes, and bring a friend. You'll feel amazing the morning after Election Day knowing you did your part for our democracy. I'll see you out there! Katie Porter Thanks for reading Beyond the Whiteboard! body: Come watch the results and (hopefully) celebrate! | | | | | | --- | --- | | | | --- | # Election night party at Historic Davenport --- | Friends, Eleanor and I warmly invite you to join us in the Grand Pennington ballroom at the original Davenport Hotel in Spokane for a special election night party on the evening of Tuesday, Nov 5th. We’ve been on quite the journey these last eight months, and we are so appreciative of all your support. It would be wonderful to watch the results roll in and (hopefully) celebrate with you. Doors open at 6pm and I’ll be pleased to publicly address the gathering after results are known at about 8:30pm. Big thanks to Representatives Mike Volz and Suzanne Schmidt for hosting what is certain to be an exciting evening! Everything is OK, it's just that I'm a bundle of nerves and excitement in these final days of the campaign, where we are _so close_ to actually defeating Rick Scott and protecting Democratic control of the Senate! I need you to know that we never would have gotten to a point where the _**polls are statistically tied**_ , where brand new polling data has me **_leading by 18 points with independent voters_** , where **_Rick Scott is forced to spend_** tens of millions of dollars to compete with our grassroots movement, and where the _**major Democratic committees**_ spend millions of dollars of their own money to help us because they believe in us! Thank you, friend. A year ago at this time, the political pundits wrote off Florida completely. We put Florida in play. We gave Rick Scott his notice. We are on the cusp of pulling off the greatest political upset in modern history. **But Rick Scott is outspending me nearly 3-to-1 on the airwaves — and he's already spent over $38 million on ads to defeat me. Well, I don't have a fraudulently earned fortune like him to tap into. I have you, friend. I have this grassroots movement. And I can only fight back and win by closing in on my final $4 million goal before Election Day. ** **[So please, will you make a donation of $5 or more to help me make history here in Florida? subject: No bodyguards, just me and the most evil dictator in the world.
body: Let me tell you a story about Kim Jong Un. ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  | | --- | | | I'll never forget the day I stepped into the heart of darkness, facing off against the North Korean dictator, Kim Jong Un. The rules were clear: no translator, no armed bodyguard, no photographers. I was completely alone, with only my convictions to guide me. **But I wasn't intimidated. ** As the former Director of the CIA, I've stared down evil before, and I know that weakness is its fuel. President Trump's unwavering resolve had my back, and together, we sent a message to the world: **America will not be swayed by tyranny.** In that meeting, I saw something that the fake news media will never report: Kim Jong Un was rattled. His regime, built on fear, was shaken to its core by the unyielding strength of American leadership. When America stands tall, the world is a safer, freer place. subject: No bodyguards, just me and the most evil dictator in the world.
body: Let me tell you a story about Kim Jong Un. ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  | | --- | | | I'll never forget the day I stepped into the heart of darkness, facing off against the North Korean dictator, Kim Jong Un. The rules were clear: no translator, no armed bodyguard, no photographers. I was completely alone, with only my convictions to guide me. **But I wasn't intimidated. ** As the former Director of the CIA, I've stared down evil before, and I know that weakness is its fuel. President Trump's unwavering resolve had my back, and together, we sent a message to the world: **America will not be swayed by tyranny.** In that meeting, I saw something that the fake news media will never report: Kim Jong Un was rattled. I wanted to send you a quick message while I have my morning coffee. To be honest, asking for donations is my least favorite part of the job. But the truth is it’s absolutely necessary if we’re going to keep Wisconsin blue and defend this seat. Republicans have spent $100 million on ads attacking me and uplifting my opponent. The bad news is, their strategy seems to be working — with multiple polls showing my opponent taking a one-point lead. Losing this seat would cost Democrats control of the Senate. If Eric Hovde secured the majority for Mitch McConnell and the extreme GOP, everything from the Affordable Care Act and abortion rights to Social Security and Medicare would be on the chopping block. We can’t let that happen, but we’re running out of time to stop them. We have three days left to leave it all on the field — get our message in front of the final undecided Wisconinites, turn out voters across the state, and win this toss-up race. body: Let me tell you a story about Kim Jong Un. ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  | | --- | | | I'll never forget the day I stepped into the heart of darkness, facing off against the North Korean dictator, Kim Jong Un. name: Kamala Harris
subject: I am so proud to be on this team with you.
body: I am asking for your support one last time before Election Day. ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-hfp-split-november-2024?refcode=em_20241102_2160_fr&refcode2=khp_em_20241102_b1_kdh_dnc_fl&amount=10&akid=2160%2E22930333%2ErXO5vG) --- Derek, these past few months have been a whirlwind. So, I wanted to step back and take a few minutes to remind you how we got here -- and why your support for the DNC and for our campaign is so important to our success on Election Day in three days. **The truth is: I am no stranger to unlikely journeys.** I grew up in the East Bay, immersed in the ideals of the civil rights movement, and at a young age I decided I wanted to be a lawyer. I wanted to protect people because I believe everyone has a right to safety, dignity, and justice. Every day in the courtroom, I stood proudly before a judge and said five words: Kamala Harris, for the people. Throughout my career, I have only had one client: The people. Today, we have the chance to chart a new way forward -- not as members of any one party or faction, but as Americans. I want you to know that I will be a president who unites us around our highest aspirations. A president who leads and listens, who is realistic, practical, and has common sense. A president who always fights for the American people. I cannot do it alone. No one person could. It takes a team. It takes millions and millions of people coming together at once to shape the outcome of this election and elect Democrats up and down the ballot. Millions of Americans have already voted, and millions more will vote on Election Day. We need to do everything we can -- and I mean everything -- to reach every last voter to win the White House and elect Democrats nationwide. We need Democrats elected at every level who will fight to deliver on our vision for the future, from the Oval Office to local office. **So, with time running out to make an impact before Election Day, I am asking for your support one last time:** [**Derek, will you help us get out the vote over these final days by splitting $10, or whatever you can afford, between the DNC and our campaign before our midnight deadline? name: Lexi Schiff
subject: My dad
body: [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=8094%2E5257348%2El9CHG9 ]Adam Schiff for Senate Derek — My whole life, I’ve looked up to my dad, Adam. Not just because he’s a member of Congress, or because he served as an impeachment manager in the case against Donald Trump, or on the January 6th Committee — though I am proud of him for all of those things! I admire my dad because he is tireless and relentless in his work to make a difference for others — especially young people like me and my brother Eli. Whether he’s fighting to reform the Supreme Court so my generation is not beholden to an ultra-conservative judiciary, or fighting to cancel student loan debt, or fighting to restore reproductive rights, or fighting to protect our clean air and water, he’s taking on big fights to help other people out. My dad is one of the most selfless people I know. Growing up, I would watch him at campaign events, asking people over and over again how he could help and hearing about their struggles. For most people, it would probably be exhausting and quite challenging — especially when the former president of the United States is always demonizing you. But my dad has never wavered in his work to make real change. For your grandma, your neighbor down the street who is a veteran, your teacher, your kids and grandkids, for everyone. And that’s why I know he’s going to be a damn good Senator. We have just a few days left to make it happen, which is why I’m earnestly asking you, Derek: [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=nov2024_abs_em.SALZ0e&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20241102_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=8094%2E5257348%2El9CHG9 ]Will you help send my dad to the U.S. Senate? name: Adam Schiff
subject: Is California getting away from us?
body: | [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/26910?t=1&akid=22489%2E4449941%2Ej_qngg) --- Team — I have some alarming news to share. **Steve Garvey outraised our campaign _again_. For the third fundraising period in a row. This time he raised over $1.2 million in the first two weeks of October alone, no doubt boosted by Trump’s attacks on me as the “enemy within.”** This is a MAJOR problem. [**We only have a handful of days left to make up the difference in our fundraising. Can I count on you to rush in a split contribution of $10 between Fight for Reform to elect state and local Democrats and my campaign before midnight to help us close the gap?**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/56596?t=7&akid=22489%2E4449941%2Ej_qngg) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight for Reform and Adam Schiff will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/56597?t=8&akid=22489%2E4449941%2Ej_qngg) --- [CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/56598?t=9&akid=22489%2E4449941%2Ej_qngg) [CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/56599?t=10&akid=22489%2E4449941%2Ej_qngg) [CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/56600?t=11&akid=22489%2E4449941%2Ej_qngg) [Or a custom donation »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/56596?t=12&akid=22489%2E4449941%2Ej_qngg) **Garvey has now raised over $18 million during this campaign.** Every day we let pass without responding to Garvey’s fundraising numbers is another opportunity for him to reach undecided voters in the California Senate race — and more MAGA candidates to press their advantage down-ballot. The implications go beyond just our race: **If Garvey turns out GOP voters, we are putting in jeopardy the half-dozen toss-up House races in California that could determine the House majority.** We _can’t_ count out Republican candidates in California. We simply can’t. Steve Garvey has outraised our campaign over the last three fundraising reporting periods. But we still have time to beat him right now, when it matters most. That’s why I’m urgently asking: [**Can you pitch in a split donation of $10 or any amount between Fight for Reform to elect state and local Democrats and my campaign to help us shift the momentum back in our favor? Steve Garvey outraised us by over $330,000, and any amount you give will help us catch up.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/56596?t=13&akid=22489%2E4449941%2Ej_qngg) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight for Reform and Adam Schiff will go through immediately: [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/56597?t=14&akid=22489%2E4449941%2Ej_qngg) --- [CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/56598?t=15&akid=22489%2E4449941%2Ej_qngg) [CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/56599?t=16&akid=22489%2E4449941%2Ej_qngg) [CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/56600?t=17&akid=22489%2E4449941%2Ej_qngg) [Or a custom donation »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/56596?t=18&akid=22489%2E4449941%2Ej_qngg) Thank you. name: Lucas Tyree Kunce
subject: One word: Community
body: This is why I’m running for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          # Hi Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce. The community that supported my family after we were bankrupted by medical bills is what motivated me to run against Josh Hawley for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat. **Please let me tell you why:** [](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83260?refcode=em20241102-8603&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8603%2E614464%2Ep6dHnE) I grew up in a working-class neighborhood in mid-Missouri. It was one of those places where the curbs crumbled into the streets and the sidewalks were so tilted you couldn’t really walk on them — though they made a pretty good bike ramp for all of us kids. We all ran in and out of each other’s houses, everyone’s parents took care of everyone. **It was a magical place to live.** Like so many families, mine lived paycheck-to-paycheck — and when my littlest sister was born with a heart condition, we were bankrupted by medical bills. Our family got by thanks to the generosity of our community — most people had no more money than we did, but helped us anyway. Our neighbors and friends took the rest of us kids into their homes while my parents were with my sister at the hospital over 100 miles away. And when we were all home together, they brought more meals by the house than we could ever hope to eat. Their support helped me go to college, and after that I joined the Marines to honor everything our community did for me and my family growing up. But when I came home between tours in Iraq and Afghanistan, I found that old magical place picked for parts — our local corner store was boarded up, our family’s first home in the neighborhood was bulldozed to the ground. **Now it’s an empty lot:** [](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83260?refcode=em20241102-8603&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=8603%2E614464%2Ep6dHnE) While all of us were risking our lives to build up towns like Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Herat, career politicians and corporate elites like Josh Hawley let our towns and neighborhoods at home waste away. And then, after spending 20 years and $6.4 trillion on pointless forever wars and defense contractors, they couldn’t figure out how to invest a fraction of that amount back into our own country. **I’m running for U.S. Senate because it’s time everyday Missourians — people who know how to take care of each other, like the ones in my old neighborhood — called the shots in this country.[And today, I’m asking for your support to help me make it happen.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83260?refcode=em20241102-8603&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=8603%2E614464%2Ep6dHnE)** [](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83260?refcode=em20241102-8603&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=8603%2E614464%2Ep6dHnE) **If you’re ready to take back power from the giant corporations and corrupt, career politicians who’ve waged economic warfare on our country, I need you on November 5th, Peter.[Will you add a $10 donation to my campaign right now so we have the resources to fight back against Josh Hawley’s attacks, keep airing our own positive message, and flip this U.S. Senate seat in just 3 days? I don’t take any money from corporate PACs, so I mean it when I say anything makes a big impact.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83260?refcode=em20241102-8603&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=8603%2E614464%2Ep6dHnE)** subject: Urgent: Final Push for Our 13 Progressive Candidates!
body: # [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20241102&t=1&akid=1390%2E587540%2EG_OuL_) Peter, As we approach Election Day, we are in the final stretch of our grassroots campaign to support 13 incredible young progressive candidates who are ready to make a difference in our communities. These candidates embody the change we need — fighting for social justice, climate action, and equitable education. But they can't do it alone. We have one last chance to ensure they have the resources to mobilize voters and share their vision. **Why Your Support Matters:** * **Time is of the Essence:** Every moment counts. Early voting is already underway, and we need to ensure that every voter knows who is on the ballot. * **Your Donation is Critical:** With just days to go, we’re making a final push to fund canvassing efforts, phone banking, and outreach materials. Every dollar you contribute will directly impact our ability to get these candidates elected. * **A New Generation of Leadership:** By electing these 13 young leaders, we’re not just changing who sits in office; we’re investing in a future that prioritizes the needs of our communities. Please join us in this critical effort. Your donation of $5 can make a significant difference in our GOTV strategy. Together, we can ensure that these candidates have the support they need to succeed. **[Donate now to help us reach our goal and make history together!](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20241102?refcode=em20241102-1390&amount=5&refcode2=1390_587540_G_OuL_&akid=1390%2E587540%2EG_OuL_)** **[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20241102?amount=5&refcode=em20241102-1390&refcode2=1390_587540_G_OuL_&akid=1390%2E587540%2EG_OuL_)** Thank you for your continued support and belief in a brighter, more equitable future. subject: This email is for anyone who is looking for a way to help
body: I just got off my first round of calls, and in about 15 minutes I have to head out for a full day of events. But while I have the time, I wanted to reach out. #                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 Peter, I just got off my first round of calls, and in about 15 minutes, I have to head out for a full day of events. But while I have the time, I wanted to reach out. If you’re anything like me, the way you shake off the nerves is by staying busy. And I hope (if you’re able) that you take the time to knock on some doors or make phone calls to get out the vote over the next three days. But if you’re at home looking for something to do, please. Let me explain why your support — even today, with three days until the election — is so important. Back in September, there were a significant number of undecided voters left in Arizona — anywhere from 5-10% of all voters. Then early voting started, and people began making their choices. Over the last few weeks, we’ve seen what was at times a double-digit lead in our favor narrow. It was gradual at first, but all of a sudden not one, but **TWO polls came out showing Kari Lake leading us** , and a third with us just barely ahead. We always knew this would be a fight to the finish. We were prepared for that. But we never thought it would be this close — _or that we would be falling behind Kari Lake_ — with just three days left. Peter, I did not come this far to lose to the “MAGA Queen.” We’ve worked too hard for that. But to regain the lead and defend everything we’ve accomplished in Arizona, I have to absolutely floor it over these next three days. I need to raise $1.5 million dollars by midnight on Election Day to cover the additional cost of this last-minute surge. And the only way I can do that is with your support. [**Please, Peter. I know you’ve done so much already, but I need you to make a donation of $20.24 or anything you can afford to give. I would not be asking you this if it was not absolutely critical to our chances in Arizona.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-nov24.6f99Bw&refcode=em241102-2-160&t=1&akid=3514%2E734936%2Ex04gtF) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly._ | | **[Donate $5](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1061?c0=ruben-em-nov24.9-UbQZ&refcode=em241102-2-160&t=20&akid=3514%2E734936%2Ex04gtF)** --- **** | **[Donate $20.24](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/3118?c0=ruben-em-nov24.uBjFYY&refcode=em241102-2-160&t=21&akid=3514%2E734936%2Ex04gtF)** --- **** | | **[Donate $50](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1039?c0=ruben-em-nov24.PyLAnK&refcode=em241102-2-160&t=22&akid=3514%2E734936%2Ex04gtF)** --- **** | **[Donate $100](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1040?c0=ruben-em-nov24.6dFo5D&refcode=em241102-2-160&t=23&akid=3514%2E734936%2Ex04gtF)** --- **** | | **[Donate $250](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1041?c0=ruben-em-nov24.Uo86uY&refcode=em241102-2-160&t=24&akid=3514%2E734936%2Ex04gtF)** --- **** | **[Other Amount](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1044?c0=ruben-em-nov24.XhYmSw&refcode=em241102-2-160&t=25&akid=3514%2E734936%2Ex04gtF)** --- **** Thank you. I did this alone: in a city I had never been to before, without my family or my husband there by my side,”_ Allie said. --- [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96391850/509856004/1847696976?refcode=EM_F_241102room__N_ASR_90DO_12_G_N_P1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImRlNjkyOTkxLTFlOTktZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=DfgKXCMmCHn2pYKzW2wCoGCswEZfMHvxc1NlDF7VC9U=) --- After this horrible, tragic experience, Allie began advocating for a new policy she titled **“Miley’s Law,”** which would add an exception for fetal anomalies to her state’s abortion ban. However, her legislator, Rep. Jeff Burkhart, did not have any empathy for her experience. He told her that if his own daughter had been in her position, he’d have wanted her to _continue the pregnancy…_ he also told her “most of the time the pregnancies that go bad are usually the first pregnancy.” (???) It’s way past time we elect legislators, not mansplainers who have no idea what they’re talking about. Almost a year earlier, a ban on abortion from the point of conception with zero exceptions went into effect in Tennessee.”_ After the conversation, Phillips wrote to Buckhart and said, _“Every chance I get to tell my story, I will… Who knows, maybe one day I’ll run against you.”_ **Now Allie is running for HIS SEAT in the TN House of Representatives – and she is within striking distance of actually winning it – but she needs our help.** [**This is a rare opportunity to replace an anti-choice extremist legislator in TN, and we are honored to be standing with Allie in this fight. body: # [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=4753%2E552475%2Ev8fdo0) [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241102-2?refcode=em20241102-2&refcode2=4753_552475_v8fdo0&akid=4753%2E552475%2Ev8fdo0) Hi Peter, it's Ken Burns. I am in the business of history. I’ve spent my life learning about America’s past and understanding the challenges our democratic system of government has faced. From Ben Franklin to Gettysburg, Pennsylvania has always played a critical role in shaping our democracy — and it has the chance to do so again this year. [**That’s why I’m personally asking you to help keep Bob Casey in the Senate. Bob is running to protect voting rights and our democratic institutions — and his success will make the difference in who has control of the Senate majority.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241102-2?refcode=em20241102-2&refcode2=4753_552475_v8fdo0&akid=4753%2E552475%2Ev8fdo0) **[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241102-2?refcode=em20241102-2&refcode2=4753_552475_v8fdo0&akid=4753%2E552475%2Ev8fdo0)** Bob Casey shares my love for learning American history, and he understands the importance of preserving our system of government that respects and listens to all of its citizens. He also understands that the democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are at risk of unraveling. The GOP is spending more than $150 million against Bob to buy this seat, meaning this race is the second most expensive in the entire country and is on track to become one of the most expensive in history. With recent polls showing that Bob is tied with his Trump-backed opponent, David McCormick, he needs all of our support to keep up. This election, our country stands at a crossroads, and it’s up to us to decide which direction we’ll take. If we’re going to elect Kamala Harris as the first woman president, defend our Senate majority, and protect our very democracy, we must re-elect Bob Casey and keep Pennsylvania blue. [**So I’ll ask you again, Peter: will you please donate to Bob’s campaign today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241102-2?refcode=em20241102-2&refcode2=4753_552475_v8fdo0&akid=4753%2E552475%2Ev8fdo0) [Donate $15 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241102-2?amount=15&refcode=em20241102-2-el&refcode2=4753_552475_v8fdo0&akid=4753%2E552475%2Ev8fdo0) [Donate $25 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241102-2?amount=25&refcode=em20241102-2-el&refcode2=4753_552475_v8fdo0&akid=4753%2E552475%2Ev8fdo0) [Donate $50 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241102-2?amount=50&refcode=em20241102-2-el&refcode2=4753_552475_v8fdo0&akid=4753%2E552475%2Ev8fdo0) [Donate $100 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241102-2?amount=100&refcode=em20241102-2-el&refcode2=4753_552475_v8fdo0&akid=4753%2E552475%2Ev8fdo0) [Donate $250 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241102-2?amount=250&refcode=em20241102-2-el&refcode2=4753_552475_v8fdo0&akid=4753%2E552475%2Ev8fdo0) [Other amount »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241102-2?refcode=em20241102-2&refcode2=4753_552475_v8fdo0&akid=4753%2E552475%2Ev8fdo0) --- Thank you for joining me in supporting Bob Casey, and playing a part in shaping the history of our country. — Ken * * * This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. A reckoning is approaching. Hey friends – this is John Rich. I’m proud to be a thorn in the side of the woke Left. Here’s the thing. I’ve been singing and writing country music since before the word “woke” was even a thing. I grew up in the South and was raised to be a freedom-loving patriot who always stands for the flag, protects the Second Amendment, supports our troops, and backs the blue. And that’s why it makes me absolutely sick to see what the liberal whack jobs have done to our country, and what they have in store for our future. They want to redefine what it means to be an American. They won’t stop until “one nation under God” is stripped from our Pledge of Allegiance. They are eager to parade drag queens through our children’s classrooms. They won’t sleep until the U.S. Constitution is shredded to bits. It’s an utter disgrace, but I find peace knowing that “the Lord laughs at the wicked, for he knows their day is coming.” It also doesn’t hurt that we have patriots like Senator Marsha Blackburn fighting the good fight for us in the U.S. Senate. https://click.updates.marshablackburn.com/?qs=b92d85a9778a6af9c4d56fbab9155cfbad4f420c998df4df1d983c9fb236ba284331617beb4f8d638e6d3edcdcdcf96facaf909453f9fd8d708adbf2184b5a4f That’s actually why I’m emailing you today. Chuck Schumer and his socialist cronies in Washington are propping up radical socialists to destroy Marsha Blackburn and PERMANENTLY take over Tennessee. They will spend, lie, and cheat their way to victory unless we do something about it right here and now. We need a response that will leave Marsha’s opponents regretting they ever entered the ring. https://click.updates.marshablackburn.com/?qs=b92d85a9778a6af9c4d56fbab9155cfbad4f420c998df4df1d983c9fb236ba284331617beb4f8d638e6d3edcdcdcf96facaf909453f9fd8d708adbf2184b5a4f So, I’m directly asking you to join me in supporting her campaign. Senator Marsha Blackburn is as tough as they come. She’s never given an inch to the woke mob, and she is a God-fearing patriot like you and me. Marsha has my complete backing, and I hope you’re willing to give her the same. I don’t write emails like this ever, so trust me when I tell you that Marsha Blackburn needs your support today to defeat her opponents and all the commie loving Liberals hell-bent on destroying America. If they take Tennessee, the battle is over. We’d never recover. https://click.updates.marshablackburn.com/?qs=b92d85a9778a6af9c4d56fbab9155cfbad4f420c998df4df1d983c9fb236ba284331617beb4f8d638e6d3edcdcdcf96facaf909453f9fd8d708adbf2184b5a4f I’m asking this as a personal favor to a fellow Patriot: please don’t close this email without taking a moment to support Marsha Blackburn’s campaign. We've been out on the Campaign trail for almost a year and now it is time to take action at the ballot box. We need your support so please get out and vote. **We are three days from the Main Event - For us it is a David v. Goliath story.** We have been identifying and posing solutions to issues facing the citizens of this district and will continue to do so **and we have been working with the local candidates** **Our Campaign has been one about Federal Solutions to Local Problems** that you and I face living in the Constitution State of Connecticut. We have also looked at world issues and issues that need to be addressed in Congress especially on global energy and reduced global emissions (See [Article](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/40db40d4-519f-4190-ae65-7e32a8d5227b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)). We've been out there: knocking doors, talking to people at Garbage dumps (_**long before we were called garbage**_), talking to you, marching in parades, talking to our youth, our veterans, talking to communities that have been ignored. We have also spent a lot of time talking to people in the supermarkets about their pocketbook issues. **We have a pretty good feeling of the pulse of this State and this Country.** Here are some of the issues that matter to Every Day Nutmeggers like You. **Connecticut has a border crisis.** Immigration and bad economic policy is affecting everyone and causes rampant inflation. The fentanyl and trafficking making its way to our backyard must stop. **At the grocery stores, many people are waiting to shop on sale days and many are shopping at multiple supermarkets to take advantages of different sales**. The sales price of groceries today were the regular prices under the Trump administration. There is no price gouging at supermarkets as they typically run on less than a 2% profit margin and high volume. **They are struggling due to high energy costs, supply chain issues, and theft.** Crime is rampant and our police need to be supported and this mantra of Crime Pays Under Harris and Himes needs to be reversed. **Education** \- Parents want to be able to send their children where they want and we have been advocating for school choice. When we marched the Puerto Rican Day parade, so many parents expressed the challenges of working two or three jobs to be in a position to send their children to private or parochial schools because Bridgeport ranks at the bottom of the school districts of 161 out of about 165. ([See our article on Your Child, Your Choice.](https://open.substack.com/pub/drmichaelgoldstein4ct/p/your-child-your-choice?r=26c3ku&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web)) **Housing** is another major issue and not just 8-30g. Rents keep going up and the supply of housing is an issue in some parts of our district. Pricing is going up for inflationary reasons as cost of home heating is up. Cost of electricity is up. Cost of insurance is up. Hartford keeps jamming 8-30g down our throats. This mandate does not solve the real problem, which is enough affordable ownership of housing. **Our children cannot afford to live in Fairfield County.** (See our article on [housing](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/dccf95aa-daad-4ffa-adbd-7d8603409ab6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)). **We Need a Return to Local Control and Affordable Home Ownership and Building Equity.** **Medicare -** We are seeing Seniors on fixed income getting the shock of their lives as Medicare funds were diverted - **Only $280 Billion** \- to subsidize the Green New Deal of the Inflation Reduction Act. This will cause major issues and we have to take care of our [seniors](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4235c566-f55f-4198-963b-355b89783a8f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). **Business** \- Companies are moving out of Connecticut. The only companies that come here are doing so because they have to. When they get here, they are stuck in traffic because I-95 doesn't move - You can blame Himes for that one - [See our article - When you Are Stuck on I-95 - Blame Himes)](https://open.substack.com/pub/drmichaelgoldstein4ct/p/i-95-when-you-are-in-traffic-blame?r=26c3ku&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web). This infrastructure and energy crisis is causing issues to Commercial Real Estate Concerns and we need to bring more jobs to Connecticut with **new pro-business strategies** including: reduced regulatory burdens, expedited zoning and permit approvals, improving the infrastructure with less congested highways and improved commuter rail service. Federal tax incentives and opportunity zones are tools that can be used to attract new businesses to our beautiful state. These are techniques being used by other states to lure away Connecticut businesses. **We need to be more aggressive in both attracting and keeping businesses here.** ([See our Article on Addressing our Commercial Markets](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6daa23f1-9e4e-44d9-8658-35fbc3680cff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)). **I-95** \- It needs solutions and some work is being done. Our new concern is that the roads are being improved by contractors not from Connecticut - **We have to try and keep jobs here and keep the money in Connecticut that will flow into Connecticut**. We launched an inquiry after you complained about New York license plates on the construction vehicles (see [article](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8046dcc5-feaf-43a7-8651-cd3b2a09611c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)). **Electricity -** As for electricity, our bills have gone up significantly because of the public benefit. The electric company should pay for these green initiatives which benefits them by reducing their need to supply additional electricity. **You are not obligated to help your neighbor make improvements in a classic taxation without representation.** In the interim, I have proposed a deduction on your taxes for this mandate while you push your local State Reps and Senators to push back. ([See our article on electricity](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/dc7ab48b-f7a4-4f5f-872a-b09b57d5fce3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)). **The Border -** The border is another big issue, which is woven into many of these other issues and impacts our lives. I am all about closing the border especially after Prison gangs of Tren de Aragua are now killing people in Stamford (See [Article](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/7667e6c8-96e7-49d0-81cc-99e45fa49e5a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)). **Protecting Women means keeping them safe and keeping known criminals from coming into this country and deporting illegals that commit violent crimes against women and children.** My Opponent voted Against the Violence Against Women by Illegals Act - and was wrong on the facts at our [debate](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/5dc80471-af6e-4e47-a1ff-d69c8ec19667?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Most of Americans are in agreement on crime and safety. However, Jim Himes has been horrible on the Border and even suggested that we should bring refugees from Gaza. ([See our article on Hamas and Himes](https://open.substack.com/pub/drmichaelgoldstein4ct/p/no-process-is-strong-enough-to-vet?r=26c3ku&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web)) **Veterans** \- We've also talked about how veterans have been ignored with better treatment given to illegals and the lack of good resources for veterans to treat their PTSD and other ailments following their service to this grateful nation. ([See our Article on Our Veterans](https://open.substack.com/pub/drmichaelgoldstein4ct/p/what-about-our-veterans-vote-august?r=26c3ku&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web)). **Israel -** Harris and Himes have been terrible on Israel despite the fact Jim Himes largest donor is AIPAC. Himes has pandered to CAIR and was silent when both President Biden and Vice President Harris snubbed Netanyahu and Israel on a very important diplomatic mission. That was their first mission since October 7. ([See our Article on Biden and Harris Snub Israe](https://open.substack.com/pub/drmichaelgoldstein4ct/p/biden-and-harris-snub-israel?r=26c3ku&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web)l) . These protests and violence on college campuses needs to end. Free speech is one thing, it is another to incite violence and desecrating government property and attacking our flag while Universities are told by Chuck Schumer to bury the issue. **WHAT CAN YOU DO?** Now ask yourself what can you do. _**If any of these issues strike a nerve it is time to take action.**_ As we have been in the words of the Doobie Brothers - Takin it To the Street, it is your turn to **Take it to the Poll** s and Tell Your Friends. Cast your vote. It matters and you matter. So Let's build the greatest team going into this November to take back Connecticut and Heal this Country. We are out there working hard for the working people of Connecticut that have been ignored. On Tuesday, November 5th, go out make your voices heard . **The silent majority can no longer be silent any longer. IF YOU DO NOT GO OUT AND VOTE - YOU HAVE NO ABILITY TO COMPLAIN.** _**We are leaving it all on the field and will not stop until the polls close.**_ Thank you for your continued support - We will not be ignored any longer. **Put a Doctor in the house and you can do that on November 5th by casting your vote for Dr. Michael Goldstein.** **Stand up for America and Our Future and the Future of Our Children and VOTE FOR ME ON ROW B.** **I would be honored by your support and tell your friends to get out and vote.** Thank you for your continued support. **This is a David v Goliath Moment and We the People Can Do this Together - that one stone is your vote at the polls.** | [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f5f495bb-4591-43df-b4c8-54bf03bfb76f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)| ---|---|--- Dr. Michael Goldstein Put A Doctor in the House [www.goldsteinforcongress.com](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/fe6ec7e8-3354-4247-aa39-e879475f200a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Paid for by Goldstein for Congress We Need Your Support. These “toss-ups” include both chambers in the Arizona legislature, the New Hampshire State House, the Michigan State House, the Minnesota State House, and the Pennsylvania State House. **Here’s a quick analysis of what’s at stake in each state: ** **➡️ Arizona:** Republicans hold majorities in both chambers of the Arizona legislature, but if we flip just two seats in each, we can flip both the state house and state senate and strengthen the state’s redistricting process. **➡️ Michigan:** While Democrats hold a trifecta in Michigan, Republicans are vying to take back the state house this November. If they do, they could attempt to roll back progress on fair maps by targeting the state’s independent redistricting commission. **➡️ Minnesota:** Democrats won a surprise trifecta of their state’s government in 2022, but this year, _only_ the state house is on the ballot. Republicans need to flip just five seats to win back control and block all the amazing progress we’ve seen there in the last two years. **➡️ New Hampshire:** It’s the Republicans who hold a trifecta in New Hampshire — and since mid-cycle congressional redistricting is permitted in this state, the GOP could use their power to rewrite their maps at any given moment. (The Republican candidate for governor has even said they hope to do so.) Democrats need to win the legislature to put an end to the possibility of mid-cycle GOP gerrymandering. **➡️ Pennsylvania:** Democrats hold the state house and the governor’s seat, but Republicans control the state senate. name: Peter Hernandez
subject: Wokeism is Not a Latino Value
body: Language matters! | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/e142fe55db0b/watch-now-electoral-forum-campaign-updates-10347609?e=638e6c2751) --- | | | | [](https://hernandezforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=314f047675baff18221b82bdc&id=af84c9df00&e=638e6c2751) --- | **Wokeism is Not a Latino Value** --- | | | | | | | | | | | In these final days of this 2024 election cycle, I wanted to share some thoughts with you. Here's an article that I wrote a couple years back explaining that "wokeism" is not a value that Latinos appreciate. --- | [](https://hernandezforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=314f047675baff18221b82bdc&id=1cc73982a5&e=638e6c2751) --- | _"Wokeism in its purest forms breaks down clarity, and replaces truth with new grievance norms that masquerade as justice. Wokeists try to negate centuries of tradition, culture and science (!) by socially shaming opposing views and using coercive tactics on young children to adopt concepts that go against every grain of common sense and human understanding of the world around us. Woke gender ideology, being so totally antithetical to the Latino language and culture, plays a huge part of why Hispanics are universally turning away from the Democrat party."_ _"Now the left wants to replace Latino with ‘Latinx.’ It is the woke objective to erase gender by changing the masculine default of Spanish plural words: canceling the ‘os’ at the end of words by replacing it with an X. The gender confusion community seeks to do whatever it can to remove the uniqueness and importance of masculine and feminine in our culture, and in our language. Are we to begin to call our sons and daughters by ninx rather than nina or nino, our grandchildren nietx, our students alumnx, our friends amigx, our neighbors vecinx, and our partners companerx? We must end this abuse of language and stop the disrespect of our masculine and feminine natures. subject: Have you heard the good news?
body: [1]Fetterman's Frontline Five Derek, y’all killed it! 🎉 My team informed me that, together, we raised $180k for my most vulnerable Senate colleagues – the Frontline Five. I am so pumped seeing the energy heading into Election Day, especially from this team. I’ve already heard back from a few of the Frontline Five who have expressed sincere gratitude to the support we have been able to provide their campaigns. They also shared how tough the races are getting with just a few days until Election Day. That’s why I am raising the Frontline Five goal to $250K by midnight on Election Day. We have the rare opportunity to make a huge impact in these tight races and defend our Democratic majority in the Senate. [ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-fff-20241102-1?refcode=em20241102-9553&refcode2=9553_434096_5-zPdh&akid=9553%2E434096%2E5-zPdh ]Derek, will you rush a $5 contribution to the Frontline Five and get us even closer to keeping a blue Senate? Here’s to no regrets on November 6th. ❤️ John John Fetterman U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. subject: A Few More Days to Election Day
body: If you haven’t voted yet, I need your vote to change what’s happening in our country. | | | | | [](https://ackramerforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0681592302c29e74ce410ea82&id=80b908835f&e=d9ccafcb33) --- | | | | | Dear Peter, --- | If you haven’t voted yet, I need your vote to change what’s happening in our country. body: Growing up, I always knew I wanted to make a difference in my community                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96403981/509886067/1561815853?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YTU1ZDkzNS0yOTk5LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-FTuiMv5bfF0dw8HtYViTV1uEbwV3VpTxdFlv03QX7w=&emci=77f0e104-8398-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=7a55d935-2999-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=12666102) Peter – Growing up, I always knew I wanted to make a difference in my community. Watching my parents work hard to support our family and care for others taught me the value of service. That’s exactly why I became a pediatrician. But I quickly realized that doctors face major obstacles when trying to treat our patients. That’s why I ran for the state legislature. In that time, I worked to pass legislation to force drug companies to lower the cost of prescriptions, expand funding for preschool, ensure all Coloradans have access to paid family leave and sick days, and protect renters from eviction during the pandemic. And, Peter, that’s why I ran for Congress in 2022. The pollsters said I didn’t have a shot at winning this race. Thanks to this grassroots movement, we defied the odds and elected the first Latina to represent Colorado in Congress. subject: I am asking you to volunteer to get out the vote in Pennsylvania
body: | The stakes of this race are high and it’s going to be close. But the power is in your hands.                                                                                                                                                                 --- [](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1142?refcode=kh_em_do_20241102_b15_kh_tier1_do_do_fl_ak&amount=47&amounts=47%252C75%252C100%252C250%252C500&utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241102_b15_kh_tier1_do_do_fl_ak&t=1&akid=236%2E2563979%2EmzP4G8) Peter, I am spending the final few days of this campaign holding rallies across the battleground states. We were in Arizona and Nevada on Thursday. Wisconsin yesterday. Georgia and North Carolina today, Michigan tomorrow. All across Pennsylvania on Monday. _The energy is extraordinary._ But let me be clear: This is going to be a very close race. The polling shows we are essentially tied with Donald Trump _in each of these states_. We are going to win -- but this election, and the person sitting in the Oval Office in January, will be determined by a small number of people who are deciding right now whether they should get out and vote or stay home on Election Day. **I am counting on your help to reach these crucial voters before polls close on Tuesday.** Peter, you have real power to shape the outcome of this election, especially in Pennsylvania. We won this state by less than 100,000 votes in 2020 -- just 1% of the vote. It looks like it will be just as close this year. **[You can use this link to find a volunteer event happening near you, or choose one from the list below. Let’s do this.](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1218?utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241102_b15_kh_tier1_do_do_fl_ak&t=7&akid=236%2E2563979%2EmzP4G8)** **[The Final Stretch Canvass with PA Dems in East Stroudsburg!](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1219?c0=706995.oA9jNT&utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241102_b15_kh_tier1_do_do_fl_ak&t=10&akid=236%2E2563979%2EmzP4G8)** Sunday, November 3rd, 9:00 a.m. East Stroudsburg, PA 18360 | | [RSVP HERE](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1219?c0=706995.oA9jNT&utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241102_b15_kh_tier1_do_do_fl_ak&t=11&akid=236%2E2563979%2EmzP4G8) --- **[The Final Stretch Canvass with PA Dems in Stroudsburg!](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1219?c0=713578.1u3fBm&utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241102_b15_kh_tier1_do_do_fl_ak&t=10&akid=236%2E2563979%2EmzP4G8)** Sunday, November 3rd, 9:00 a.m. Stroudsburg, PA 18360 | [RSVP HERE](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1219?c0=713578.1u3fBm&utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241102_b15_kh_tier1_do_do_fl_ak&t=11&akid=236%2E2563979%2EmzP4G8) --- _Not seeing an event that works for you? You can find more volunteer opportunities**[here](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1218?utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241102_b15_kh_tier1_do_do_fl_ak&t=12&akid=236%2E2563979%2EmzP4G8)**._ We have three days to get this done. Let’s look back at these final three days knowing we did everything we could. As you are out talking to your fellow Americans at their doors, over the phone, and in your neighborhood, remember that we have so much more in common than what separates us. We are all in this together. And together, we will write the next chapter in the most extraordinary story ever told. Three days to go, Kamala Kamala Harris Vice President of the United States [](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1218?utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241102_b15_kh_tier1_do_do_fl_ak&t=14&akid=236%2E2563979%2EmzP4G8) | [VOLUNTEER TODAY](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1218?utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241102_b15_kh_tier1_do_do_fl_ak&t=15&akid=236%2E2563979%2EmzP4G8) --- | * * * | | [DONATE](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-hfp-footer-2024?refcode=kh_em_do_20241102_b15_kh_tier1_do_do_fl_ak&amount=47&amounts=47%252C75%252C100%252C250%252C500&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ak&utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241102_b15_kh_tier1_do_do_fl_ak&t=16&refcode2=236_2563979_mzP4G8&akid=236%2E2563979%2EmzP4G8) --- | [TAKE ACTION](https://go.kamalaharris.com?utm_medium=email&utm_source=ak&utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241102_b15_kh_tier1_do_do_fl_ak) --- | [SHOP](https://store.kamalaharris.com?utm_medium=email&utm_source=ak&utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241102_b15_kh_tier1_do_do_fl_ak) --- * * * This email was sent to **dpwillis67@gmail.com**. When I ran against Lauren Boebert in 2022, I knew we could win. No one believed me – not the Democratic party, not the Republican party, and certainly none of the political pundits. Ultimately, though, after the recount, I lost to Lauren Boebert by just 546 votes. It was the closest race in the entire country. We were outspent heavily by Boebert and her allies. And the attacks and the vicious lies they told about me were really hard on my family – especially my two teenage children. After we came so close to winning against Boebert, everyone expected me to run again in 2024. It seemed like a no-brainer. But it wasn’t an easy decision to put my family through what I knew was going to be an even nastier race than the last. I spent a lot of time reaching out to supporters and donors like you, listening and getting their advice. And everyone promised me: They’d have my back. So I took a leap of faith. Now, with Lauren Boebert having run off scared, this seat is going to be much harder to win. The Super PACs are attacking me. I need your help if I’m going to have the resources it takes to finish the job and win this critical House seat. subject: Protecting our democracy
body: Secretary Jocelyn Benson is on the front lines. Here’s how you can support her today: Friend, We all have differing opinions heading into Tuesday’s big vote. That’s the beauty of democracy! But one thing we can all agree on is that the stakes this year are high. And when the elections are consequential, we often see an uptick in misinformation and bad-faith attempts to undermine our democratic process. **Michigan’s Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson is on the front lines of the fight to ensure our elections are free, fair, and secure for everyone — Democrats, Republicans, and independents alike.** Recently, Secretary Benson spoke about the challenges we face heading into Tuesday: _“We know that because our systems are secure, there are foreign bad actors and adversaries to democracy on the global scale who will seek to potentially not hack our systems, but hack voters' minds to spread falsehoods and misinformation — not just to sow seeds of distrust, but to diminish citizens' confidence in the process and in their own voices.”_ **Secretary Benson is on the road answering questions, building confidence in the vote, and ensuring all Michiganders can make their voices heard this year**. body: # [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=4752%2E552475%2Er1Auo8) Peter, it’s Tiernan, Bob Casey’s campaign manager. I’m taking a break from knocking on doors to send you a quick message, because the election is just THREE DAYS AWAY! Our team is talking to thousands of voters across the Commonwealth every day, making sure they know the difference between Bob Casey and Dave McCormick and the stakes of this election. This race will come down to the wire, so we can’t take any vote for granted. body: We can take back the White House and the Senate, but if we lose the House – which we only hold by a handful of seats – we can’t get anything done. | [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=eb704364e35e4001923497fb27b8e16b&_e=e7rI0m7XqEHdNdh3dk1I-CQr2ZKGSchw2y6s9bQCKKiobXKvp1JD0D8jvUv3p2xa3FH73jDNDRuFBO0uF_rQvQuMV1bOKpS34_M3YvzTZbda-mNAT-9IQDACuYkblxdzHyobTVB98vWwy3r_qMLLkmGZpWxLOCbjwDYRAfRv8yOgaFRr6u3lU_8V1Vnnql97F34wEOZ-XTN7TJxoaJsg42wKzlFcGzcY3NZ30S211DsFtC8o_Wp7bDwaOdVXeY2h8ImsD3UdHKNYFj8iFmOnfZH7vNZx3p5fp28hyy5wSrKB-9pY7MLjKLp4jBST2dp-3nMW2U8DMLXxdyGPNkB7xUD3PN1Bg1B4N2MIw2bCZBEBhSDeGESMFx1Q4pklbWC2-CBLRSQXe9PbW8UaoA47i-19A84khf6LLR-EsQcRvcQPellxEdXUnedm6da4xmRI) I’m worried you’re sleeping on this, Peter. Democrats have been leading in the Generic Congressional Ballot for three months now, meaning more Americans would rather send a Democrat to represent them in Congress than a Republican. body: | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96409498/509902063/1654258770?refcode=header-img&amount=25&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZTkyNWY1NC0yZjk5LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KjuWRwz7zPyzlBCfgdrF3n15u1zHzEzGqffPckTutQU=) --- Peter, I grew up across the street from one of Donald Trump's golf courses in New York. body: We’re investing $50,000 in phone calls and texts over the next few days to ensure we mobilize our voters and turn them out to the polls in support of Ruben. # Peter, we’ve put $3 million into Arizona supporting Ruben Gallego. He is one of our original members, our first Arizona State Captain. He is a Marine, a fighter, a man of character. He is the kind of leader we need more of, and we need far less like his opponent, Kari Lake. But in the last week, three polls have dropped showing Ruben tied, or worse. Two of them actually have Kari Lake leading Ruben. This is a huge concern for us, and we’re scrambling to help. We’re investing $50,000 in phone calls and texts over the next few days to ensure we mobilize our voters and turn them out to the polls in support of Ruben. This late in the race, the most important thing we can do is get out the vote. Angus is a critical partner of mine in the U.S. Senate, and we can’t afford to lose his thoughtful, compassionate, bipartisan approach to policy making. He’s running for reelection in Maine and I’d like to ask you to support his campaign by splitting a $20 contribution between us. There’s just too much on the line — from reproductive rights to access to the ballot box — to risk losing Angus and letting Republicans take back the Senate majority. Can you chip in today? body: #                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 Peter, the amount of support Ruben and this campaign has already received is breathtaking. If we could win this race without sending another fundraising email your way, rest assured: We would do it. But if we did that we would cede Arizona and everything we have fought for over the last two years to Kari Lake. You’ve done too much to let that happen. [**So, we’re writing to ask you to make your first donation to Ruben Gallego’s campaign. Chip in $20.24 to ensure that we defeat Kari Lake. name: Pete Maysmith, LCV Victory Fund
subject: GET OUT THE VOTE: LAST DAY TO PITCH IN
body: To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTE3MTM2MTgS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjEwMDAyNjY5MQS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser. Peter — this is it. The election is on Tuesday, and our field teams are out knocking on doors right now to help Kamala Harris beat Donald Trump and elect environmental champions down the ballot. I’m reaching out because their ability to keep going depends on you, Peter. Folks from all over the country have been pitching in — $5, $10, $50 — to help turn out environmental voters. But if we’re going to win in the swing states of Pennsylvania, Michigan, Wisconsin, North Carolina, Nevada, and Arizona — it’s going to take all of us. Our team has knocked on more than 3 MILLION doors in states that could be decided by a small number of votes. We’re STILL reaching voters who are undecided. Are you with us? Today is the final day of our pre-election fundraising campaign. A group of donors is triple matching every contribution until midnight. https://links.messages.lcv. MAKE YOUR 3X GIFT >> https://links.messages.lcv. You know what’s at stake. The future of our democracy — and of our planet — comes down to what happens in the next few days. Every. Single. Vote. Counts.I’ve never seen an election polling this close — where virtually every swing state is a true toss-up. When things are this close, victory will come down to turnout. If the environmental movement turns out, I know we can win.And I also know that if voters who support our issues stay home, Trump will be our next president. So we’re asking one last time today — please, help our organizers knock on doors, call, and text to get environmental voters to the polls. It’s the final weekend before Election Day — our organizers are working around the clock, running on cold coffee and even colder pizza. We’re asking everyone who can to pitch in to let them know: we’re cheering you on! TRIPLE YOUR IMPACT: Help turn out environmental voters in PA, MI, WI, NC, NV, and AZ. Let our organizers know you’ve got their backs! Even $5 helps >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/k_ypT7qP~ MAKE YOUR 3X GIFT >> https://links.messages.lcv. Thanks, Peter — for everything you do for people and the planet! name: Katrina Christiansen
subject: An incredibly tough decision, Peter
body: --- | |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         I just left a critically important meeting with my team, Peter. As a top supporter of my campaign, you deserve to be in the loop. The election is days away, and right now we are falling short of our budget goal. After pouring over our polling, it became clear: If we had a bit more money, we could reach the undecided voters we need to win this race. [**The money wasn’t in the budget, but I gave the green light to ramp up our ad spending.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96413110/509912965/-1408912288?amount=15&refcode=20241102_em_fr_b1_katrina_main_v1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg4ODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTdhZGM3MzQtMzQ5OS1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=juD0Mkjz3GKB5rfpRuB449wSpcwOFtubmMRMwGBoizY=) It’s a risk. But in a race this close and this important, it would be a mistake for us not to leave it all out on the field. subject: An essential part of our strategy to win
body: # [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=4755%2E552475%2EewVBBe) Hi Peter, it’s Bob Casey. I’ll be quick: This race is a Toss Up, and I need your help to get out the vote on Election Day and win. [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241102-3?refcode=em20241102-3&refcode2=4755_552475_ewVBBe&akid=4755%2E552475%2EewVBBe) National Republicans are spending millions on attack ads in the closing days of this race to buy this seat and take control of the Senate. We’re facing an uphill battle, Peter. subject: Voting is fun, easy, and everyone is doing it
body: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em] “Voting is fun. Voting is easy. And everyone is doing it!” When you’re an organizer, that sentence is one of the first things you learn about getting out the vote. The #1 way to make sure people actually go vote is by letting them know those three facts. Voting is fun. Not only are you exercising your civic duty and your fundamental right by voting, you also get a great sticker! Voting is easy. Between the 200+ early vote centers in San Diego County, the ballots mailed directly to voters, and the official ballot drop boxes, voting is so easy . Everyone is doing it. Here in CA, more than five million people have already returned their ballots. It’s a party! So as you’re going about your weekend, whether you’re canvassing, phonebanking, or just running errands, I hope you’ll tell everyone you talk to that voting is fun, easy, and everyone is doing it – and then remind them to go to IWillVote.com [https://iwillvote.com/] for any and all information they need to go vote! If you’re looking for volunteer opportunities in these final days, you can find them here [https://go.kamalaharris.com/] . And if you still need to return your own ballot…what are you waiting for?! Go, vote, win! -Sara https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em] Congresswoman Sara Jacobs California’s 51st District CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em] If you can’t give much right now, I want you to know that even $1 or $5 makes a difference. Flip this seat, protect our Republican House Majority, and secure the future of our country by chipping in to support my campaign today.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=d277da4f676642c2b62e033c5edf58fa&_e=41FBuH71DqEgx-aqATySMAuJVKd7mfUf_MUecysopIm7L-dqv3b4Ryl4cWRzWmbiLwWoX8lVyO2dBr6Qs1p6AYC39klD16OUUHlCfB7eIY0ZaKhLS-TE2zoJOHTOpGdtfYEguAOekkZMU1VP-EPiDtJ-Rl1m4L1_QDTgifeGAWX8YMCZsRFJETP7TJ2pbovw63hfGAO6LbvKhGVf4y7I3iEDAcbl4J_9KNAWQq-jopRZc4naw3kAQ5zqTtg3InHV01hdUyZjtZqXlO8oWQlp2XCYgV5xQGTP23Vdjm_cyHskQGFgXNSU52wmmfVL42fdEEnpjKwDIyiAyjgbbPUG_hxqdmdWuCIrAHlwk655GI9OmDH843MteMEYVg1GDyycUPfh-0h_SQ5rUtVjtFJIe6rfrGpAkMsEPW72-4GkopU43bW59DnvW_3pahKdPmdh) For America, **Kevin Lincoln** Veteran, USMC [ ** SEND A MARINE TO CONGRESS ➞ **](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=d277da4f676642c2b62e033c5edf58fa&_e=41FBuH71DqEgx-aqATySMAuJVKd7mfUf_MUecysopIm7L-dqv3b4Ryl4cWRzWmbiLwWoX8lVyO2dBr6Qs1p6AYC39klD16OUUHlCfB7eIY0ZaKhLS-TE2zoJOHTOpGdtfYEguAOekkZMU1VP-EPiDtJ-Rl1m4L1_QDTgifeGAWX8YMCZsRFJETP7TJ2pbovw63hfGAO6LbvKhGVf4y7I3iEDAcbl4J_9KNAWQq-jopRZc4naw3kAQ5zqTtg3InHV01hdUyZjtZqXlO8oWQlp2XCYgV5xQGTP23Vdjm_cyHtkmlamek6wQ7XyEFZAPTnGE8G_REQtXjQEWe29O5Dp3zuQ8y44MkY72BceiCs813-Djpv5uAZARaIj6qb6-G-Gelm4ETlBXjwMy1y-CJJOB1SAv1Vu3uE523e40g0Kg--Vyky5zp5pyNjxqvPtiDMO) | **Meet Kevin Lincoln ** My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran. Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader. I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton. name: Steve Garvey
subject: Important message
body: What matters most right now is that we do whatever we can to fund a campaign that can win. That’s the most important thing. Winning this race. | | | ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         --- | | --- --- | | Fellow Patriot,I have an important message that I didn’t think I’d be sending you today. In just a moment, I am going to ask you to make a contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate. November 5th is _days away_ , and I’d really appreciate the chance to explain why this request — especially today — is so critically important.Here’s the truth:Right now, we have a week of media buys to pay for — the most important week of the entire campaign. And if we don’t raise what we need now, we will be forced to give up the airwaves and let Adam Schiff and the Democrat-machine backing him up run their attacks on me unopposed.What matters most right now is that we do whatever we can to fund a campaign that can win. That’s the most important thing. Winning this race. Not just for the sake of winning, but because of what it would mean to substitute my presence with Adam Schiff’s in the Senate.That’s a reality I don’t think any of us want to consider, but it’s what will happen if we come up short.Now, time is running out. body: [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/33436?t=1009&amount=25&akid=3181%2E52803%2E7kOuRk ][IMG] Peter, this is probably the longest email you’ll ever get from me. But it’s also one of the most important, so it really would mean a lot to me if you could read through it. If you’re in a hurry or if you’re already sold and ready to do whatever it takes to help me defeat Larry Hogan and defend our Senate majority, [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/33436?t=1010&amount=25&akid=3181%2E52803%2E7kOuRk ]then please consider making a quick grassroots contribution to give us the resources and momentum to win this race in just 3 days! [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/33436?t=1011&amount=25&akid=3181%2E52803%2E7kOuRk ]Donate I want to outline our campaign's message to fill Maryland’s open U.S. Senate seat. It hinges on 3 major components: Power to the People This campaign has never been about me, Peter. It’s always been about Marylanders, our families, and our communities. And when Republican Larry Hogan entered the race putting our Democratic Senate majority at risk, it became about the future of the entire country. That’s why Republicans are pouring millions of dollars into this race. But during the Democratic Primary, we proved that Maryland is won by the many, not by the money. We’ve never had limitless resources, million dollar checks, or shady dark money super PACs pulling the strings. Instead, we built a grassroots coalition of people in every corner of the state who stepped up to volunteer, donate, and talk to their neighbors about our campaign. Your time and your contributions were the driving force behind our primary victory, and we need to continue building on that in order to win on Tuesday. Focus on the Issues that Matter While Republicans are lining up to get behind Donald Trump and his divisive MAGA agenda, we're focusing on the issues that matter most to people — like protecting abortion rights, improving wages, and preserving our democracy. My Republican opponent Larry Hogan hopes Marylanders won’t remember that as governor, he vetoed legislation that would have expanded access to abortion care throughout the state. He’s banking on Marylanders forgetting that he vetoed a $15 minimum wage and legislation to benefit unions and workers. He’s hoping Marylanders won’t realize that electing him means handing control of the Senate over to extremists like Ted Cruz and Lindsey Graham. On the issues that matter most, Hogan’s record speaks for itself: He’s all wrong for Maryland, and he’ll say and do whatever he thinks will win him this seat. Make the Case for a Democratic Senate Majority Here’s the truth, Peter: There simply isn’t any way Democrats maintain our razor-thin Senate majority if Larry Hogan wins this open seat. Mitch McConnell handpicked Hogan for this race because he sees Maryland as his best chance to flip a seat, retake the majority, and enact his far-right, anti-choice agenda. If the GOP retakes the Senate, they'll have the power to pass a national abortion ban, roll back environmental protections, undermine our elections, and so much more. Hogan has proven that he cannot be trusted to protect our reproductive rights or put Maryland families first. Defending the Senate is the only way to protect our freedoms, uplift working families, and preserve our democracy. We’ve got a winning message that’s resonating with voters, Peter, and I need your support to make sure everyone hears it.
