body: | [ ](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/JLPFZPN_TI5Xg9tb95UwIQ~~/AAPPAAA~~) Peter, we’re _so_ close to the finish line but I need your help ONE more time. Our college tour hit campuses in Florida, Ohio, Arizona, Minnesota, Pennsylvania, Nevada, Georgia, Michigan, North Carolina – all to rally young voters for Harris-Walz. And we’re already seeing results! Early turnout numbers are surging on college campuses in key battlegrounds like North Carolina, Michigan and Georgia – and it’s all thanks to people like you, Peter. **But guess what? We’re _STILL_ not finished.** From now until Election Day, my focus is on Florida. I’ll be on University of Central Florida’s campus til’ the polls close, golf-carting students to their polling place and reminding them that it’s OK to take a study break to go vote. More than OK – it’s _critical._ **This is one of the few campuses with a polling location on site, so everything we do these last few days can make an _immediate impact_. But I can’t do it alone. I’m counting on you to fuel this fight until the very end.** [**_Peter, will you rush $27 to help fund our last push to mobilize young voters at University of Central Florida and across Florida? Any of these votes could be the ONE we need to defeat fascism in Florida, but we can’t turn them out without your support!_**](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/JLPFZPN_TI5Xg9tb95UwIQ~~/AAPPAAA~~) _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [DONATE $10 ➔](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/CbiO3lydnhLVn84EVJPiDw~~/AAPPAAA~~) --- | [DONATE $27 ➔](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/yBJpRcfGiYQmpKETaG29-g~~/AAPPAAA~~) --- | [DONATE $50 ➔](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/c8tXPHhRRT4PwxCQsbVClw~~/AAPPAAA~~) --- | [DONATE $100 ➔](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/6wFfHXC9dvhOX1VcyobT1A~~/AAPPAAA~_M-ZSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAABp) --- | [DONATE $250 ➔](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/g7JOwQKbPjZVdUZB1xh6rg~~/AAPPAAA~_M-ZSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAABp) --- | [DONATE OTHER ➔](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/YlfjTFrIME2MosvwV_acKg~~/AAPPAAA~~~) --- Let's finish strong, Maxwell Frost | [ ](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/JLPFZPN_TI5Xg9tb95UwIQ~~/AAPPAAA~~) --- **Maxwell Alejandro Frost is an organizer representing Florida's 10th Congressional District. subject: Knock knock knock
body: | | | [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=c0ebc7e5947647369b1335de757e0fb0&_e=CZVDnPDXHM6yWGURsuIVp7TQgR0sI-CbwNDq025KihfOAtHE6CI5U-UrbnWf65Wu7lnBuKDjH9P7ovDumEa8JFeKQOmNER7XN9mbqUVU02rGEt5MYjJ5sJfkwHQssnWkYCWiJohvf5wGQxlZqglWO08qnbVxAsi6P1Std9GC938i8FW5BWLY8m3G5zB2yz1swROID5mUiacyKapPg-hn4k7uQEq-BNHDrCP2pn5TrEs2WGD6MzVkivYmLmnj473iINMOKSW4WxDqdM8PC6sxUTIET3jF1cBM2HC123Z3l2Rpp_rSZvyAhxlJPGGr1qlzcy3nO9wHvSAAYEjoH7Vg9ERW-u46Sv9e4ktz7g59ER_J53mZc201E6IcknLuxA-obYLRkq1JTQlQbob-3paZYw%3D%3D) --- **Knock, knock, knock.** _It’s the scariest sound you’ll hear when you live in a communist country._ _It’s the last sound my parents heard when their fathers were taken away._ _It’s the sound of always living in fear, and it’s my family’s real-life story._ We escaped from Vietnam just days before Saigon fell to the communists, and we were given a new life in the most generous country on Earth. **America saved my life, and I dedicated my life to paying her back.** I graduated from the United States Naval Academy and served for 25 years in Navy Special Operations in Iraq, Afghanistan, Somalia, and Pakistan and 40 other countries around the world. I love this country - but right now, it’s taken a dark turn. Now, the knocks are coming from Joe Biden’s Department of Justice. Sending two dozen armed agents to arrest a pro-life activist in front of his family. Raiding gun shops and seizing records from law-abiding gun owners. Arresting his challenger in the next election. _And he’s doing it all while real criminals are free to roam our streets._ We are losing our country. You know it. But you also know we can save it. I’ve been all over the world. Believe me when I tell you, if America fails, there is nowhere else to go. **It’s time to save America while we still have a chance.** **I’m Hung Cao, retired Navy Captain, and I’m running for the United States Senate.** **[If you’re all-in to defend the greatest country on Earth, join our team today.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=c0ebc7e5947647369b1335de757e0fb0&_e=CZVDnPDXHM6yWGURsuIVp7TQgR0sI-CbwNDq025KihfOAtHE6CI5U-UrbnWf65Wu7lnBuKDjH9P7ovDumEa8JFeKQOmNER7XN9mbqUVU02rGEt5MYjJ5sJfkwHQssnWkYCWiJohvf5wGQxlZqglWO08qnbVxAsi6P1Std9GC938i8FW5BWLY8m3G5zB2yz1swROID5mUiacyKapPg-hn4k7uQEq-BNHDrCP2pn5TrEvR6smCwjs0_frhwMCj891yYIJC3OEe-vy2L6-VpXe9FLZcqqHzftDDgnCKuE9KVxKDQwLgWDryI2wNJJwOW13u0DsfmtlJoIyN9sjdwiR2C1x7YxJQPOJLmDl_1E1a2OmSNkEEe0VLctKkgm8mhqFKS7SJZT0CgJHe_2Am_2OfRA%3D%3D)** --- [**JOIN THE TEAM - STAND WITH ME TODAY**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=c0ebc7e5947647369b1335de757e0fb0&_e=CZVDnPDXHM6yWGURsuIVp7TQgR0sI-CbwNDq025KihfOAtHE6CI5U-UrbnWf65Wu7lnBuKDjH9P7ovDumEa8JFeKQOmNER7XN9mbqUVU02rGEt5MYjJ5sJfkwHQssnWkYCWiJohvf5wGQxlZqglWO08qnbVxAsi6P1Std9GC938i8FW5BWLY8m3G5zB2yz1swROID5mUiacyKapPg-hn4k7uQEq-BNHDrCP2pn5TrEvNcVwPc5unWJNwPnfd86LkAnJO_N_fxmYP9k7WcplMZhZljQ2TQHoKSfaOMTjLr-kt8iridDG5kfW5DkyOOXo4v3Uy58x6l-sEfa34MORhHiXtZ13xKPqEkUTBIU9_8MWv-vg1viMRV88Uv77f2c6s7l9UIz3Y9wf5x9nx29csNQ%3D%3D) --- I still believe America can be the land of opportunity, Fellow Patriot. And as someone who owes their life to the American Dream, I have an obligation to fight back against those who have trampled on it. We need REAL fighters. Not politicians, not bureaucrats, and not keyboard warriors acting tough in custom made suits. If we’re going to preserve our freedoms, we can’t be intimidated. We must be fearless. **[It’s time to fight for the American greatness that lies within us. body: [1]Justice Democrats Peter, the 2024 general election is only three days away. The outcomes of Tuesday's election will drastically reshape the future of our nation and will demand different urgencies from our movement. But no matter what, this moment calls for building a new Democratic Party, led by new leaders that working families actually see fighting for their most pressing needs. It’s the final weekend before Election Day, with just three days left to reach as many voters as possible. Team Pramila is going all-out to get out the vote, and we need your help! [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241102-1?refcode=em20241102-4483&amount=3&refcode2=4483_420207_rBPj8g&akid=4483%2E420207%2ErBPj8g) **Here are just a few of the ways you can make a difference in this final stretch:** * [**Sign up for a virtual phone bank**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/48302?t=2&akid=4483%2E420207%2ErBPj8g) and make calls to swing state voters from the comfort of your own home, or [**join us for in-person phone banking**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/48303?t=3&akid=4483%2E420207%2ErBPj8g) in Seattle. No experience? No worries! We’ll provide all the training you need. * [**Pitch in $3 to power the work we’re doing.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241102-1?refcode=em20241102-4483&amount=3&refcode2=4483_420207_rBPj8g&akid=4483%2E420207%2ErBPj8g) We’ve made more than 50,000 calls into swing states so far and Pramila has been personally leading door-knocking teams — and since she doesn’t take corporate PAC money, it’s your grassroots support that keeps us going. Whether you can make calls, knock on doors, or even just pitch in a few dollars to support our work, **it WILL make a difference**.
